rows.original: You lift up one of the witch's tattooed hands, pressing down her sheer silk glove with your thumb. Beneath it, you can just make out the swirling lilac runes of a spell, invocations of elemental fire and... something about the mind? "Ah, you've got a keen eye. This one was one of my master's own inventions. It came to him in a dream, he said. One of his first steps on the road to madness." Ynes daintily pulls on each finger of her glove, and then presents it to you to remove the rest of the way, revealing the purple tattoos in their entirety. "Have you ever experimented with phosphorus, [pc.name]? Veins of it reached deep into the mountainous heart of our home, Corlund. It burns like a white sun, and a little water isn't near enough to extinguish it. My master claimed he had a dream of injected white-hot phosphorus into a servant's flesh, burning him alive from inside. Within a week he'd developed this spell... and had tested it on a butler who'd displeased him. He was so pleased that he inked it into my flesh the next day, to ensure that he would never forget it." Ynes curls her fingers. "This spell is a potent defensive tool. Touch a man, and light him on fire from inside. Keep striking, keep stoking the flame, until nothing remains but ashes. Copy the runes, but not my master's intent to use them: this spell is one of the most painful things you can experience." You lift her arm up, turning it around in front of you so you can see each one of the arcane sigils tattooed from elbow to wrist. It's hard to imagine such a soft, beautiful woman as Ynes possessing such a horrific spell, much less ever using it. "Don't give me that look. You know what I am," Ynes sighs. "What I was. Why do you think I wear these gloves, hm?" You commit the runes to memory the best you can, tracing each of them one by one with your fingertips. Invocations of fire, elemental binding, a conjuration sigil... gods, this spell really does just drive spears of burning phosphor under the target's skin. You can't help but [pc.isDK |lick your lips |grimace ] — it's no wonder Eirina would consider this to be among her forbidden spells. 为了方便你的行程，我们已经派了一辆马车前往霍克斯通男爵领地肥沃山谷中的商队旅馆，那辆马车会随时等候你的到来，带你翻越群山，前往蒂克里斯公国。
    
    致以最崇高的敬意，  
皇家图书馆馆长瓦斯科大师

一份皇家邀请函，啊？你 [pc.dcb
        |向瑞弗点头表示认可。
        |感谢河神
        |紧紧拥抱瑞弗一下
    ] 用来传递这条消息，然后把它放进你的背包里。或许值得一试……
    
    [var2
        |提克里斯，是吗？”凯特凑过来，从你肩膀后面望去，“据说他们拥有世界上最为丰富的图书馆之一。如果世界上有什么地方能让我了解更多关于传送门的信息，那肯定就是那里了。拜托了 [pc.name]如果你正在考虑去的话——带上我吧！
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    "Oh, [pc.name]!" River chirps as you pass by, hopping up from where he'd been strumming. "I've got a message for you. Big 'mander lass just dropped it off a couple of hours ago, in fact."
    
    "Big 'mander?" you echo. [vitra.met
        |Vitra? But she's all the way in Khor'minos...
    ]
    
    "Biggest frostscale salamander I've ever seen," he nods. "[var0
        | Present company excluded, anyway.
    ] A warrior born if I've ever seen one. Here."
    
    You take the missive from River when he offers it up and unfurl it. Even without reading a word, you can tell whoever sent this has money to spare: the kitten-bard's handed you a roll of the softest vellum you've ever handled, rolled up around a gold-etched baton. The handwriting is laid out thick and bold, as if with a paintbrush rather than quill, though the characters look somewhat more rounded and compact than most Belharan scripts you're familiar with. 
    
    It reads: "Hail, Champion of [var1],
    
    The tales of your exploits have spread far and wide, across even the great Greyvale Mountains where they have captivated the court of the humble realm of Tychris. It is in light of such astounding feats that the His Most Serene Highness Prince Evander extends his invitation to yourself and your companions to visit the principality and its grand palace, that you might grace the royal court with a personal recounting of your deeds whilst enjoying His Highness's most generous hospitality. There is much opportunity to be found for a champion of your accomplishments within our borders.
    
    For your convenience, a carriage has been dispatched to the caravanserai in the north-west of Hawkstone Barony's fertile valley, and will wait at your pleasure to convey you across the mountains to the Principality of Tychris.
    
    With deepest respect,
    Magister Vasko, Chancellor of the Royal Library"
    
    A royal invitation, huh? You [pc.dcb
        |give River an upnod
        |thank River
        |give River a big hug
    ] for delivering the missive and stow it in your pack. Might be worth checking out...
    
    [var2
        |"Tychris, huh?" Cait chimes in, peering over your shoulder. "They're supposed to have one of the most impressive libraries in the world. If there's anywhere in the world I can find out more about portals, it would be there. Please, [pc.name], if you're thinking about going — take me with you!"
    ]
    
    "

[flags.P_DILEMMA_CARRIAGE
        |"[pc.name]," Captain Tyna says coolly, pushing herself up to a standing position beside the driver's seat of her carriage. "Are you ready to depart yet? We've got a bit of a ride ahead of us, and the royal family's been really looking forward to your arrival."
        |As [party.yall] make your way into the ruins' courtyard, the tall salamander woman pushes herself off the carriage wheel and takes a step towards you, hand lingering on the saber at her hip. River wasn't kidding — she's certainly a big girl, towering just over seven feet tall and wearing barely anything save a short kilt and bustier. Her bare limbs are covered in smooth cyan scales, and she's got more than her share of muscle and scars both. A lengthy lizard-tail sweeps across the ground behind her, its tip flickering with an auroran light amidst the overgrown weeds at her bare feet. 
        
        "So, you're the Champion everyone's talking about," the woman says evenly, looking you up and down. "The [flags.WC_CLEAR
            |boreal elves' diplomat spoke highly of you indeed."
            
            [party.has ryn
                |Etheryn glances at you, ears wiggling in delight.
            ]
            |baroness of Hawkethorne made you out to be quite the hero."
        ] The salamander nods approvingly, sliding her hand from her sword hilt to hooking a thumb through her belt. "I'm Tyna, Captain of the Guard for the Principality of Tychris. The royal family are more eager to meet you, [pc.name], than anyone I've ever escorted before. It's a bit of a trek across the Greyvales, and even more dangerous than usual these days, so I've been commanded to come and make sure you reach the city safe and sound. Assuming you're coming, that is?"
    ]

rows.original: Three days later... The Greyvale Mountains pass you by in stately majesty, their slate-gray peaks earning their name beneath caps of white snow and sporadic clumps of evergreen trees. The old road winds through the valleys and across wind-swept mountainsides, sometimes so narrow that a wheel comes inches from spinning off into the air, or grinding against sheer stone. Captain Tyna's an excellent driver, at least, steering you through the twisting paths with level-headed skill. You see the city just before sundown. The day is spent watching the craggy rock giving way to rolling green hills and farmland dotted with homesteads. Blue-scaled salamanders stare on with curiosity from porches and vegetable patches, but Captain Tyna's presence keeps them from asking any questions — she just waves them off and assures any that wander close that everything's alright. You're friends visiting from Hawkethorne, nothing to worry about. Eventually, the fields end against mighty stone walls, taller than any you've seen elsewhere in the Marches. Towers rise from it every hundred paces, bristling with arrow-slits; the gates are wide enough for a dozen men to match through abreast, but they stand open in invitation. Tyna nods to the soldiers guarding it — only half so scantily clad as their travelling captain, clad up in breastplates and plumed helms. They snap crisp salutes as Tyna drives you through and into the city proper. And a city it truly is! The paved streets are flanked by tan brick homes and businesses with tall tiled roofs and colorful shutters over their window. The occasional curious glance you got on the road becomes a growing throng around you. It seems your exploits have reached more ears than just the royal court's... The ice-cold captain commands them to keep out of your way, driving steadily towards the heart of the city. The crowd parts... and reforms behind you, forming an impromptu procession all the way to the second ring of walls surrounding the palace grounds. The pace of your carriage grinds to a crawl in the midst of such a press of bodies. You're a curiosity, a wonder, to these people. Something so out of place that folk are coming out of their homes from streets away just to see you. Little children run alongside you, waving scaly arms and technicolor tail-flames. "Popular [pc.mf |guy |lady ], aren't we?" Tyna says. "Try not to disappoint them." [pc.isCunning |"No pressure, right?" |You gulp. ] By the time the gates close heavily behind you, separating you from the crowd, it's past dark. Tyna breathes a sigh of relief as she clambers down from the carriage. She sweeps an arm up the paved path ahead, leading to a broad structure of marble and brick that crowns the hilltop in the middle of the city with a single great tower at its center. The whole place is perhaps three times the breadth of Castle Hawkstone back home, though far less imposing in its architecture — it looks more like a temple than a fortress, open and inviting to the public. At least, you suppose, when there isn't a huge crowd trying to see the hero of the hour.
rows.translation: 三天后…… 格雷维尔山脉以雄伟壮丽的姿态从你身旁掠过，那些板岩灰色的山峰在白雪的覆盖下以及零星分布的常绿树木的映衬下，更加显得气势磅礴。这条古老的道路蜿蜒穿过山谷，越过被风侵蚀的山坡，有时道路狭窄到极点，车轮几乎要悬空飞出路面，或者与陡峭的岩石擦肩而过。不过，泰娜船长驾驶技术娴熟，她冷静而熟练地引导车辆穿行在这些曲折的小路上。 你在日落前看到了这座城市。 一整天，你都在观察那些崎岖的岩石如何逐渐让位于连绵的绿丘以及散布着农舍的农田。蓝鳞蝾螈们从门廊和菜园里好奇地注视着你，但泰娜船长的出现让它们不敢发出任何疑问——她只是向它们挥了挥手，向那些靠近她的蝾螈们保证一切都很安全。你们只是来自鹰棘镇的朋友们，没什么好担心的。 最终，那些田野在巍峨的石墙前终结了——这些石墙比你在边境地区见过的任何石墙都要高耸。每隔一百步，就会有一座塔楼耸立在那里，塔墙上布满了箭孔；城门宽大到足以让十几名士兵并排通过，而且它们此刻大开着，仿佛在热情地邀请人们进入。泰娜向守卫城门的士兵们点了点头——这些士兵的装备远没有他们的队长那么精良，只穿着胸甲，头戴羽毛装饰的头盔。当泰娜带你穿过城门进入城市时，这些士兵整齐地向她敬礼。 这确实是一座城市！铺砌的街道两旁是棕褐色的砖房，各种商铺的屋顶都覆盖着高高的瓷砖，窗户上还装有色彩鲜艳的百叶窗。在路上偶尔会遇到的那些好奇的目光，渐渐汇聚成了围绕在你周围的众多人群。看来，你的冒险事迹已经传到了不仅仅是宫廷里的人耳中…… 那位冷若冰霜的队长命令他们让开道路，自己则径直朝城市的中心驶去。人群纷纷退开……然后在你的身后重新聚拢起来，形成一支临时组成的队伍，一路跟随你，直到那环绕宫殿地界的第二道城墙。在如此密集的人群中，你的马车前进的速度简直慢得像爬行一样。对这些人来说，你就是一个奇观，一个奇迹——如此与众不同，以至于人们会从几条街之外赶来， just为了看看你。小孩子们跟在你身边奔跑，他们挥动着布满鳞片的胳膊，尾巴上还闪烁着五颜六色的火焰。 受欢迎 [pc.mf |伙计 |女士 ]不是吗？”泰娜说道，“尽量别让他们失望吧。 [pc.isCunning |没压力吧？ |你咽了口唾沫。 ] 当大门在身后重重关上，将你与人群隔开时，天已经完全黑了。泰娜从马车上下来，长舒了一口气。她顺着前方铺好的小路走去，那条路通向一座由大理石和砖块建造的宏伟建筑——这座建筑矗立在城市的中心，山顶上有一座高大的塔楼。这个地方的范围大概是家乡霍克斯通城堡的三倍，但其建筑风格远没有那么雄伟壮观——它看起来更像一座寺庙，而非堡垒，对公众而言显得开放而亲切。当然，至少在没有人群挤来挤去试图一睹这位当红英雄的风采时才是这样。

They snap crisp salutes as Tyna drives you through and into the city proper. And a city it truly is! The paved streets are flanked by tan brick homes and businesses with tall tiled roofs and colorful shutters over their window. The occasional curious glance you got on the road becomes a growing throng around you. It seems your exploits have reached more ears than just the royal court's... The ice-cold captain commands them to keep out of your way, driving steadily towards the heart of the city. The crowd parts... and reforms behind you, forming an impromptu procession all the way to the second ring of walls surrounding the palace grounds. The pace of your carriage grinds to a crawl in the midst of such a press of bodies. You're a curiosity, a wonder, to these people. Something so out of place that folk are coming out of their homes from streets away just to see you. Little children run alongside you, waving scaly arms and technicolor tail-flames. "Popular [pc.mf |guy |lady ], aren't we?" Tyna says. "Try not to disappoint them." [pc.isCunning |"No pressure, right?" |You gulp. ] By the time the gates close heavily behind you, separating you from the crowd, it's past dark. Tyna breathes a sigh of relief as she clambers down from the carriage. She sweeps an arm up the paved path ahead, leading to a broad structure of marble and brick that crowns the hilltop in the middle of the city with a single great tower at its center. The whole place is perhaps three times the breadth of Castle Hawkstone back home, though far less imposing in its architecture — it looks more like a temple than a fortress, open and inviting to the public. At least, you suppose, when there isn't a huge crowd trying to see the hero of the hour. "

rows.original:
You're announced with the blare of trumpets. A page wearing nothing but a kilt and a tabard — black with a silver dragon on its breast — shouts, "Hail, [pc.name], [pc.title][var0
        |
        | from Hawkethorne
    ]!"
    
    The noise echoes off the vaulted ceiling high above, softened by dozens of tapestries and portraits hanging from the walls. About a dozen guards and servants, all blue-scaled salamanders with as much modesty as Tyna, are in attendance in the palace's foyer — you've clearly arrived later than expected, and whatever courtiers the palace might have are long gone. You're escorted through the palace's great hall and into the throne room, facing down a pair of empty chairs backed with blue velvet sitting on a dias. 
    
    A few moments later and three more salamanders enter from a narrow door half-hidden behind the dias. The smallest of them, a slender and sickly-pale man with a golden laurel clinging to his milky brow, leads the pack while a taller and broader man in a black cloak trimmed in silver gesticulates wildly at him.
    
    "And again I must protest, my prince. These are affairs of state, not the business of southern upstarts! We are perfectly capable of solving our own problems."
    
    The third 'mander is about as tall as the robed man and even more built. The simple grey dress she's wearing does little to hide muscles and voluptuous curves alike, and her hair's a dark red in contrast to every other frostscale you've seen so far. She tweaks the robed man's frilled ear with a grunt of annoyance. "We have had this discussion ad nauseum, Magister Vasko, and our decision stands... and our guest has finally arrived, it seems."
    
    The magister clenches his jaw tight, looking your way with eyes of fury, while the other two salamanders step past their thrones and approach you. The larger woman takes the lead, offering you her hand as if equals. "Welcome to Tychris, Champion. I am Lady Tethys, and this is my husband and the lord of our proud city, Prince Evander. We've been eager to see the [pc.mf
        |man
        |lady
    ] behind the myth, the [pc.title] who brought order to [var1
        |Hawkstone
        |Njorhaalt
        |both Njorhaalt and Hawkstone
    ]."
    
    The frail salamander behind her gives you a vague nod.
    
    You shake the lady-consort's hand and say, "[pc.dcb
        |[silly
            |Peace was never an option. I'm just bringing my own order.
            |I'm just doing what needs to be done.
        ]"
        |Thank you. I'm just doing my best."
        |Aww, thanks, queenie!"
        
        The magister's lips for a tight line at your response, glancing accusingly at the consort.
    ]
    
    "Well," Tethys says, folding her hands in front of herself, "I imagine you must be quite exhausted after your trip. We'd planned a grand dinner in your honor, Champion, but given the late hour, perhaps we should show you to the guest chambers. You can tell us all about your exploits over breakfast, and then perhaps a chance to meet our royal daughter."
    
    Considering how sore your ass is after three days [var2
        |in Brint's lap
        |in Arona's lap
        |in the carriage
    ], yeah, that sounds like a fantastic idea.
    
    The furious scowling from the magister tells a different story...
rows.translation:
随着响亮的号角声，你的名字被宣告了出来。一个只穿着短裙和一件印有银色龙纹的黑色外袍的人高声喊道：“欢迎 [pc.name], [pc.title][var0
        |
        | 来自鹰棘镇
    ]喧闹声在高高的拱形天花板上回荡，不过挂在墙上的数十幅挂毯和肖像画使这种声音变得柔和了许多。在宫殿的大厅里，有大约十几名守卫和仆从在场——他们都是蓝鳞蝾螈人，和泰娜一样，也都非常低调。显然，你来得比预期的要晚，而宫殿里原本可能有的那些朝臣们，早就已经离开了。你被引领着穿过宫殿的大厅，进入王座室。在那里，你看到一对蓝色天鹅绒靠背的空椅子摆放在高台上。 
    
    几分钟后，又有三只蝾螈从半隐藏在屏风后面的狭窄门缝中走了进来。其中最小的一只是一个身材瘦弱、面色苍白的人，他的额头上戴着金色的月桂花环；这个家伙走在队伍的最前面，而另一个身材更高、体型更魁梧、身穿银边黑色斗篷的人则不断地对他挥舞着手部势，似乎在指挥什么。
    
    我必须再次抗议，我的王子。这些是国家大事，不是那些南方新贵能够插手部的事情！我们完全有能力自己解决这些问题。”

第三位使者与那位穿着长袍的男子身高相仿，而且体格更为魁梧。她穿着的那条简单的灰色连衣裙几乎无法掩盖她那结实的身材与诱人的曲线，而她的头发则是深红色的，与你迄今为止见过的所有其他颜色都截然不同。她恼怒地哼了一声，轻轻拨了拨那个穿着长袍的男子褶边装饰的耳朵。关于这个话题，我们已经讨论得够多了，瓦斯科大师，我们的决定已经定下来了……而且看来，我们的客人也终于到来了。
    
    那位法师紧咬着牙关，怒目瞪视着你，而另外两条蝾螈则从它们的王座上走下来，向你走来。那个体型较大的女性走在前面，像对待平等的人一样向你伸出了手部：“欢迎来到提克里斯，冠军。我是泰西斯女士，这是我的丈夫，也是我们这座骄傲城市的统治者——埃万德王子。我们一直都非常期待见到你。 [pc.mf
        |男人
        |女士
    ] 在背后的真相是 [pc.title] 是谁带来了秩序 [var1
        |霍克斯通
        |Njorhaalt
        |Njorhaalt和霍克斯通都……
    ]她身后的那只体弱多病的蝾螈向你微微点了点头。

你与那位女伴握了握手部，然后说道：[pc.dcb
        |[silly
            |和平从来都不是一个可行的选择。我只是在努力维护自己的秩序罢了。
            |我只是在做那些必须做的事情而已。
        ]"
        |谢谢。我只是在尽自己最大的努力而已。
        |哇，谢谢你，小女王！”
听到你的回答，那位大师的嘴唇紧绷在一起，同时责备地瞥了那位王后一眼。
    ]
    
    嗯，”泰西斯双手部交叠在身前说道，“我想你在长途旅行之后一定已经筋疲力尽了。我们原本打算为你准备一场盛大的晚宴，冠军，但考虑到现在已经很晚了，或许我们应该先带你去客房休息。你可以在早餐时向我们详细讲述你的冒险经历，到时候也许还能见到我们的王室女儿。”

想想看，经过三天的旅途，你的屁股肯定已经疼得厉害了吧 [var2
        |坐在布林特的怀里
        |坐在阿罗娜的怀里
        |在马车上
    ]是啊，这听起来确实是个很棒的主意。

不过，那位大师那愤怒而阴沉的表情，却说明了另外一番意思……

rows.original: Sleep comes easily once you're tucked into an opulent guest room on the palace's second floor, but it fails to keep you in its somnolent embrace. As comfortable as you are in the big four-posted bed, swaddled in silk sheets and warm blankets, your dreams are disturbed by strange noises. At first you think it's the howling of the wind whipping across the hill, but when you finally drag your eyes back open, the moonlight spilling through the windows shows no motion in the curtains at all. A still, cold night. And yet, the howling — that high, lilting cry in the night... You pull yourself out of bed and go to the window, half expecting to see a slavering pack of wolves baying in the courtyard. You're hardly the only person poking [pc.hisHer] head out the window, either — you catch sight of a few servants in the palace, but even down in the town below windows are starting to light up with auroran tail-flames. The whole town can hear, but nobody seems alarmed, just curious or annoyed. Like it's nothing out of the ordinary to them. The longer it goes on, though, the more it sounds like a voice. [var0 |Arona rolls over in bed behind you, grumbling "Come back to bed. I'll keep ya safe from the big bad ghosts or whatever." |Arona shoots up in bed behind you, shouting "Fucking ghosts... this place is haunted!" | ] You perk your [pc.ears], trying to pick out the source of the howling. Whatever, or whoever, is making that racket isn't far off. In fact, the longer you listen, the more sure you are it's coming from the castle itself. No, from the top of the tower! What the hell... A hard knock thumps against your door, urgent and insistent. Lady Tethys barges in before you're halfway across the room, the warmth she greeted you with replaced by steely-eyed concern. "Champion. We need to talk."
rows.translation: 一旦你躺进了宫殿二楼那间豪华的客房，入睡就会变得很容易，但这种睡意却无法让你长久沉浸在它的怀抱之中。无论你躺在那张四柱大床上，被丝绸床单和温暖的毯子包裹着，感觉有多舒适一些奇怪的声音扰乱了你的梦境……起初，你以为那是风在山间呼啸的声音，但当你终于重新睁开眼睛时，透过窗户洒进来的月轻型清楚地显示：窗帘上没有任何动静。这是一个寂静而寒冷的夜晚。然而，那呼啸声——那种高亢而悠扬的声响，在夜空中回荡…… 你从床上爬起来，走到窗边，心里几乎期待着会看到一群狼在院子里嚎叫。其实，像你这样感到疑惑的人，不止一个。 [pc.hisHer]你也可以把头伸出窗外——你会看到宫殿里有一些仆人，但就连下面的城镇里，窗户上也开始闪烁着极轻型般的尾焰。整个城镇的人都能听到这种声音，不过似乎没有人感到惊慌，只是感到好奇或有些烦躁。对他们来说，这似乎根本不是什么异常的事情。不过，这种情况持续的时间越长这声音听起来就越像是一个真实的人在说话。. [var0 |阿罗娜在你身后翻了个身，嘟囔道：“回来睡觉吧。我会保护你，让你远离那些可怕的鬼魂之类的东西的。 |阿罗娜在你身后从床上猛地坐起来，大喊：“该死的鬼魂……这个地方有鬼！ | ] 你使出你的能力/技能。 [pc.ears]你试图分辨那阵嚎叫声的来源。无论是什么东西，或者是什么人在发出那种声音，它肯定就在不远处。事实上，你听得越久，就越确信那声音是从城堡里传来的——不，是从塔顶传来的！究竟是怎么回事…… 一阵急促而有力的敲门声响起。在你还没走到房间中间时，泰西斯夫人就已经冲了进来，她刚才还对你表现出热情的态度，此刻却露出了充满关切的目轻型。“冠军，我们得谈谈。

rows.original: What the hell is that noise?
That letter was a load of horseshit, wasn't it?
rows.translation: 那封信根本就是一派胡言，对吧？
rows.raw: "That letter was a load of horseshit, wasn't it?"

rows.original: Tethys sighs as the questions passes your lips, eyes falling to the floor. "That noise... is the reason my husband and I summoned you here, Champion." "Somehow I had a feeling this wasn't just a social call." "I'm sorry for the subterfuge. We did not tell Magister Vasko of our intentions, either... please do not blame him for his outburst in the hall this evening. If you wish to levy blame, direct it entirely at me, but first, my family is in desperate need of help. That noise is the sound of the most important thing in the world to me suffering: my only child, Kythie." "What's wrong with her?" you ask. "Sounds like she's being tortured." Tethys fidgets. "I... in a way, yes. Please, walk with me, Champion. Let me show you the reason we called you here. Just the two of us." That may be for the best. You gesture for the lady of the palace to lead the way, following behind [silly |the bodacious sway of her massive booty and ]her aurora-tail as she takes you from your guest quarters all the way to the very peak of the palace's tower. A pair of guards in full Tychrisian livery stand at the top with their backs to you and the consort, facing the narrow bridge between the main keep and its lone tower. Now that you're closer to the source, that haunting noise that roused you from your sleep has resolved into the frustrated roaring of a woman — one clearly just as large as Lady Tethys, bellowing with rage and slamming against the door at the far end of the bridge. It rattles on its hinges, restrained in place only by a thick wooden bolt laid across it. [pc.isCunning |"Princess locked in a tower, huh? Isn't she supposed to be in another castle — one with a dragon or something?" Tethys gives you a sidelong glance. "Were it only so straightforward as a kidnapping... or a problem solvable by force of arms, I would save her myself. Alas, it's not so simple..." |"Okay, what's going on here?" you finally insist, looking between consort and cage. "Why is your daughter locked up in a tower?" It's like something out of a children's story. ] Sighing, Tethys turns to the pair of guards and commands "Leave us. And... leave the key." Once the two 'manders-at-arms are gone, the lady-consort approaches the door, resting a gentle hand on it despite the violent hammer-blows falling on it from the other side. "Something has happened to my daughter, [pc.name]. Magister Vasko calls it a curse. Whether it's a punishment from the goddess or a hex woven by some enemy of the state, I cannot say. No matter the source, the effect is clear: my Kythie has been overcome by a lewd aggression. She cannot control herself: what started as inappropriate flirtation with Captain Tyna and her guards quickly escalated into outright throwing herself at them, and when our armsmen honorably refused her, she began trying to strongarm servants into bed... now I am afraid that if she isn't contained, she'll force herself on someone. My poor girl has lost her mind to her lusts. You can hear her in there, howling like an animal in her frustration. The whole town can hear our shame. I do not know how else to save her but to sate her. Please, Champion, you must help us."

rows.raw: ' Tethys sighs as the questions passes your lips, eyes falling to the floor. "That noise... is the reason my husband and I summoned you here, Champion." "Somehow I had a feeling this wasn't just a social call." "I'm sorry for the subterfuge. rows.translation: 去直接询问那位公主本人吧。

rows.original: Tethys has mentioned her goddess more than once. Has no divine aid been forthcoming?
rows.translation: 泰西斯已经不止一次提到过她的女神。难道没有任何神灵的帮助降临吗？

rows.raw: "Alright, let's cut to the quick: what help is it that Lady Tethys wants from you exactly?"

rows.original: What's the big deal about her maidenhood?
rows.translation: 她的童贞有什么了不起的？
rows.raw: "What's the big deal about her maidenhood?"

rows.original: You'll agree to help Princess Kythie vent her sexual needs — and to keep her maidenhead intact. How hard can it be?
rows.translation: 你肯定会同意帮助凯西公主满足她的性需求，同时确保她的童贞得以保留。这有什么难的呢？
rows.raw: "You'll agree to help Princess Kythie vent her sexual needs — and to keep her maidenhead intact. How hard can it be?"

rows.translation: 你确实想帮助凯西，但总不能利用一个已经订婚且被诅咒的女性来达到这个目的吧。肯定还有其他办法的。

rows.original: Someone's been cursed with perpetual horniness? Well, you have the perfect solution in the form of a slutty pink cat.
rows.translation: 是不是有人被诅咒了，永远都欲火中烧？那么，有一只淫荡的粉色猫咪，正好能为你提供完美的解决办法。
rows.raw: "Someone's been cursed with perpetual horniness? Well, you have the perfect solution in the form of a slutty pink cat."

rows.original: Too bad you don't have Cait around to help, she'd be perfect for this.
rows.translation: 真可惜你身边没有凯特来帮忙，她做这个再合适不过了。
rows.raw: "Too bad you don't have Cait around to help, she'd be perfect for this."

rows.original:
"So what exactly has this curse done to her?"
    
    Tethys gestures helplessly at the door. "You can hear her, can't you? She's gone mad, consumed by unnatural lusts. At this point we've had to cage her, for fear that she'll force herself one of the servants. My poor daughter can barely string three words together without cursing, and now she barely sleeps. All she does is throw herself against the doors and barred windows, trying to break free so she can... can slake herself on someone; on anyone."
    
    "Is that all?"
    
    "N-no, I suppose. Kythie's a strong girl — she takes after me, as you can no doubt imagine — but the curse seems to have made her even stronger. It took four warriors to wrestle her down and drag her to the tower. She broke poor Ser Ephenos's arm in the process."
    
    So she's stronger, more aggressive, and so horny she can't think straight. Gotta admit, that's not an entirely unfamiliar host of symptoms these days... but it's not going to make her easy to deal with, either.
    
    "Does she have any calm periods?"
    
    Tethys shakes her head. "Only when she's exhausted herself so completely that she passes out. And the moment she wakes..."
    
    So no, not really.
rows.translation:
那么，这个诅咒究竟对她做了什么？”

泰西斯无奈地指向门口：“你们能听到她的声音吧？她已经疯了，被那些违背自然的欲望所控制。现在我们不得不把她关起来，生怕她会强迫某个仆人成为她的牺牲品。我可怜的女儿现在连说三句话都不免要骂几句脏话，而且她几乎睡不着觉。她整天只是不停地撞门、砸窗，试图挣脱束缚，只为了……能找个人发泄情绪；随便哪个人都行。就这些吗？”

“不……我想是的。凯西是个坚强的女孩——她很像我，这一点你们应该能想象得到——但那个诅咒似乎让她变得更加强大了。竟然需要四名战士才能把她制服并拖到塔里去。在这个过程中，她把可怜的埃菲诺斯爵士的胳膊弄断了。

所以，她变得更加强大、更具攻击性，而且欲望如此强烈，以至于已经无法理智思考了。不得不承认，这些症状在如今已经不算什么新鲜事了……但这也意味着她变得更加难以对付了。
    
    她有没有什么平静的时候？”

泰西斯摇了摇头：“只有当她把自己累得昏过去的时候，才会有一会儿平静。而一旦她醒来……”

所以，其实并没有什么平静的时候。

rows.original:
"What can you tell me about Kythie, before the curse?"
    
    "Everything," Tethys answers, smiling sadly. "She's my baby. My pride and joy. Never far from me... even now, I spend much of my days sitting here, hoping that I can sooth her. Ah, but where to start? My daughter takes after me in body and spirit: she's tall and strong, a warrior born at first glance, but she has her father's gentle heart. I turned her to athletics instead of the sword when her sweet disposition became clear: she loves nothing more than to run, to throw discus and javelins, and to wrestle with the guards. She won the the Tychathalon this year... I was so proud to present my own daughter with the aurum wreath of victory."
    
    The consort casts a sorrowful glance towards the door. "Please believe me, Champion: she is a good-natured young woman, full of more warmth than any other frostscale I've met. Someday she'll make a magnificent sovereign, and a loving wife and mother. But in her current state, she cannot rule, much less marry... and our entire line rests with her. My poor girl..."
    
    "She has no siblings?"
    
    "No." Tethys shakes her head. "It was an ordeal just to have the one, and the goddess hasn't blessed Evander and I with another. One beautiful baby girl was all I needed, though. Our little miracle."
    
    You have to ask, you suppose, "[pc.isBimbo
        |Doesn't she have like, a boyfriend or cutie girlfriend to take all this out on?
        |She doesn't have any paramours to vent this frustration out on, I take it?
    ]"
    
    The lady of the palace stiffens somewhat, eyeing the door. "No. This isn't Khor'minos. It doesn't do for high nobility for fornicate so freely, and... and Kythie's hand has long been promised to another. The second prince of Felurze, one of our sister-cities to the south, will come north to be her consort when he comes of age next year. Until then, for the sake of her bloodline's purity, we've kept her away from men."
    
    "I see."
    
    That raises the question of what exactly you can do for her, then...
rows.translation:
在那个诅咒降临之前，你能告诉我关于凯西的什么吗？”

“一切，”泰西斯悲伤地笑着回答，“她是我的宝贝，我的骄傲和快乐。她从来都不会离开我……即使现在，我也常常坐在这里，希望能安抚她。啊，但该从哪里说起呢？我的女儿无论在外表还是性格上都与我很像：她身材高挑、体格强壮，乍一看就像一名战士，但她却继承了我父亲那颗温柔的心。当发现她天性热爱运动而非武艺时，我就让她选择了田径而不是剑术——她最喜欢做的事情就是跑步、掷铁饼和标枪，还有与守卫们进行摔跤训练。她今年赢得了提卡塔隆大赛……能够为自己的女儿戴上这顶胜利的黄金花环，我感到无比自豪。

那位王后悲伤地望向门口，说道：“请相信我，冠军：她是个心地善良的年轻女子，她身上散发出的温暖，远超过我曾经遇到的任何一位霜鳞族成员。总有一天，她会成为一位伟大的女王，一位充满爱心的妻子和母亲。但以她现在的状况，她既无法统治国家，更无法结婚……而我们的整个家族命运都寄托在她身上。我可怜的孩子……

“她没有兄弟姐妹吗？
    
    不。”泰西斯摇了摇头，“能生下那个孩子就已经是莫大的幸运了。女神并没有赐予埃万德和我另一个孩子。不过，一个可爱的女婴就已经足够了——我们的小奇迹。”

你或许会忍不住问：[pc.isBimbo
        |她难道没有男朋友或者可爱的女朋友可以倾诉这些烦恼吗？
        |我想，她没有任何可以倾诉这种沮丧情绪的人吧？
    ]宫殿中的那位女士微微一僵，目光投向门口。“不，这里不是科尔米诺斯。对于高等贵族来说，如此随意地私通是不被允许的……而且，凯西的手早已许给了别人。我们南方的一个姐妹城市——费卢尔泽的次子，明年成年后就会来到北方，与她成婚。在那之前，为了保持她血脉的纯正，我们一直让她远离男性。”

“我明白了。”

那么，这就引出了一个问题：你们究竟能为她做些什么呢？

rows.original: "Your goddess... have you had no luck with her clergy?" "No," Tethys sighs, lips drawing taut. "Tychris is Nareva's stronghold in the north, the most devout of all her cities. Long have we kept her faith since the days of Evander's ancestor who fought for her in the Godswar, and yet her clerics are no more able to help her than Magister Vasko. They have performed exorcisms and purification rituals, but each brings less relief than the last. Even a member of the blessed Order Astrida came to examine her. I will not soon forget the humiliation of watching one of Nareva's chosen having to overpower my child, fending off unwanted gropes and tail-thrusts while she attempted to draw out the curse. She succeeded. We were thrilled... for a few days, until it returned. The Lorekeeper of the Order came next, repeated the process, and again, days later, my daughter began to succumb. The Astrida say they are investigating and assure us of their ability to help her... but days go by, and no word comes. They refuse to see me now. Refuse my husband's summons! All communication with the Order comes back with empty assurances!" Tethys groans. "Should the church find a solution, I will sing their praises to the heavens for the rest of my days. But until then, I cannot bear to see my daughter suffer so." [var0 |"The Order hasn't been helpful?" Tethys shakes her head so violently that the motion carries through all the way to that prodigious bosom of hers. "No! Normally, breaking a curse like Kythie's would be exactly the sort of thing I would expect the Order to be used for, but the Lorekeeper and her paladins have declined to answer our summons after the second attempt. They claim they are researching, and that we cannot rush them! Would that I were so impious, I would have the Lorekeeper dragged here to answer for the goddess's silence! But if Kythie's suffering is not already Nareva's punishment, then surely some worse fate would befall us all if I did." |"Who are these Order Astrida?" you ask. Tethys takes a breath to settle herself. "Ah, you are an outsider, of course. You'll see the occasional salamander with coal-dark scales if you linger in the city — they are the divine servants of Nareva: our goddess of knowledge, strategy, and the arcane. Every blackscale is a hand-sculpted champion of the goddess, crafted in her likeness from the womb to become a peerless mage-knight. The Astrida keep a stronghold here in the city, from whence the goddess sends them out to protect her temples and to stamp out sorcerers that stray from the path of righteousness, those who turn Nareva's gifts to evil. Normally, breaking a curse like Kythie's would be exactly the sort of thing I would expect the Order to be used for, but..." She sighs. "Either we have offended the goddess in some way and are suffering her punishment, or whatever caused this curse is so powerful that even Nareva's chosen are mystified by it. I wish I knew which, but the Lorekeeper and her paladins have withdrawn to their keep and have fallen silent to our summons. Would that I were so impious, I would have the Lorekeeper dragged here to answer for the goddess's silence! But if Kythie's suffering is not already Nareva's punishment, then surely some worse fate would befall us all if I did." ] [pc.isCunning |The consort is growing desperate indeed to even countenance the idea. Breaching a temple, especially a paladin stronghold, isn't something to be taken lightly even for the mightiest of kings. But why in the world can't the goddess of magic's servants help her? ]
rows.translation: 你的女神……你派去的牧师们难道一点作用都没有吗？” “没有，”泰西斯叹息道，嘴唇紧绷着，“提克里斯是娜瑞瓦在北方的据点，也是所有城市中最虔诚的地方。自从埃万德的祖先在神战中为她而战以来，我们一直维护着那里的信仰，然而，那些牧师们同样无法帮助她，就像瓦斯科大师一样。他们进行过驱邪仪式和净化典礼，但每一次都带来的缓解效果越来越差。就连那位备受尊敬的阿斯特里达教团成员也来为她诊治过。我永远忘不了那种羞辱感——看着娜瑞瓦挑选出来的人不得不强行压制我的孩子，阻止那些不必要的触碰和骚扰，而她自己也在努力解除那诅咒。她成功了。我们有几天都欣喜若狂，直到那种情况再次出现。随后，教团的典籍守护者采取了同样的措施，几天后，我女儿又一次开始出现那种症状。阿斯特里达家族表示他们正在调查此事，并向我们保证他们有能力帮助她。……然而日子一天天过去，却始终没有任何消息。他们现在拒绝见我，也拒绝接受我丈夫的召唤！与那个组织的所有沟通都只是得到一些空洞的承诺而已！ 泰西斯叹了口气：“如果教会能找到解决办法，我余生都会为他们歌功颂德。但在那之前，我实在无法忍受看到我的女儿遭受这样的痛苦。 [var0 |这个组织根本没有起到任何帮助作用吗？” 泰西斯剧烈地摇了摇头，这一动作甚至让她那丰满的胸部也跟着晃动起来。“不！通常情况下，解除像凯西这样的诅咒正是我期望这个组织能够发挥作用的地方，但是那位知识守护者以及她的圣骑士们，在我们第二次发出召唤之后，竟然拒绝回应我们的请求。他们声称自己正在进行研究，所以我们不能催促他们！要是我也这么无礼的话，真该把那位知识守护者拖到这里来，让他为女神的沉默负责！但是，如果凯西所遭受的痛苦还不是娜瑞瓦对我们的惩罚，那么如果我真那么做了，我们所有人肯定都会遭遇更可怕的命运。" |这些‘秩序阿斯特拉达’的人都是谁？”你问道。 泰西斯深吸一口气，平静下来后回答道：“啊，你当然是个外人。如果你在城里闲逛，偶尔会看到一些皮肤呈煤黑色、外形像蝾螈的生物——它们就是娜瑞瓦的神圣仆从。娜瑞瓦是我们的女神，掌管知识、战略与神秘力量。每一名黑鳞战士都是女神亲手塑造的勇士，他们依照女神的形象被创造出来，从而成为无与伦比的法师骑士。阿斯特里达家族在这座城市中驻扎着据点，正是从这里，女神派遣这些战士去保护她的神庙，消灭那些偏离正义之路的巫师——那些将娜瑞瓦赐予他们的力量用于邪恶之人。通常来说，解除像凯西这样的诅咒，正是我期望教会能够发挥作用的地方……但是…… 她叹了口气：“要么是我们以某种方式得罪了女神，因此正在承受她的惩罚；要么就是导致这个诅咒的力量太过强大，就连娜瑞瓦挑选出来的人也对此感到困惑不已。我真希望自己能知道是哪一种情况，但是那位知识守护者以及她的圣骑士们已经退回他们的据点，对我们的召唤置若罔闻。要是我再不敬一些的话，真该把那位知识守护者拖到这里来，让她为女神的沉默负责！但如果凯西所遭受的痛苦还不是娜瑞瓦对我们的惩罚，那么如果我这么做了，我们所有人肯定都会遭遇更糟糕的命运。 ] [pc.isCunning |这位王后确实越来越绝望了，甚至都不愿意考虑这个想法。攻破一座寺庙，尤其是骑士团的据点，即便是最强大的国王也绝不能掉以轻心。但究竟为什么呢不能魔法女神的仆从们会帮助她吗？ ]

rows.original:
"Do you have any idea who might have cursed her?" you ask. "Anybody you'd call an enemy?"
    
    Tethys takes a moment to consider. "None that could pull off something so daring! Tychris was once a powerful and influential polis before the Godswar, but since the fall of Belhar we've been left as a frontier town without an empire. There's been little back-stabbing political machination in my lifetime save for the rare baronial squabbling over land, and that's mostly been resolved with amicable duels or marriages. There are bandits that harry our lands from the south, gnolls and ogres too, but I've lead more sorties against them than any other lord and I can safely say I've never seen more than a petty shaman among them. No open foe of the city could inflict a curse that would befuddle Nareva's own servants, surely."
    
    "And hidden foes?"
    
    The consort shrugs. "If we have hidden foes, Champion, then they are hidden from me — I know of none. I was a warrior before I was a mother; I leave spies and skullduggery to Vasko. He has the peasant cunning for such things. The only spellcasters of substantial power in the city are Nareva's holy Lorekeeper, my own court Magister, and Lady Zainem; she's something of a sorceress-philosopher. Eccentric, but that mountain of muscle would sooner break me over a knee for suggesting her guilt than she'd raise a spell against an innocent woman. I would eat my own tail before accusing any of them of conspiracy against the crown."
    
    "I see."

你有没有想过，究竟是谁诅咒了她？”你问道，“有没有什么你认为是敌人的人呢？”
    
    泰西斯沉思了一会儿，然后回答道：“没有谁有这样的胆量做出这种事！在神战之前，提克里斯曾经是一个强大而富有影响力的城邦，但自从贝尔哈尔陷落之后，我们就变成了一个没有所属帝国的边陲小镇。在我的有生之年中，除了偶尔发生的那些关于土地的贵族争斗之外，几乎没有什么暗中算计和政治阴谋。而这些争斗大多都是通过友好的决斗或婚姻来解决的。当然，也有强盗从南方侵扰我们的领地，还有地精和食人魔，但我带领军队出征对抗他们的次数比任何其他领主都要多。可以肯定地说，在这些敌人中，我从未见过有什么高阶的萨满或巫师。这座城市里，没有任何公开的敌人能够施展出那种连娜瑞瓦自己的仆从都会陷入混乱的诅咒吧。
    
    还有隐藏的敌人吗？”
    
    那位妃子耸了耸肩：“如果真有隐藏的敌人，冠军，那他们肯定是对我隐藏起来了——我根本不知道有这样的敌人。在我成为母亲之前，我曾经是一名战士；这类间谍活动和小动作，就交给瓦斯科吧。他在这些事情上可有着农民特有的狡猾劲头。这座城市里唯一拥有真正强大力量的施法者，就是娜瑞瓦的神圣知识守护者、我自己的宫廷法师，以及扎伊奈姆女士——她可以说是一位兼具魔法师与哲学家身份的女性。她性格古怪，但只要我敢暗示她有罪，那庞大的肌肉力量绝对会立刻把我打倒，而她绝不会对一个无辜的女性施展任何魔法。在我指责他们中的任何一个人密谋反对王室之前，我宁愿先吃掉自己的尾巴。
    
    我明白了。

You give the queen a steady nod. "Okay. I'll do it."
    
    Relief is palpable on her face. The large woman leans back against the door and circles her heart with a thumb, murmuring a prayer of thanks to Nareva. "You are goddess-sent, Champion. I... I never thought I would be so relieved to hear someone would lay my daughter outside her marriage bed, but I am beyond desperate. Thank you."

The crown will, of course, reward you handsomely if you find a more permanent cure for our daughter's suffering..." [pc.isDK |Royal money is nice and all, but if you drag this out, who knows how long you can keep slamming her daughter in secret. Still, you'd need to at least make a convincing act of investigating even if you don't necessarily intend to do so. ]"I'll need to look around the palace, the grounds, anywhere Kythie might have been." "Of course. I'll make sure our guards and servants know to help you in any way they can. You have no idea how relieved we are that you're here, Champion. Truly. If there's anything we can do to aid you in your inquiry, do not hesitate to ask. We would only request that you be discreet. If Prince Lazaran discovers the curse — or your method of controlling it — the future of our entire realm will be doubly imperilled. Please, Champion. Help us as you helped [var1 |Njorhaalt |Hawkethorne |Njorhaalt and Hawkethorne both ]!" Surely you can figure this whole curse thing out before that happens. ] ] '

rows.original:
[var0
        |This time, the princess isn't a sweaty mess of naked amazon — rather, she's dressed similarly to her father, with a short kilt and a tunic that leaves most of her chest bare. The effect on a large-breasted woman is... quite a bit more striking than on the willowy Prince Evander. A pair of thick cloth straps are trying to compete with the weight of her chest to hold it up, but is clearly struggling. The princess is quickly settling a fur mantle around her shoulders when you step inside, and her auroran tail has drooped behind her like a shamed puppy. 
        
        "Um, hi," she says awkwardly. Her cheeks and tail both burn a little brighter as you take her new appearance in, but she forces herself to look you in the eye. "I know we've, well, met, but... um, I don't think that quite counts as a proper introduction! Thank you, by the way. I don't, um... gods I'm making a fool of myself." 
        
        The princess takes a deep breath and straightens her back. "I'm Kythie. And I'm faring quite a lot better thanks to... whatever it was you call that."
        
        "[pc.isBimbo
            |Sex!" you explain. "Really raunchy, sweaty sex."
            
            Despite herself, the princess can't help but laugh, hearty and from the core. "Ah, yeah, I suppose it was!"
            
            You give her a bright smile. "Glad to meet the real you, Kythie. I'm [pc.name]. So you're okay now?"
            |Just trying to help," you say reassuringly. "I'm [pc.name]. Glad you're okay."
        ]
        
        "Better, not... okay." Kythie's toe-claws tap anxiously on the tower floor. "My insides are still burning, just not so hot as before. Thank the goddess!" She laughs awkwardly. "I don't... it's getting worse. I can feel it from my toes to my t— my tail-tip! Yeah!"
        
        "So you're not cured?"
        
        The princess fans herself with a hand. "I think you treated the symptom pretty well! Just, whatever is doing this to me is still... doing this to me."
        
        Then you should probably conduct an investigation while you have the chance...
rows.translation:
[var0
        |这一次，公主不再是那个汗津津、赤裸着的亚马逊狼狈模样——相反，她穿得和她父亲相似，短褶裙配着一件让大半胸口裸露在外的束腰上衣。这样的衣着穿在一位丰胸女性身上……比穿在身形修长的 埃万德 王子身上要醒目得多。一对厚布带正试图与她胸部的重量抗衡，把它们托住，但显然相当吃力。你走进来时，公主正迅速把一件毛皮披肩披到肩上，她的 auroran 尾巴像一只羞愧的小狗般垂在身后。
        
        “呃，嗨，”她尴尬地说。你打量她的新模样时，她的脸颊和尾巴都烧得更亮了一点，但她还是强迫自己与你对视。“我知道我们，嗯，见过面了，可是……呃，我觉得那不太算正式介绍！顺便谢谢你。我不，呃……诸神啊，我真是在出丑。”
        
        公主深吸一口气，挺直后背。“我是 凯西。而且多亏了……不管你把那个叫什么，我现在好多了。”
        
        “[pc.isBimbo
            |性爱！”你解释道。“特别淫乱、汗水淋漓的性爱。”
            
            公主还是忍不住笑了出来，笑声爽朗而发自内心。“啊，是啊，我想确实是！”
            
            你向她露出灿烂的笑容。“很高兴认识真正的你，凯西。我是 [pc.name]。所以你现在没事了吗？”
            |只是想帮忙，”你安慰道。“我是 [pc.name]。很高兴你没事。”
        ]
        
        “好些了，但还……没好。”凯西 的脚爪焦虑地敲着塔楼地面。“我的身体里面还在燃烧，只是没有之前那么烫了。感谢女神！”她尴尬地笑了笑。“我不……情况正在变糟。我能从脚趾一直感觉到 t——我的尾巴尖！对！”
        
        “所以你还没痊愈？”
        
        公主用手给自己扇风。“我觉得你把症状处理得很不错！只是，不管是什么东西在对我做这种事，它还是……还在对我做这种事。”
        
        那你大概应该趁还有机会展开调查……

rows.raw: "So why is Tethys so dead-set against letting Kythie marry Lord Theo of Maidenbridge?"

rows.original: "Why? Oh, I could hardly count the reasons, Champion!" Tethys growls, fixing you with a withering look. "Thore is nothing but an upjumped bandit masquerading as a lord, and his misbegotten son is no better than his father. They killed Count Julius in cold blood when he dared to stand up against their company's demand for tribute and now squat on his grave like a pack of vultures. They burned his daughter alive! And then there's the brutal stranglehold over trade he's exerting — one can hardly move goods across the River Maiden without Thore taking a princely cut. He commands the safest crossing of the river for fifty leagues in either direction and is delighted to remind anyone who'll listen. Damned mongrel peasant delights in rubbing his new position in the face of everyone around him!" The lady-consort pauses, and takes a deep breath. "And that is why Felurze is so important, Champion. The city commands the second safest crossing of the Maiden. It's no Belharan stone, but it's stood unharmed for ten years. It's become a lifeline for our city's goods to reach southern markets. You must understand how dangerous it already is, moving anything to Old Belhar. Risking the Maiden in the process is too much. She's savage, particularly this time of year." "Ten years," you murmur. "But Kythie's been betrothed to Lazaran longer, hasn't she? Before Count Thore took over, too." "Yes, yes. Count Julius only had the one daughter; no sons to speak of. I oft wondered if Maidenbridge suffered the same... weakness of the blood... that afflicts so many northern realms. It hardly matters now. Lazaran was always our pick. His parents are good friends, and staunch allies. His uncle Asher, too. Evander's been close with him since they were small." Tethys laughs dryly. "If my husband had been born a woman I suspect we'd have a prince-consort Asher today. Does that answer your question, Champion? I'll not have Kythie's hand bound to that of a usurper and murderer, and that is the end of that!" Yeah, you got it alright. [kythie.isCursed |Considering how steadfast Tethys is in refusing him, one wonders if that would be motive enough to make Count Thore resort to... darker means of encouraging her to accept the offer? ]
rows.translation: “为什么？哦，冠军，这理由我数都数不过来！”泰西斯低吼着，用一道能把人剜掉一层皮的目光盯住你。“托雷不过是个暴发户土匪，披着一张领主的皮；他那个孽种儿子也不比老子强。朱利叶斯伯爵胆敢站出来反抗他们商会索取的贡赋，就被他们冷血地杀害，如今他们又像一群秃鹫似的蹲在他的坟头上。他们还把他女儿活活烧死！再说他对贸易的那套残暴钳制——想沿梅登河运货，托雷不抽走一笔亲王级别的分成，你几乎寸步难行。他掌控着上下游各五十里格内最安全的渡口，还乐此不疲地提醒每一个愿意听的人。这该死的杂种泥腿子，就爱把自己新得的地位甩到周围每个人脸上！” 这位亲王妃顿了顿，深吸一口气。“所以费卢尔泽才这么重要，冠军。那座城控制着梅登河第二安全的渡口。它比不上一座贝拉兰石桥，可十年来一直安然无恙，已经成了我们城中货物运往南方市场的一条命脉。你必须明白，往旧贝尔哈运货本来就已经够危险了。再拿梅登河去冒险，代价太大。这条河很凶蛮，尤其是每年这个时节。” “十年，”你低声说。“可凯西跟拉扎兰订婚的时间更长，对吧？而且还是在托雷伯爵上位之前就订下的。” “是啊，是啊。朱利叶斯伯爵只有一个女儿，没有值得一提的儿子。我常想，梅登布里奇是不是也患上了那种……血脉上的虚弱……困扰着北方那么多王国的毛病。如今这些都无所谓了。拉扎兰一直是我们的人选。他父母是我们的好友，也是坚定的盟友。他叔叔阿舍尔也一样。埃万德从小就和他亲近。”泰西斯干笑一声。“要是我丈夫生来是个女人，我猜今天我们就会有一位王夫阿舍尔了。这样算回答你的问题了吗，冠军？我绝不会把凯西的手绑到一个篡位者和杀人犯手上，这事到此为止！” 嗯，你算是问明白了。 [kythie.isCursed |想想泰西斯拒绝得如此坚决，不知道这够不够成为动机，让托雷伯爵动用……更阴暗的手段逼她接受这门亲事？ ]

rows.original: "About me? Surely I am not a suspect!" You shake your head. "I'm just looking for [pc.isCunning |context |a clearer picture ] here." A momentary bristle passes from the Lady Consort's features, and her shoulders relax backwards. "Very well. Of course. I will spare you the obvious pageantry, then." She takes a breath, shaking off the severity of her normal courtly demeanor. "My family are landholders north of the city, on the frontier of Tychris's domain. We are its shield against the barbarians of the tundra. But we were not immune to the decline that has affected so many bloodlines in the principality; Kythie is the last of my line, and I doubt very much that I would be alive if it were not for my father's love for a foreign priestess." "The decline?" Tethys sighs. "An affliction has long gripped Tychris. One of the malingering repercussions of the Godswar, still blighting us centuries after. The bloodlines of our nobility run thinner each year, producing weaker offspring, and fewer of them. I love my husband very much, [pc.name], but go outside and look upon the statue of his ancestor-king who won the holy war alongside Nareva herself; then compare him to Evander. Prince Philandros would have thought Evander to be his smallest daughter at a glance." [pc.bg scholar |You've heard of such things happening in other isolated reaches of the old Empire. Some consider it to be a punishment from the gods for inbreeding. ] She laughs, but there's a fond smile on her face. Tethys crosses her arms beneath her prodigious bosom — there's certainly no thinning of her bloodline to worry about, if that manifests as skinny and frail heirs. "So your father found the cure?" "We believe that foreign blood will reinvigorate the city. That is why Father took a Jassiran to be his partner, and why we have reached out to Felurze to wed Kythie. Other noble families are beginning to follow suit, in the wake of Kythie's public engagement. I am glad to have been a part of this, in my small part. Perhaps even moreso than my pride as a soldier. " "Did you follow your father's footsteps, as a shield of the realm?" That gives a proud chest-puff out of the 'mander. "I did! I am Strategos for my husband, master of his soldiers. I trained for the position since I was a child, I fought against many foes before I married Evander, and it is my honor to have protected Tychris during the Lion Witch's War afterwards." "Tell me about that?" "Ah, I should not be surprised the war's not so famous beyond our borders," Tethys says, trying to mask some amount of disappointment. "About eighteen years ago, a group of leothran barbarians descended from the northern tundra and began raiding the frontier villages. They enslaved our citizens, burned farms, destroyed bridges that connect us to our people. A shamaness lead the pack, much more powerful than any that had threatened the city for generations — strong enough to lay waste to village militias all by herself. The Order Astrida recalled its paladins to hunt her, but before they could march, a tribesman defected to us and told us of his kins' movements, of their plans to celebrate the solstice in an isolated valley near my family's holdings; I was in a position to seize the initiative and thrust north with the princely guard under cover of night while the Astrida were still coming to their camps." There's a certain relish in Tethys's voice now. "A hard march, but I know the land well. We moved with speed, and caught the witch and her allies while they were still hung over from their merry-making, barely ready for battle — the state in which they had once found our people. Even still, the witch was powerful! She shattered the forest around us with thunder and scoured our shields with lightning. Still and all, we fell on her like warhawks!" The salamander's fists clench before her, and her tail blazes bright. "My men fought with unequalled valor, driving the tribe's warriors to route, until I found myself locking blades with the Lion Witch herself. She gave me the greatest battle of my life! Staff and spear clashed, and her spells burnt my shield black, burned it to cinders. I thought I had finally met my match, until in her hubris she left her spellcasting hand exposed, ready for a killing cantrip; I skewered it with my war knife!" Tethys allows herself a momentary, sadistic smirk. "How she howled! A little pain crippled a mage that powerful, forced her to flee." "Did you kill her?" "No," Tethys sighs. "She did not die by my hand. Her kinsmen broke, bearing their wounded shaman back to the tundra... and her thane-husband left me a terrible wound in trying to separate us. Still, the leothrans were scattered by my guard, and the witch proved easy prey for the Astrida to hunt, once the warband was routed." [pc.bg soldier hunter barbarian |A fine story... though you know tribal cultures like that tend to hold grudges for generations. A humiliating defeat might leave them bitter even today. |Well, routing a whole barbarian tribe is certainly an accomplishment. ] "Did those leothrans ever give you trouble again?" "No, thank the goddess. We taught them a painful lesson, and it's bought us a generation of peace from our neighbors in the north. And that remains my second greatest accomplishment." "And what's the first?" Tethys looks at the door and smiles. "You can guess, I'm sure."
rows.translation: 关于我？我肯定不是嫌疑人吧！” 你摇了摇头，说道：“我只是想了解一下而已。 [pc.isCunning |背景信息 |更清晰的画面 ] 好吧。” 王妃的脸色瞬间变得柔和起来，她的肩膀也放松了下来。“当然可以。那我就不搞那些繁琐的仪式了。”她深吸一口气，摆脱了平时那种正式、端庄的举止，显得更加自然了。我的家族拥有城北的土地，位于提克里斯领地的边境。我们是抵御苔原上那些野蛮人的屏障。然而，我们也无法逃脱这场影响整个公国众多家族的衰败趋势；凯西是我家族的最后一代成员，如果没有我父亲对那位外国女祭司的深情，我恐怕早已不在人世了。这种衰败……” 泰西斯叹了口气：“提克里斯长期以来一直深受其害。这是神战留下的后遗症之一，几个世纪以来一直在折磨着我们。我们贵族的血脉一年比一年稀薄，后代也越来越弱小，数量也越来越少。我非常爱我的丈夫。 [pc.name]但是，你不妨走到外面去看看他那位曾与娜蕾瓦一同赢得那场神圣战争的祖先国王的雕像，然后再将他与埃万德进行比较。菲兰德罗斯王子一看就会觉得，埃万德简直就像他的小女儿一样。 [pc.bg scholar |你肯定听说过，在旧帝国的其他偏远地区，也发生过类似的事情。有些人认为，这是上天对近亲繁殖行为的惩罚。 ] 她笑了，但脸上带着一丝温暖的笑容。泰西斯将双臂交叉在自己那丰满的胸前——如果这意味着她的后代会变得瘦弱不堪，那么她的血统显然并没有退化。“所以你父亲找到了治愈方法？我们相信，外来的血液能够为这座城市注入新的活力。正因为如此，父亲才会选择一位贾西兰人作为自己的伴侣，也正因为如此，我们才会联系费卢尔泽家族，让凯西与他们的女儿结婚。在凯西公开宣布订婚之后，其他贵族家族也开始纷纷效仿这一做法。能够以自己微小的力量参与到这件事中来，我感到非常荣幸。或许，这种自豪感甚至超过了作为一名军人所感受到的自豪。 你是追随你父亲的脚步，成为这个王国的守护者吗？” 听到这个问题，她自豪地挺起了胸膛：“是的！我是我丈夫的军师，是他军队的统帅。从小我就为这个职位而努力训练，在嫁给埃万德之前，我已经与许多敌人交过战。而在后来的‘狮女巫之战’中，能够保护提克里斯，对我来说是一种荣誉。 跟我说说这件事吧？” “啊，战争在我们国境之外并不出名，这也难怪，”泰西斯说道，试图掩饰自己内心的些许失望，“大约十八年前，一群来自北方苔原的莱奥斯兰野蛮人开始袭击边境的村庄。他们奴役了我们的公民，烧毁了农田，毁坏了连接我们与同胞们的桥梁。有一位女萨满率领着这些侵略者，她的力量远超那些几代以来一直威胁这座城市的敌人——她强大到足以独自消灭所有村庄的民兵组织。阿斯特里达教团召回了它的骑士们去追捕她，但在他们出发之前，有位部落成员投奔了我们，他向我们透露了他族人的动向——他们打算在我家族领地附近的某个偏远山谷里庆祝至日节。因此，我有机会先发制人，在夜幕的掩护下率领王室卫队向北方进发，而那时阿斯特里达的骑士们还正在返回他们的营地呢。" 泰西斯的语气中现在带着一丝兴奋。“虽然路程艰辛，但我对这片土地非常熟悉。我们迅速行进，在女巫和她的盟友们还沉浸在欢乐之中、几乎还没准备好战斗的时候就抓住了他们——他们当初就是以这样的状态袭击了我们的人。即便如此，那女巫依然实力强大！她用雷电摧毁了我们周围的森林，用闪电击碎了我们的盾牌。但尽管如此，我们还是像战鹰一样扑向了她！ 蝾螈将双拳紧握在身前，它的尾巴也亮起了炽烈的光芒。“我的部下们以无与伦比的勇气作战，迫使敌方的战士们纷纷退避，直到我最终与那位狮女巫展开了决斗。那场战斗，成为了我一生中最难忘的经历！她的法杖与我的长矛相撞，她的法术将我的盾牌烧得通黑，直至化为灰烬。我原以为自己终于遇到了对手，然而就在她傲慢自大的那一刻，她露出了释放法术的手掌，正好让我使出致命的诡计——我用战刀刺中了她的手！泰西斯暗自露出了一丝幸灾乐祸的笑容。‘她当时叫得多惨啊！仅仅是一点痛苦，就让那样强大的法师陷入了困境，迫使她不得不逃跑。 是你杀了她吗？” “不，”泰西斯叹息道，“她并不是死在我的手里。她的族人溃败了，他们把受伤的萨满带回了苔原……而她的丈夫在试图将我们分开时，给了我一个致命的伤。不过，我的卫兵已经把那些莱奥斯人驱散了，而当那支战帮被击溃后，那个女巫也就成了阿斯特里达轻易捕捉到的猎物。 [pc.bg soldier hunter barbarian |一个不错的故事……不过你知道，这样的部落文化往往会让怨恨延续数代人。一次耻辱性的失败可能会让他们至今仍心怀怨恨。 |嗯，将整个野蛮人部落都纳入自己的统治范围，这确实是一项了不起的成就。 ] 那些莱奥特兰人后来还给你惹过麻烦吗？” “没有，多亏了女神。我们给了他们一个惨痛的教训，因此我们北边的邻居们在这一代人里都没有再给我们带来麻烦。而这一点，可以说是我第二大的成就。” “那第一大的成就是什么呢？” 泰西斯望了望门口，笑了笑：“你应该能猜到的，我相信。
rows.raw: ' "About me? Surely I am not a suspect!" You shake your head. "I'm just looking for [pc.isCunning |context |a clearer picture ] here." A momentary bristle passes from the Lady Consort's features, and her shoulders relax backwards. "Very well. Of course. I will spare you the obvious pageantry, then." She takes a breath, shaking off the severity of her normal courtly demeanor. "My family are landholders north of the city, on the frontier of Tychris's domain. We are its shield against the barbarians of the tundra. But we were not immune to the decline that has affected so many bloodlines in the principality; Kythie is the last of my line, and I doubt very much that I would be alive if it were not for my father's love for a foreign priestess." "The decline?" Tethys sighs. "An affliction has long gripped Tychris. One of the malingering repercussions of the Godswar, still blighting us centuries after. The bloodlines of our nobility run thinner each year, producing weaker offspring, and fewer of them. I love my husband very much, [pc.name], but go outside and look upon the statue of his ancestor-king who won the holy war alongside Nareva herself; then compare him to Evander. Prince Philandros would have thought Evander to be his smallest daughter at a glance." [pc.bg scholar |You've heard of such things happening in other isolated reaches of the old Empire. Some consider it to be a punishment from the gods for inbreeding. ] She laughs, but there's a fond smile on her face. Tethys crosses her arms beneath her prodigious bosom — there's certainly no thinning of her bloodline to worry about, if that manifests as skinny and frail heirs. "So your father found the cure?" "We believe that foreign blood will reinvigorate the city. That is why Father took a Jassiran to be his partner, and why we have reached out to Felurze to wed Kythie. Other noble families are beginning to follow suit, in the wake of Kythie's public engagement. I am glad to have been a part of this, in my small part. Perhaps even moreso than my pride as a soldier. " "Did you follow your father's footsteps, as a shield of the realm?" That gives a proud chest-puff out of the 'mander. "I did! I am Strategos for my husband, master of his soldiers. I trained for the position since I was a child, I fought against many foes before I married Evander, and it is my honor to have protected Tychris during the Lion Witch's War afterwards." "Tell me about that?" "Ah, I should not be surprised the war's not so famous beyond our borders," Tethys says, trying to mask some amount of disappointment. "About eighteen years ago, a group of leothran barbarians descended from the northern tundra and began raiding the frontier villages. They enslaved our citizens, burned farms, destroyed bridges that connect us to our people. A shamaness lead the pack, much more powerful than any that had threatened the city for generations — strong enough to lay waste to village militias all by herself. The Order Astrida recalled its paladins to hunt her, but before they could march, a tribesman defected to us and told us of his kins' movements, of their plans to celebrate the solstice in an isolated valley near my family's holdings; I was in a position to seize the initiative and thrust north with the princely guard under cover of night while the Astrida were still coming to their camps." There's a certain relish in Tethys's voice now. "A hard march, but I know the land well. We moved with speed, and caught the witch and her allies while they were still hung over from their merry-making, barely ready for battle — the state in which they had once found our people. Even still, the witch was powerful! She shattered the forest around us with thunder and scoured our shields with lightning. Still and all, we fell on her like warhawks!" The salamander's fists clench before her, and her tail blazes bright. "My men fought with unequalled valor, driving the tribe's warriors to route, until I found myself locking blades with the Lion Witch herself. She gave me the greatest battle of my life! Staff and spear clashed, and her spells burnt my shield black, burned it to cinders. I thought I had finally met my match, until in her hubris she left her spellcasting hand exposed, ready for a killing cantrip; I skewered it with my war knife!" Tethys allows herself a momentary, sadistic smirk. "How she howled! A little pain crippled a mage that powerful, forced her to flee." "Did you kill her?" "No," Tethys sighs. "She did not die by my hand. Her kinsmen broke, bearing their wounded shaman back to the tundra... and her thane-husband left me a terrible wound in trying to separate us. Still, the leothrans were scattered by my guard, and the witch proved easy prey for the Astrida to hunt, once the warband was routed." [pc.bg soldier hunter barbarian |A fine story... though you know tribal cultures like that tend to hold grudges for generations. A humiliating defeat might leave them bitter even today. |Well, routing a whole barbarian tribe is certainly an accomplishment. ] "Did those leothrans ever give you trouble again?" "No, thank the goddess. We taught them a painful lesson, and it's bought us a generation of peace from our neighbors in the north. And that remains my second greatest accomplishment." "And what's the first?" Tethys looks at the door and smiles. "You can guess, I'm sure." '

rows.original: "Hm, I am not inclined to gossip about my family, Champion," Tethys says. "But Evander's ancestors have ruled this city for four hundred years, since its initial founding. From Belharan suzerainty, through the Godswar, and now more than two centuries of independence. I should say that have done well by this city, and they are well loved by the people within it." "Tactful as ever," you say, "but I was hoping for something more personal. Tell me about your husband, at least?" You can see a moment of hesitation cross Tethys's face, before her features finally soften. "My dear flame. We have been companions since childhood, him and I. Our fathers were close as brothers, and though I was a woman grown before they finally decided we should be wed, I knew all my life I was to be his shield. His Strategos." The statement makes Tethys swell with pride, all the way to her tail-flame. "Were you in love?" Tethys's smile only deepens. "I couldn't tell you when it began, but yes, I think so. For a long time. There is a deep comfort in being with someone for so long, knowing someone so well. Truly sharing your life with them." Tethys pauses, resting a hand over her heart. "We were both delighted when our parents made the decision." "Were there any other contenders for Evander's hand? Or yours?" "A few," Tethys says. "For Evander's, anyway. I had no serious suitors of my own. But my husband is still a prince, and every prince will have those who wish to bind themselves to his power. Only one was seriously considered from here in Tychris, if your reasoning is what I suspect: Lady Zainem, a sorceress of the court, from a long lineage of magical excellence. She is a good friend to our family, though also one of our harshest critics, whenever our edicts and her philosophy clash. I would hardly suspect her of treachery!" [pc.bg scholar |Lady Zainem... you vaguely recognize the name from your readings back home. She's written a few treatise on the relationship between the health of the body and the mind; that one cannot be a powerful sorcerer while possessing a frail physical form. Very focused on exercise and meditation. ] "So every other suitor was from other cities?" Tethys nods. "Yes, and most have their own husbands now. It's been two decades, [pc.name]. I doubt any of them would feel slighted over a man they hardly knew that long." Fair enough. "Alright. Aside from the three of you, is there anyone else in the royal family?" "We are... a small family, [pc.name]. My injuries from the Lion Witch's War precluded me from having more children than Kythie, and Evander had only one sibling of his own, now passed from illness. We have two nieces, twins, just a year older than Kythie. Marianthe and Nephele. They and their mother chiefly reside in an estate outside the city that the family owns." "Do they get along well with Kythie?" Tethys smiles. "Oh, yes. They all love each other dearly." [pc.bg noblescion minstrel |Be that as it may, those girls would be the heirs to the city if something happened to Kythie. They certainly have something to gain from her insanity... |Then you suppose they're not the most likely suspects. ]
rows.translation: 嗯，冠军，我并不喜欢谈论我的家族，”泰西斯说道，“但埃万德的祖先从这座城市建立之初就开始统治它，至今已经四百年了。从属于贝尔哈兰的统治，经过神战时期，到现在已经有两个多世纪的独立统治。我必须承认，他们的统治对这座城市很有好处，也深受当地人民的爱戴。 你还是那么圆滑得体，”你说，“但我本来希望能听到一些更私人的一些事情。至少，跟我说说你的丈夫吧？” 你可以看到泰西斯脸上闪过一丝犹豫，但很快她的表情又变得柔和起来。“我亲爱的…… 我们从小就是一起长大的伙伴，他和我。我们的父亲情同手足，虽然在我长大成人之后他们才最终决定让我们结婚，但我从一开始就明白，自己一生的使命就是成为他的保护者，他的得力助手。这句话让泰西斯感到无比自豪，这种自豪感甚至蔓延到了她的尾焰上。 你曾经爱过吗？” 泰西斯的笑容更加深了。“我无法确切地说这种感情是从什么时候开始的，但没错，我想我确实爱过。而且持续了很长时间。与某个人共度如此漫长的时光，如此深入地了解对方，真正与他们分享自己的生活，这种感觉真的很令人欣慰。”泰西斯稍作停顿，将手放在心上，“当我们的父母做出这个决定时，我们俩都感到非常高兴。 还有其他人争夺埃万德的手吗？或者争夺你的手的人？” “有几个，”泰西斯回答，“至少是争夺埃万德的手的人。至于我，没有认真的追求者。不过我的丈夫毕竟还是位王子，每个王子身边都会有一些人想要依附于他的权势。如果我的推测没错的话，在提克里斯，真正被认真考虑过的人只有一个人：那就是宫廷女巫扎伊妮姆女士。她出身于一个拥有悠久魔法传承的家族。她是我们家的好朋友，但每当我们的法令与她的理念发生冲突时，她也会成为我们最严厉的批评者之一。我绝对不会怀疑她会背叛我！ [pc.bg scholar |扎伊奈姆女士……这个名字在你在家乡读过的书籍中曾出现过。她写过几篇关于身体健康与精神状态之间关系的论文，认为如果身体状况不佳，就无法成为一名强大的巫师。她非常重视锻炼和冥想。 ] 所以其他追求她的人都是来自其他城市的吗？” 泰西斯点了点头。“是的，而且他们中的大多数现在都已经有了自己的丈夫。毕竟已经过去二十年了 [pc.name]我怀疑他们中的任何人，都不会因为一个他们才认识不久的男人而感到被冒犯。” 有道理。“好吧。除了你们三个人之外，王室里还有其他人吗？” “我们……是一个小家庭。 [pc.name]在‘狮女之战’中受的伤让我无法再生育其他孩子，而埃文德也只有一个兄弟姐妹，不过他已经因病去世了。我们有两个侄女，是一对双胞胎，她们比凯西大一岁，名叫玛丽安特和内菲尔。她们和她们的母亲主要住在家里在城外拥有的一处庄园里。” “她们和凯西相处得很好吗？” 泰西斯微笑着回答：“哦，当然。她们彼此都非常喜欢。 [pc.bg noblescion minstrel |尽管如此，如果凯西出了什么事，那些女孩就会成为这座城市的继承人。他们肯定能从她的疯狂行为中得到一些好处…… |那么你认为他们应该不是最有可能的嫌疑人吧。 ]

rows.original: The question makes Tethys visibly uncomfortable. Her tail dims, and she looks to the floor. "I should have noticed it sooner, [pc.name]. But Kythie's at that age where, well, the heart begins to yearn in ways it hadn't before..." Tethys sighs heavily, voice dropping quiet. "We just thought she was learning things about herself, you must understand. We were upset, but-" "Slow down, slow down. What happened?" Tethys scratches at her arm scales. "I planted the aurum wreathe on my daughter's head at the Tycathalon this year, [pc.name], won through her hard work, not her bloodline. A high honor for us both. Something she could boast about the rest of her life. What she should not have done is grab hold of the runner-up and kiss on her on the stage in front of the entire city." That could certainly cause a kerfuffle, yes. "The worst part is, the city cheered for it! They loved seeing their future ruler letting loose. If only they knew!" Tethys groans, rubbing her temples. "The woman in question gave Kythie a piece of her mind, as did her parents, behind the scenes. That seemed to be that. A few days later, a blizzard rolled through and trapped us all indoors... and then we had one of our most trusted maidservants begging a private audience to report Kythie attempting to seduce her." "Twice so quickly... did you think something was amiss?" "Not amiss, per se," Tethys says awkwardly. "We punished her for her behavior, of course. Unwanted advances are beneath a princess of the realm. But in truth, Evander and I were preparing for a more serious talk about her future. We didn't attribute her behavior to external factors yet." You quirk a brow. "Talk about what?" Tethys shifts her weight and glances at the door. "That perhaps she would struggle in her marriage commitments to the prince of Felurze, if it was two women she was pressing herself upon in these moments of vulnerability." "Ah." "But, of course, our fears were misplaced. We restricted Kythie to her chambers, only for her to fall upon one of the guards soon after. She's strong, [pc.name]. Strong enough to hurt a grown man trained for combat. But she is also a gentle soul. That is when we knew something was truly amiss." No kidding. "And she's been in this tower ever since, huh?" "With one reprieve. When the Order Astrida first unbound the curse..."
rows.translation: 这个问题让泰西斯明显感到不安。她的尾巴颜色暗了下来，她把目光投向了地面。“我本应该早点注意到的 [pc.name]但是凯西现在正处于那个阶段，嗯，她的心开始以一种前所未有的方式渴望着某些东西……”泰西斯沉重地叹了口气，声音渐渐低了下去，“我们只是以为她在了解关于自己的一些事情，你一定要理解。我们当时确实很担心，但是——” “慢点，慢慢说。到底发生了什么？” 泰西斯挠了挠自己手臂上的鳞片，“今年在提卡塔隆节上，我在女儿的头上戴上了金色的花环 [pc.name]这一荣誉是她通过自己的努力获得的，而不是凭借她的出身。这对我们双方来说都是一件非常光荣的事情。这也是她可以终生引以为傲的成就。她确实应该如此。不是他们所做的就是抓住那位亚军，在整个城市的注视下，在舞台上亲了她一下。” 这确实可能会引起一阵骚动，没错。 “最糟糕的是，全城的市民都为这一幕欢呼！他们很高兴看到自己未来的统治者如此放纵自己。要是他们知道该多好啊！”泰西斯呻吟着，揉着太阳穴。“那个女人当面严厉地批评了凯西，她的父母也在背后责备了她。事情似乎就这样结束了。然而几天后，一场暴风雪来袭，把我们都困在了室内。然后，我们有一位最值得信赖的女仆请求单独会面，报告说凯西试图引诱她。” “这么快就发生了两次……你是不是觉得有些不对劲？” “严格来说，并没有什么不对劲，”泰西斯有些尴尬地回答道。我们当然因为她的行为而惩罚了她。这种不必要的冒犯行为，根本不配一个王国的公主做出。但实际上，埃文德和我原本打算就她的未来进行一次更严肃的谈话。我们当时还没有将她的行为归因于外部因素。你挑了挑眉毛：“说什么？” 泰西斯挪了挪身子，瞥了一眼门：“也许她在履行婚姻责任时会遇到困难王子关于费卢尔泽的事情……在那些脆弱的时刻，她其实是靠两个人来支撑自己的。” “啊。” “不过，当然了，我们的担忧完全是多余的。我们把凯西关在她的房间里，结果她不久之后还是遇到了其中一名守卫。她其实很坚强 [pc.name]这种力量足以伤害一个受过战斗训练的成年男子。但她也拥有一颗温柔的心。那个就在那时，我们意识到真的出了什么问题。” “说真的……从那以后，她就一直待在这座塔里，对吧？” “只有一次例外。当阿斯特里达教团第一次解除了那个诅咒的时候……
rows.raw: ' The question makes Tethys visibly uncomfortable. Her tail dims, and she looks to the floor. "I should have noticed it sooner, [pc.name]. But Kythie's at that age where, well, the heart begins to yearn in ways it hadn't before..." Tethys sighs heavily, voice dropping quiet. "We just thought she was learning things about herself, you must understand. We were upset, but-" "Slow down, slow down. What happened?" Tethys scratches at her arm scales. "I planted the aurum wreathe on my daughter's head at the Tycathalon this year, [pc.name], won through her hard work, not her bloodline. A high honor for us both. Something she could boast about the rest of her life. What she should not have done is grab hold of the runner-up and kiss on her on the stage in front of the entire city." That could certainly cause a kerfuffle, yes. "The worst part is, the city cheered for it! They loved seeing their future ruler letting loose. If only they knew!" Tethys groans, rubbing her temples. "The woman in question gave Kythie a piece of her mind, as did her parents, behind the scenes. That seemed to be that. A few days later, a blizzard rolled through and trapped us all indoors... and then we had one of our most trusted maidservants begging a private audience to report Kythie attempting to seduce her." "Twice so quickly... did you think something was amiss?" "Not amiss, per se," Tethys says awkwardly. "We punished her for her behavior, of course. Unwanted advances are beneath a princess of the realm. But in truth, Evander and I were preparing for a more serious talk about her future. We didn't attribute her behavior to external factors yet." You quirk a brow. "Talk about what?" Tethys shifts her weight and glances at the door. "That perhaps she would struggle in her marriage commitments to the prince of Felurze, if it was two women she was pressing herself upon in these moments of vulnerability." "Ah." "But, of course, our fears were misplaced. We restricted Kythie to her chambers, only for her to fall upon one of the guards soon after. She's strong, [pc.name]. Strong enough to hurt a grown man trained for combat. But she is also a gentle soul. That is when we knew something was truly amiss." No kidding. "And she's been in this tower ever since, huh?" "With one reprieve. When the Order Astrida first unbound the curse..." '

rows.original: "Tychris bears the honor of hosting Nareva's grandest temple north of the Holy City itself," Tethys says bitterly, "but they have only offered false hope, when they offered any at all! I-" Tethys cuts herself short, balling her fists. For a moment you worry that she'll be the one striking the door, but a heartbeat passes, and she merely rests her palm against the wood. "I apologize," Tethys finally says. "But I have grown more than frustrated with our divine patrons. Each and every day since the curse began, we have prayed to the goddess for relief, and we petition her servants just as frequently. This is the center of Nareva's worship in the North, the heart and soul of the goddess of magic's dominion over our people, and yet..." "Has Tychris always been the center of her worship here?" you ask, trying to steer the conversation away before Tethys loses her grip entirely. [pc.bg acolyte |And before Tethys commits a little too much heresy for her guards to ignore. ] Indeed, she takes another deep, centering breath, and nods. "Since the Godswar. Once, it is said, she kept her home in the Sailgraves — Estelore, perhaps; that old Belharan coven of madmen sprung up around her. But when the world was on the brink of ending, the goddess chosen our city to make her stand at. We were her last bastion in this part of the world, and her compact with us was for her protection everlasting." "But her priests haven't been able to help..." Tethys sighs deeply. "They have tried, goddess bless them. Two of the Order Astrida, including the Order's leader herself, came to our aid... but they failed. Each time, Kythie's curse has returned in mere days. Now they refuse to meet me at all! Every message is returned with platitudes that they are investigating, telling me that in time they will succeed." She clenches her fists. "These childless monks will never understand how I cannot." It might be worth investigating the temple to see why they've been so unhelpful.
rows.translation: 提克里斯有幸成为娜瑞瓦在圣城以北地区最宏伟的神庙的守护者，”泰西斯苦涩地说道，“但他们所提供的，只不过是虚假的希望罢了——如果他们真有什么诚意的话！我……”泰西斯突然停住了话，双手紧握成拳。有那么一瞬间，你甚至担心她会失控她我会去敲门，”她说道，但片刻之后，她只是将手掌轻轻放在门上。 “我很抱歉，”泰西斯终于开口说道，“但我对我们那些神圣的庇护者感到无比失望。自从诅咒开始以来，每一天我们都在向女神祈祷，请求她解除这个诅咒，同时也经常向她的仆从们求助。这里是北方地区人们崇拜娜瑞瓦的中心，也是这位魔法女神统治我们人民的象征与灵魂所在……然而…… “那么，提克里斯一直以来都是这里人们崇拜的对象吗？”你问道，试图在泰西斯彻底失去控制之前转移话题。 [pc.bg acolyte |而在泰西斯犯下那些连她的守卫们都无法忽视的“异端行为”之前…… ] 的确，她又深吸一口气，让自己平静下来，然后点了点头。“从神战开始之后。据说，有一段时间她住在赛尔格雷夫斯地区——也许是埃斯托洛尔吧；那时，那些由疯子们组成的贝尔哈兰教团开始围绕在她身边。但是当世界即将走向毁灭的时候，那位被选中的女神我们的这座城市是她最后的依靠。在我们这个地区，我们是她最后的屏障，而她与我们签订的契约，正是为了获得永恒的保护。” “但是她的祭司们却无能为力……” 泰西斯深深地叹了口气。他们已经尽力了，愿女神保佑他们。包括组织领袖在内的两名‘阿斯特拉达组织’成员前来帮助我们……但他们失败了。每次，凯西的诅咒都在短短几天内再次降临。现在，他们根本拒绝见我！每条回复都只是些敷衍之词，说他们正在调查中，还告诉我只要再等等，他们就会成功。“她紧握着双拳，继续说道：‘这些没有孩子的僧侣永远也不会理解，为什么我无法做到。 或许值得去调查一下那座寺庙，弄清楚为什么它们一直如此毫无帮助。

rows.original: "Our palace isn't a fortress, but it is well guarded," Tethys says firmly. "I have trained our armsmen myself, and they are supplied by the best smiths in the North, supported by the most well-educated magicians a city could ever supply, here in the shadow of Nareva's own temple." [pc.bgMulti soldier slumrat |You've heard plenty of nobles say something similar, and get robbed blind all the same. |A fine boast, but well-armed soldiers aren't a deterrent to those skilled enough to slip their notice in the first place. |Fine, fine. ] "So there's no chance anyone had access to Kythie without you knowing?" "Of course not. Our daughter is our pride and joy, and the hope of a nation. No one in Tychris is better protected than Kythie." "And the palace itself? Who controls who comes and goes?" Tethys begins to bristle under the questioning now. "Captain Tyna, of course. She manages the day to day of guarding our persons, the treasury, and the grounds." "From the entire complex?" you ask. "Even the temple? You share your outer walls with it." "... A number of people are permitted in the walls each day, yes, but each is accounted for by night's end. In all my years we have never found temple supplicants meandering the grounds past nightfall. Come now." She's never found any. [pc.cl thief |Despite her insistences, it seems to you like Tychris Palace would be pretty easy to sneak around in. The grounds are open, the palace itself is sprawling and blessed with so, so many windows... it would be child's play to break into if you could sneak past the guards. Or if you had a proper disguise... ]
rows.translation: 我们的宫殿虽然不是堡垒，但防守措施十分严密，”泰西斯坚定地说道，“这些卫兵都是我亲自训练的，他们配备了北方最优秀的铁匠制造的武器，同时还得到了这座城市里最有学识的魔法师们的支持——这一切，都发生在娜瑞瓦神庙的庇护之下。 [pc.bgMulti soldier slumrat |你肯定听过很多贵族说类似的话，但最终还是被抢得一干二净。 |说得挺响亮的，不过装备精良的士兵对于那些手段高明、能够悄无声息地完成行动的人来说，根本构不成任何阻碍。. |好吧，好吧。 ] 所以，绝对不可能有人在你不知情的情况下接触到凯西吧？” “当然不可能。我们的女儿是我们引以为傲的人，也是整个国家的希望。在提克里斯，没有谁比凯西受到更严密的保护。” “那么宫殿本身呢？谁来决定谁可以进出这里？” 听到这个问题，泰西斯开始感到不悦了。“当然是泰娜船长了。她负责管理我们的人身安全、财宝以及整个基地的日常事务。” “整个基地的事务都由她来负责吗？你问得倒好……就连那座寺庙也不例外？它的外墙其实与我们共享的。” “……每天确实有很多人被允许进入那片区域，但到了晚上，所有人都必须被清点确认。这些年来，我们从未发现有任何寺庙的信徒在日落后还在这片地方游荡。快来吧。” 她从来都没有创建任何。 [pc.cl thief |尽管她一再坚持，但在你看来在提克里斯宫殿里，偷偷行动其实相当容易。场地已经开放，宫殿本身规模庞大，而且拥有无数窗户……如果你能悄悄绕过守卫，或者有合适的伪装，那么闯入宫殿简直易如反掌。 ]

rows.original: "Few with power," Tethys says. "We have battled barbarians on and off for generations since the Godswar. Monsters of all kinds, too. But since the Lion Witch's War, we have enjoyed a generation of peace." She pauses, considering. "Although, we must admit, we are not well loved by all out neighbors." Now you're getting somewhere. "Khor'minos, Felurze, Rosetree, even little Hawkethorne... we have good relations with them all. But the new Count of Maidenbridge has been a difficult pill to swallow, and his early reign was tense. If the River Maiden hadn't been flooded at the time, we might have marched to war against him." Oh, this is good. "Why? What did he do?" "Killed the previous count," she says glumly. "Thore was a bandit king, a self-made warlord commanding a band of mercenaries, outlaws, and exiles from across the northern Heartlands. They acted as sellswords to the count, and then turned on him. Burned half the city and killed its rulers without mercy. By the time we'd heard what had happened, that warlord had proclaimed himself the new count! We were allies with Maidenbridge, and overnight they were taken from us!" "But you never did go to war?" Tethys shakes her head. "Evander forbade it, against my counsel. The damage was done, he reasoned, and the best thing we could do for the people of Maidenbridge was to keep the peace, give them the opportunity to rebuild. Still, I marched our soldiers to the border to make sure that his rebellion did not spread. There were skirmishes. Several of the brigands were put to the sword before the we came to terms. But, against all odds, peace did reign. Count Thore proved to be a-" Tethys pauses, frowning, "a capable ruler, not disposed to cruelty towards his subjects. Still, our relationship has remained rocky, and Thore has not shied from showing his frustration in our communiques. More than once I have thought ill tidings that befall the city might have his duplicitous hand behind them, but this would be a new low." Barbarians and a neighboring warlord, all of whom might hold some kind of a grudge...
rows.translation: 掌握权力的人并不多，”泰西斯说道，“自神战以来，我们已经与野蛮人进行了数代人的斗争，也遭遇过各种各样的怪物。但自从狮女巫之战之后，我们终于享受了一代人的和平。” 她停顿了一下，似乎在思考着什么。“不过，我们必须承认，我们并没有受到太多人的喜爱所有我们的邻国们……” 现在你终于说到点子上了。 “科尔米诺斯、费卢尔泽、罗塞特里，甚至小小的鹰棘镇……我们与他们所有人都有着良好的关系。但是，新的梅登布里奇伯爵实在让人难以接受，他在位初期带来的紧张局势令人担忧。如果当时梅登河没有发生洪水，我们或许早就对他发动战争了。 哦，这可真糟糕。‘为什么？他做了什么？’” “他杀了之前的伯爵，”她沮丧地说道，“托雷原本是个土匪头目，一个白手起家的军阀，他率领着一群雇佣兵、逃犯以及来自北方腹地的流亡者。他们原本为那位伯爵效力，后来却背叛了他——他们烧毁了半个城市，残忍地杀死了当地的统治者。等我们得知这些事情时，那个军阀已经宣布自己成为了新的伯爵！我们原本与梅登布里奇是盟友，然而一夜之间，他们就被夺走了！ 但是你从来没有真正参加过战争，对吧？” 泰西斯摇了摇头。“埃文德禁止我这么做，尽管我并不认同他的看法。他认为，伤害已经造成了，对我们梅登布里奇的人们来说，最好的做法就是保持和平，给他们重新建设的机会。尽管如此，我还是率领我们的军队前往边境，以确保他的叛乱不会蔓延。期间发生了一些小规模冲突，有几名叛乱者在我们达成协议之前就被处决了。然而，尽管困难重重，最终还是恢复了和平。索尔伯爵被证明是一位……泰西斯皱着眉头停顿了一下，“一位有能力的统治者，他并不倾向于对自己的子民施以残酷对待。然而，我们的关系一直很紧张，索尔也在我们的通信中毫不掩饰自己的不满。我不止一次怀疑，这座城市所遭遇的那些不幸事件，或许都与他的阴险狡诈有关，但这次的行为实在已经达到了新的低点。 那些野蛮人以及邻近的军阀们，他们或许都怀有某种怨恨……

rows.original: "You may not see it here, today, Champion, but Tychris is prospering. We are known throughout the world for our glassworks and the skill of our mages, and both bring us wealth and prestige. Our farmlands have had good years, enough to stock the granaries, and trade has continued apace from our neighbors. I struggle to imagine anyone in the city feels betrayed by our rule; certainly not enough to target their future princeps." [pc.bg slumrat courtesan minstrel |An easy analysis from the ivory tower, but you wonder if that's actually true. |Fair enough. ] "So you've had no troubles recently?" "Every city has its troubles!" Tethys says. "We've had some disagreements with the millers' association of late — it's becoming more expensive to import good wood from Hawkethorne, and the millers wish to pass the costs on to our people. The tavernkeepers and farmers alike have turned the court into a gallery for their brawl with the millers." She sighs with frustration. "We've had a series of small bandit raids from beastkin in the mountains, but nothing that our soldiers have not been equal to. The late summer brought flooding into the farmlands, and we are still dealing with the aftermath of that, both the beastkin raids and upset landholders. Which has lead to millers needing more wood to repair the mills after the floods, and... you get the point, I hope. Our squabbles are those of any city." "So aside from the royal family, who're the movers and shakers here?" "The temple, of course, exerts great influence over Tychris. We are Nareva's stronghold, and her worship is paramount among our people. Past that, a number of rural barons control the surrounding countryside — my own father was among them. Today Ruarc en Rhydan is the loudest voice among the county barons, and now the wealthiest. He himself won the argent wreathe in weight lifting, which has furthered his fame quite a bit. Beneath them are the farmers that support the city. The rural commons have flexed greater power these last years, with their growing prosperity; good rain has brought good harvests for a decade, and for the first time in our history we've begun exporting food. Coin flows in from city-states to our south while gems and furs come the northern tundra."
