Athletes from around the region, even across the world, come to earn glory beneath the Temple of Nareva. And it brings travelers from all over to watch, too: merchants, craftsmen, nobles, sorcerers... and all their wealth. For two weeks the city is flooded with double its regular population, there's a celebration that never ends from dusk until dawn — and grand exhibitions of magical prowess in the temple. Even the magicians feel the need to flex their muscles during the Tycathalon." A great big gathering of wealthy and powerful people, right before Kythie caught her curse. The timing can't be a coincidence. "Was there anyone particularly noteworthy in attendance?" "Lady Anthiese of Altenspire, a famous sorceress of Altenspire, and her daughter Therese. Certainly the most notable to us, considering Therese won the argent wreathe after Kythie, and then suffered the first outburst of the curse in front of the whole city. Even if she had not, Therese is one of the rare salamanders born with horns — an eye-turning young lady if ever there was one. She made quite the splash. Even with Kythie, it seems..." Tethys clears her throat. "We also had the honor to host Baron Asher of Felurze, uncle to Kythie's betrothed; Aric Ignafaerus of Khor'minos, the famous javelin thrower who was too drunk to hit his targets this year; Halua of Khor'hofra, high priestess of Lumia; Ser Tristan and Dame Faunra, crusaders all the way from the Dukedom of Claremont who took the aurum wreathe in charioteering; Tajana the Lynx, an archmage illusionist from Callathia; Robert Kalter, an alchemist from Barania who won argent in wrestling... ah, and of course, Countess Arielle of Taelia, one of the many prospective heirs to the Alliance. Though rather than leading in the competition, she was leading most of the drunken revelry throughout the city..." You get it, you get it. "Anybody who'd have reason to want to upset the balance here in Tychris?" "If I could think of any, [pc.name], they'd have been in chains before you arrived." Tethys rests her hands on her hips. "My list of suspects is perilously thin. No one has reason to hurt Kythie of all people! There's a list a league long of worthies who should be courting her favor, but cursing her? I cannot think of why! We have maintained peace and stability for a generation in our domain. To strike at the crown would be to upset all that we have accomplished, and for what? Chaos?" You can certainly think of at least one group back east that would love to spread chaos out here...
rows.translation: 冠军，今天你可能在这里看不到，但提克里斯正在蓬勃发展。我们的玻璃制造业和法师们的精湛技艺让我们闻名于世，这两者都为我们带来了财富与声望。我们的农田也取得了良好的收成，储备了充足的粮食，而与邻国的贸易也持续保持着稳定的发展势头。我实在无法想象这座城市里会有人对我们的统治感到不满；更不可能有人会因此而企图推翻未来的王子。 [pc.bg slumrat courtesan minstrel |从象牙塔里出发，这种分析固然简单易懂，但人们不禁会怀疑：这究竟是不是事实呢？ |有道理。 ] 所以你最近没有遇到什么麻烦吧？” “每个城市都会遇到一些麻烦！”泰西斯说道，“最近我们和磨坊主协会发生了一些争执——从鹰棘镇进口优质木材的成本越来越高，而那些磨坊主们想把这些成本转嫁给我们的人们。酒馆老板和农民们把这片空地当成了他们与磨坊主们斗殴的场所。“她沮丧地叹了口气，“最近山上的一些兽人小股匪徒不断来袭击我们，但我们的士兵完全有能力应对他们。夏末时节，洪水侵袭了农田，我们至今仍在应对这场灾害带来的后果——既有兽人的袭击，也有土地所有者因此而产生的不满。这些情况导致磨坊主们需要更多的木材来修复被洪水破坏的磨坊。我希望你明白我的意思。我们的争吵其实和其他城市里的争吵没什么两样。” “那么，除了王室之外，这里还有哪些真正有影响力的人物或组织呢？” “当然是寺庙了。它在提克里斯拥有巨大的影响力。我们是娜瑞瓦的据点，而人们对她的崇拜在我们这里也是极其重要的。除此之外，还有许多乡绅控制着周边的乡村地区——我的父亲就是其中之一。如今鲁阿尔克·恩·瑞丹是这些郡级男爵中声音最响亮的一个。而他如今已成为最富有的人。他自己还在举重比赛中赢得了银质奖章，这一成就使他的名声更加显赫。在他们之下，是那些支撑着这座城市的农民。近年来，随着农民们日益富裕，他们的力量也变得更强大了；十年来，良好的降雨带来了丰富的收成，我们历史上第一次开始出口食品。南方的城邦向我们输送货币，而北方的苔原地区则送来了宝石和毛皮。 所以教会和那些拥有大量土地的贵族们都在宫廷之外发挥着影响力……而后者更是让提克里斯的财富逐年增加。“那么提卡塔隆事件又是怎么回事呢？”你可能会问，“它对这里的情况产生了什么影响？这是我们每四年要承担的最大一笔开支，”泰西斯略带自豪地说，“但这一切都是值得的。来自整个地区，甚至来自世界各地的运动员都会来到娜瑞瓦神庙下争夺荣耀。同时，也有许多来自各地的游客会前来观看这场盛会：商人们、工匠们、贵族们、法师们……以及他们所有的财富。整整两周的时间里，这座城市里的人口数量会增加到平时的两倍，庆祝活动会从黄昏持续到黎明，从未间断——同时，寺庙里还会举办各种展示魔法技艺的盛大表演。就连那些魔法师们，在这个泰卡塔隆节期间也觉得有必要展示一下自己的本领。" 就在凯西遭到诅咒之前，正好举行了一场聚集了许多富人和权贵们的盛大聚会。这样的时间安排绝非巧合。“在出席的人当中，有没有特别值得注意的人物呢？” “有，那就是阿尔滕斯派的安西丝女士——阿尔滕斯派著名的女巫，以及她的女儿特蕾莎。她们无疑是这场聚会中最引人注目的人物。我们考虑到特蕾莎在凯西之后获得了银色花环，而且还在全城人的注视下首次遭遇了诅咒的发作……即便没有这些经历，特蕾莎也算是那些天生就长着角的稀有蝾螈之一了——她确实是一位令人瞩目的年轻女士。她引起了不小的轰动。就连和凯西在一起的时候，似乎也是如此……” 泰西斯清了清嗓子，继续说道：“我们还有幸邀请到了费卢尔泽的Asher男爵，他是凯西未婚夫的叔叔；还有Khor’minos的Aric Ignafaerus，那位著名的标枪投掷手部，不过今年他喝得酩酊大醉，连目标都投不中；还有Khor’hofra的Halua，她是卢米娅的大祭司；还有来自Claremont公国的Ser Tristan和Dame Faunra，他们是通过马车比赛赢得银质奖牌的十字军战士；还有来自Callathia的Tajana the Lynx，她是一位擅长幻术的大法师；还有来自巴拉尼亚的长袍rt Kalter，他通过摔跤比赛赢得了银质奖牌。啊，当然还有泰莉亚的艾莉尔伯爵夫人，她也是其中的一位。很多联盟的潜在继承人们。不过，她在整个城市里参与的那些醉酒狂欢活动，反而让这场竞争陷入了混乱…… 你懂我的意思吧，“在提克里斯，究竟有没有人会想要打破这里的平衡呢？” “如果我能想到这样的人的话，[pc.name]要是你在之前赶到，他们早就被锁在链子里了。”泰西斯双手部叉腰说道，“我的嫌疑人名单短得可怜——毕竟没人会有理由伤害凯西啊！应该有一大堆值得尊敬的人争相讨好她才对，但谁会诅咒她呢？我想不通为什么！在我们的领地，我们已经维持了整整一代人的和平与稳定。如果攻击王室，那就意味着会破坏我们一直以来所取得的一切成果，而这一切，又是为了什么？只是为了制造混乱吗？ 你肯定能想到，在东边，肯定有某个势力非常乐意在这里制造混乱。..

rows.original: You can see the way this is pushing Tethys to her limits, just the same as Kythie herself, and something about seeing a mother in distress — even one that looks big enough to smother you with her body — sends a pang through your heart. You take a step closer and rest a hand on Tethys's shoulder. "It's going to be alright," you tell her. "I will find a way to help your daughter. I promise. So just hold it together a little while longer." "I-" the noblewoman's voice catches in her throat, and she winces back from you — though not enough to brush your hand off completely. [pc.isCunning |Not used to such forwardness, is she? ]"Th-thank you, Champion. I am trying." She says that with such heaviness, you can feel her shrink a little in front of you. "You [pc.hasKids |have children of your own?" You nod. "I pray you never suffer anything like this. Watching your child suffer is an acute horror, and being impotent to help her is... it feels as though I am suffocating. Drowning. I fear you are my only way out. So, one parent to another: please, in the goddess's name, do whatever you must to help her." |don't have children of your own, do you?" You shake your head. "No." "Then you will not understand, not truly. How can you? A child rewrites your life, your very soul. And now I must watch mine suffer, impotent to help her. I feel so completely helpless here, as though I'm drowning in despair." ] "You called me," you assure her. "You took a risk for her, and I'll make sure it pays off. I swear it." Thethys finally relaxes, at least a little bit. "Thank you, Champion. You are right. Even still, one wonders how the world might be different, if I had pursued the path of a priest or sorceress rather than the blade and shield. Could I have found her cure myself, without resorting to such... such debasing means?" "Is this really so bad?" you ask. "Sex is as natural a cure as it gets." The [silly |milfmander |salamander matron ] sighs. "Not like this. Sex is meant to be between lovers, not a... a fleeting dalliance, and certainly not between strangers. If you had courted my daughter, perhaps things would be different, but there is something deeply humiliating about surrendering her to a foreigner who'd never set foot in our lands. Yet that is what makes you perfect to be her savior. Ironic, isn't it?" She's got a very romanticized view of sex, for such a beautiful woman. "I don't want to humiliate you or Kythie, Tethys." "I know," she says. "And yet... I feel as though I've done you as much a dishonor as my daughter. Even if you have a more... libertine view of things than I." The look she gives you seems genuinely regretful, despite how [pc.isDK |ridiculous |outlandish ] the situation is. You squeeze her shoulder a bit tighter. "It'll be alright." "I... thank you." Tethys crosses her arms and glances towards the door.
rows.translation: 你能看出这件事正把泰西斯逼到极限，就像凯西本人一样；而看到一位母亲如此痛苦——哪怕这位母亲看起来壮得能用身体把你闷死——还是让你心头一酸。你走近一步，把手搭在泰西斯的肩上。“会好起来的，”你告诉她。“我一定会找到办法帮你女儿。我保证。所以，再多撑一会儿。” “我——”这位贵妇的声音卡在喉咙里，她从你身边畏缩了一下——但还没到把你的手完全甩开的地步。[pc.isCunning |她还不习惯有人这么冒失吧？ ]“谢、谢谢你，冠军。我正在努力。” 她说这话时语气沉重得让你能感觉到她当着你的面缩小了一圈。“你[pc.hasKids |有自己的孩子吗？” 你点了点头。 “我祈祷你永远不必遭受这种事。看着自己的孩子受苦是一种尖锐的恐怖，而无力帮她……那感觉就像我在窒息，在下沉。我怕你是我唯一的出路。所以，为人父母者对为人父母者：求你了，看在女神的名分上，无论必须做什么，都请帮帮她。” |没有自己的孩子，对吧？” 你摇了摇头。“没有。” “那你就不会明白，永远不会真正明白。你怎么可能明白呢？孩子会改写你的人生，你的灵魂本身。而现在我只能看着我的孩子受苦，却无力帮她。我在这里感到彻底的绝望无助，仿佛正溺死在绝望里。” ] “是你叫来了我，”你向她保证。“你为她冒了风险，我保证这风险不会白费。我发誓。” 泰西斯终于放松下来，至少松了一点。“谢谢你，冠军。你说得对。可即便如此，人还是会想：如果我当年走的是祭司或女巫的路，而不是刀剑与盾牌，这世界会不会不一样。我是不是就能自己找到治好她的办法，而不必诉诸这种……这种自贬身份的手段？” “这事真有那么糟吗？”你问。“性已经是最天经地义的疗法了。” 这位[silly |蝾螈熟母 |蝾螈主母 ]叹了口气。“不该是这样的。性应当是爱人之间的事，而不是……一段露水姻缘，更不该发生在陌生人之间。如果你曾追求过我女儿，也许情况会不一样，可把她交给一个从未踏足我们国土的外乡人，实在有某种深切的羞辱感。然而正是这一点让你成了拯救她的最佳人选。很讽刺，不是吗？” 这么美丽的女人，对性的看法倒是浪漫得过了头。“我不想羞辱你，或者凯西，泰西斯。” “我知道，”她说。“可还是……我觉得自己对你和我女儿一样失了礼数。即便你对事情的看法比我更……放荡不羁。” 她给你的眼神里满是真切的悔意，尽管[pc.isDK |荒唐 |离奇 ]这场面再怎么离谱也一样。你把她的肩膀握得更紧了些。“会好起来的。” “我……谢谢你。” 泰西斯抱起双臂，朝门口瞥了一眼。

[flags.P_DILEMMA_CAIT_VISIT
        |"Can we talk to Kythie?" you ask, looking between Cait and Tethys.
        
        "They can!" the princess says from inside her cell. "I'm good for it." 
        
        Tethys gives you and your priestess a weary smile before unbarring the door. "You have your answer then, Champion."
        
        "We're coming in," Cait says gently. "Both of us." 
        
        Kythie's sitting on the bed's edge when you step in, and tries not to wince when the door's bar slides back into place. "Hey, Cait. [pc.name]. How's your investigation going?"
        
        "It's going," you assure her. "How are you feeling?"
        
        She sighs. "I'm okay as I can be. Cait's been a big help." Kythie's tail curls around the cleric's leg, pulling her into princess's lap. "But I feel like I'm going a little crazy in here! I haven't been outside in... in who knows how long. I miss the sun!"
        
        Cait rubs the 'mander's shoulders. "We'll find a fix, sweet thing. Trust [pc.name]. I know I do."
        
        Kythie gives you a hopeful look.
        |You exchange a look with Cait. "I think we're ready to talk to the princess." 
        
        Tethys nods. "She's been more calm, thanks to Sister Caitriss's efforts. I think she's in a state of mind to entertain visitors."
        
        "I am!" a voice says through the door. "I'm okay. Well, okay enough to talk. You can send them in."
        
        You give Tethys a nod, and the lady-consort unbars the door.

It wasn't until a couple days after the storm passed that anybody really noticed I was behaving strangely. Even me! rows.translation: 起初，这种变化很微妙。我记得是在提卡塔隆比赛之后，我才第一次注意到有些事情正在发生变化——那是我们每年秋天举办的盛大体育赛事，来自全国各地的人们都会前来参赛！那是我第二次参加这项比赛，但我竟然在铁饼项目中赢得了金质奖环！公主感到无比自豪，她的尾焰如同北极光般闪耀。”当妈妈把那枚徽章戴在我的额头上时，我简直欣喜若狂，我……简直被这种感觉冲昏了头脑，感觉我的心都快要燃烧起来了。” 凯西的耳朵微微一动：“当时我也不知道自己是怎么做的——嗯，现在想来，我大概知道原因了——但我没多想，就抓住了那个赢得银质徽章的女孩，在领奖台上亲了她一下。她的脸颊涨红了。尽管她这样，所有人还是鼓起了掌来。不是开心极了。他们怎么可能知道呢，对吧？“爸爸因此训了我一顿，但也就仅此而已。大家都以为我只是太兴奋了。说实话，我当时确实也是这么觉得的。 [var0 |另一个女孩，她后来怎么样了？”凯特问道。 “在台上时没什么事情发生，但当我们所有人都离开人群的视线后，她用头撞了我。”凯西努力笑了笑，“她来自……嗯，应该是阿尔滕斯派尔吧？对，她在那里算是挺有地位的，因为她天生就长着角。对于一个‘曼德尔’来说，这种情况相当罕见。她专程赶来参加比赛，结果仅仅差了一英寸半就输给了我，她当时肯定气坏了。后来我发现，她根本不怕使用那些头槌啊！我的脑袋上还淤青了一周呢。 ] 那么接下来发生了什么？”你问道。 “一开始什么也没发生。几天后，一场大暴风雪来了，所有没有离开城镇的人几乎都被困在了家里。然后——” “大暴风雪？” “没错！那场暴风雪简直太可怕了。我从来没见过在一年这么早的时候会出现这么猛烈的风暴，它让所有人都措手不及。 [var0 |你与凯特对视了一眼。那一刻，一定让人回想起你们两人初次相遇的那一天，也就是卡拉被绑架的那一刻。 |那应该就是你在那个晚上遇到凯特、也就是卡拉被绑架的那个晚上发生的事情吧。 ] 这到底是在提卡萨隆事件发生后的多久？” 凯西皱起了眉头：“我想是五天吧？ [pc.isCunning |如果邪教组织牵涉其中的话，从这里回到鹰棘镇完全有足够的时间。 ] 在暴风雨期间，有什么变化吗？” “是的，”凯西说。她 [kythie.lowLibido |她喉咙里发出尴尬的声音，然后把耳朵耷拉了下来。 |她咬着嘴唇，脸上带着一丝淫荡的笑容。 ]我得说，那段时间我几乎一直把自己关在房间里，沉浸在自己的思绪中。我一直在想着那个我吻过的姑娘，我的未婚妻，还有寺庙里那个胖乎乎的‘女妖’，还有那位在仪式上挺起胸膛主持仪式的肌肉发达的祭司 [silly |真正的堕落时光 |仅仅一周的时间，就陷入了堕落的境地…… ] 就在其他所有人都被锦标赛的余波所吸引、无暇他顾的时候，直到风暴过去几天后，才有人真正注意到我的行为有些异常。就连我自己也沒有察觉！我当时想……嗯，我听说过很多参加泰卡塔隆锦标赛的运动员在比赛结束后都会表现出一些异常行为。也许这是由于荷尔蒙的影响，再加上比赛带来的压力以及胜利带来的兴奋吧。 “是什么让你改变了想法呢？”她再次向你投来[kythie.lowLibido |羞愧的目光 |毫不掩饰的饥渴目光 ]。“有个宫女撞见了我，当时我简直觉得完全地我当时只是自然而然地张开双腿，摇摇尾巴，仿佛在说：“进来吧，我们一起玩吧！”根本没想过自己的行为有什么不妥。或许我运气比较好，因为她已经在宫殿里待了很长时间，所以能认出我当时并不是平时的自己。她跑出去，立刻把这件事告诉了我的父母。我甚至都没有足够的理智去为此感到尴尬……或者把门关上。 凯西把肘部放在膝盖上，叹了口气：“从那以后，发生的事情就有点模糊不清了。我记得当时父母都对我大发雷霆。后来我经常在半夜醒来，去解决一些生理需求。每次醒来时都会满身大汗，感觉身体仿佛着了火一样。有一次，我试图抓住路过我房间的某个男人，但没能成功，结果就和几个男人打了起来。然后泰娜队长开始把我按倒在地，接下来我就发现自己在了塔里，不停地尖叫、挣扎，因为我的整个身体仿佛都在燃烧，疼痛从腰部开始蔓延开来。 [var0 |凯特露出了感激的微笑：“如果没有你，我可能至今还是那样。” “能帮上你的忙，是我的荣幸，公主！你虽然有点难伺候，但确实值得这个付出。 |你露出了感激的微笑：“如果没有你，我依然会是这样。 [pc.name]你轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀：“我们会帮你度过这个难关的。 ]

rows.original: "I don't think so! Not that could do something like this, anyway!" Kythie sighs. "I'm sure Mom's been tearing her scales off thinking about every bandit lord and barbarian chieftain she's crossed blades with as Strategos. Our family used to fight giants, generations ago, but they've barely been seen in the last century — and I don't think they'd stoop to cursing." "Would a bandit or barbarian?" [pc.bg barbarian |You know your tribe had shamans, and you vaguely remember stories of clashing with Tychrisian soldiers decades ago, but that doesn't seem like something any of your people would do. ] Kythie shakes her head. "Maybe a rogue sorcerer? I hear those are always a problem down south, but the Order Astrida always hunt them down in the end. I know Mom killed one right when I was born. Maybe he had an apprentice or something, but... I don't know. Really we're pretty safe up here. We're friends with most of our neighbors. I don't know who'd be so mad at our family they'd try to hurt me." "If not your family, what about you personally? Do you know of anybody holding a grudge?" "Me?" Kythie seems genuinely taken aback by the question. "What did I do?" [var0 |Cait gives her a disarming smile. "Nothing, sweetheart. But sometimes people take innocent things so far the wrong way it drives them mad. So try and think about anybody whose behavior around you changed, or something like that." |You sigh. "That's what I'm trying to find out. Did somebody start treating you differently lately?" ] The princess pouts. "No! I don't know. The girl from Altenspire I beat out in the Tycathalon, Ariande, was righteously pissed off at me, but she's as much of a meathead as I am!" Kythie frowns. "Now that you mention it, her mother's a court magician in their home city, I think. I guess she could have, but why...?" "We don't know anything for certain," you say. [pc.isCunning |But Kythie's prime competition being a magician's daughter is a possible lead. The curse could have been intended to weaken Kythie before the competition just as easily as it could have been meant to punish her for winning... ] "Anybody else you can think of?" "I guess, uh, there's a girl down at the temple library. Ynes? The last couple times I've been there, I think she was flirting with me! She used to be a witch herself, I hear. Before she came to the temple." "Did you reciprocate?" Kythie shakes her head vigorously. "No, never. I would never. I won't pretend she's not beautiful, but there's something unsettling about her. Not to mention she's a thrall to the temple. I couldn't..." [pc.isCunning |Still, if a witch feels spurned... ] "And nobody else comes to mind?" "No," Kythie sighs. "Tychris is full of spellcasters, [pc.name]. Magister Vasko lives here in the palace, he'd know more of them than I do! Ask him..."

rows.original: "No!" Kythie laughs. "I'm as magic as a rock on the side of the road. My parents hired a tutor to teach me spellcraft when I was young, but nothing stuck. Vasky — I mean, Magister Vasko — tried to get me to apprentice to him for a year anyway, but I didn't make it more than a couple of weeks before I had to tell him I couldn't hack it. And I don't give up easy!" "What made you give up?" Kythie shrugs. "I just... couldn't do it. As hard as I tried, it's like my fingers and tongue just won't work the way I tell them when I try and recite an incantation. And it's weird, I'm an athlete, I know how to push my body... except it all falls apart the moment I open a book." [var0 |Cait chuckles. "Some people have a real knack for magic. I'm told I'm one of them! And if some people can have a natural talent, I guess some people have a natural... un-talent." Kythie snorts. "Yeah, it's... something like that, feels like." |[pc.isMage |"Some people just aren't cut out for it," you say. "Spellcasting's hard, and dangerous, and if you try and push yourself to do it anyway you're likely to hurt yourself or others." "Thank you!" Kythie says, throwing a hand up. "I'm terrified of turning myself into a newt or something!" |"Alright," you say, "so you're no mage yourself. And you stopped practicing when?" "Ages back," Kythies says. "More than a year ago." ] ] You scratch your chin. Kythie definitely didn't do this to herself at least.
rows.translation: 不！”凯西笑着说，“我可一点魔法天赋都没有，就像路边的石头一样。我小时候，父母请了老师来教我魔法，但我什么都不会。瓦斯基……我是说，瓦斯科大师，曾经试图让我跟他当一年学徒，但我连几周都坚持不下来，最后只好告诉他我实在不适合学习魔法。我可不会轻易放弃！” “是什么让你放弃了呢？” 凯西耸了耸肩：“我只是……做不到而已。无论我怎么努力，当我试图念出那些咒语时，我的手指和舌头就是不听使唤，完全无法按照我的意愿来动作。奇怪的是，我本来是个运动员，知道如何锻炼自己的身体……但只要一拿起书来，所有这些努力就都白费了。 [var0 |凯特轻笑起来：“有些人真的天生就擅长魔法。据说我就是其中之一！而如果有些人天生就具备这种天赋，那么我想也一定有人天生就缺乏这种能力吧。” 凯西哼了一声：“是啊，大概就是这个意思吧。 |[pc.isMage |有些人就是不适合做这种事情，”你说，“施法既困难又危险，如果你强行尝试，很可能会伤害到自己或他人。” “谢谢！”凯西举手说道，“我可害怕把自己变成一只蝾螈之类的东西！ |好吧，”你说，“所以你自己并不是法师。那你是什么时候停止练习的？” “很久以前了，”凯西斯回答，“已经有一年多了。 ] ] 你挠了挠下巴。凯西绝对不是自己这么做的。至少是这样。
rows.raw: ' "No!" Kythie laughs. "I'm as magic as a rock on the side of the road. My parents hired a tutor to teach me spellcraft when I was young, but nothing stuck. Vasky — I mean, Magister Vasko — tried to get me to apprentice to him for a year anyway, but I didn't make it more than a couple of weeks before I had to tell him I couldn't hack it. And I don't give up easy!" "What made you give up?" Kythie shrugs. "I just... couldn't do it. As hard as I tried, it's like my fingers and tongue just won't work the way I tell them when I try and recite an incantation. And it's weird, I'm an athlete, I know how to push my body... except it all falls apart the moment I open a book." [var0 |Cait chuckles. "Some people have a real knack for magic. I'm told I'm one of them! And if some people can have a natural talent, I guess some people have a natural... un-talent." Kythie snorts. "Yeah, it's... something like that, feels like." |[pc.isMage |"Some people just aren't cut out for it," you say. "Spellcasting's hard, and dangerous, and if you try and push yourself to do it anyway you're likely to hurt yourself or others." "Thank you!" Kythie says, throwing a hand up. "I'm terrified of turning myself into a newt or something!" |"Alright," you say, "so you're no mage yourself. And you stopped practicing when?" "Ages back," Kythies says. "More than a year ago." ] ] You scratch your chin. Kythie definitely didn't do this to herself at least. '

rows.original: "I, uh, well... that was... not my finest moment." Kythie squirms, eyes downcast. "One of the Order came to the tower when the curse really took me. I never even got her name, I was too far out of it by then, just about ready to bend the bars and climb out the window!" Kythie manages an awkward laugh. "I really made an ass of myself. The Astrida that came over was the first person I'd see except through a door in three days, and I threw myself at her. Like — well, you know. I'm pretty good at wrestling, but I had nothing on her; she had me pinned in a heartbeat! Heh, I bet it was at least awesome to watch — naked nineteen year old versus paladin in full war panoply!" You're sure it was. "So what did she do once she had you in submission?" "You don't have to phrase it like that!" Kythie laughs. "[var0 |That's more between me and Cait..." Cait gives you a wink. "But it wasn't like that," Kythie says. |That's more between you and me. It wasn't like that." ] "So what was it like?" Kythie wrings her hands. "It's hard to describe. She pinned my wrists and then squeezed, but I felt it inside my chest. Like the fist of Nareva herself was grabbing my lungs and trying to make me scream all the air out. It didn't hurt, not really, but it's like... I don't know! Like something in my soul was getting squeezed out." "Your soul?" "I don't know how else to say it. I've never felt my soul before, but I sure did then. It was wild, pressure like nothing else inside me... and then the fire was snuffed out! I felt great. And then promptly died of embarrassment." "[silly |RIP," you lament. |[pc.isCunning |Awfully talkative, for a ghost." Kythie snorts. "Well, I finally found somebody who'll listen! And I bet you want to know about the next time they came, huh?" You nod. |I guess you got better." Kythie snorts. "Yeah, I mean, had a paladin right there laying hands on me, bound to happen. Not for the last time, either." "What brought on the second visit?" ] ] The princess scratches her head. "I felt fine for a couple of days after the Astrida left. Felt myself again. Enough that I could apologize to the people I'd harassed, and the guardsman I roughed up. They were understanding, mostly. Dad had Mistress Hestia cooked up my favorite kreatopita and a cheesecake. I got to go outside and run around. It was good. And then on the third day, I woke up in a burning-hot sweat again, with my fingers already in myself. I managed to tell Mom it was starting again, at least! And then it was back to the tower, and another visit from an Astrida. This time it was Lady Eirina herself — the head of the Order here in Tychris!" [var0 |"That must be quite an honor, getting the personal attention of your goddess's representative," Cait says. "Do you know her well?" |"Do you know her?" ] "Eirina? Yeah, I mean, kinda. We've met before. I was there at her swearing in as the First Spear a couple years ago. She's not much older than me, so Dad wanted us to get friendly. We'll probably be working together a lot, when I'm princeps someday. I think we hit it off pretty well... which made it so much worse when my naked ass got beat down, again, by an Astrida, again, just one I have lunch with every few weeks." Kythie sighs. "The same thing happened again. I felt my soul squeeze, then the heat broke. Eirina examined me all over, waved some magic doohickies at me, mumbled a lot, and then told me I should be fine now!" "Obviously she was wrong..." [pc.bg acolyte scholar |You furrow your brow and consult what you know about the shadowy order. They're professional mage hunters and spell-breakers, trained from birth. If Kythie was actually cleared by the First Spear of the Astrida, whatever's going on here can't just be a regular garden variety curse. There's no way one of the most accomplished Astrida would just miss something; the curse almost certainly was broken. And then it just... came back. ] "Obviously," the princess groans. [pc.isCunning |"Did anything happen between the two attempts? Anything at all out of the ordinary?" Kythie shakes her head. "I don't... I don't know. We were celebrating. I partied, feasted, did a lot of exercise... I actually read a book! Oh, and visited the temple, like, every day. Lot of thankful prayers to Nareva. Right until her cure sorta wasn't." "So you didn't go anywhere?" Kythie shakes her head. "Didn't leave the walls. Just the palace grounds, courtyard, temple." Hmm. ]
rows.translation: 我，呃，那个……确实不是我表现最好的时刻。”凯西尴尬地低下了头。“就在诅咒开始真正影响我的时候，有个教团成员来到了塔里。我甚至都没记住她的名字，那时我已经完全失去了理智，几乎要强行折断铁栏杆从窗户逃走了！凯西勉强挤出了一个尴尬的笑声：“我真的搞砸了一切。那天来的阿斯特里达，是我三天来除了透过门看到的人之外，第一个见到的人，而我竟然直接扑了上去。嗯，你懂的……我的摔跤技术还算不错，但对她来说根本不是对手部，她一下子就把我按在了地上！呵呵，光是看那场面肯定也很刺激吧——一个赤条条的十九岁少女，对上全副武装的骑士！” “你确定吗？那她把你制服之后，又做了什么？” “你不用说得这么直白吧！凯西笑了。[var0 |这其实是我和凯特之间的事情……” 凯特向你眨了眨眼。 “但实际情况并不是这样的，”凯西说道。 |这事儿就咱们俩知道吧，其实并不是那样的。 ] 那么，那是一种什么样的感觉呢？” 凯西绞着双手部说道：“很难描述。她把我的手部腕固定住，然后被挤压了但我能感觉到那种感觉就在我的胸口。就好像娜雷瓦本人的拳头紧紧抓住了我的肺部，试图把我肺里的空气全部挤出来，让我发出尖叫。那种感觉确实存在。受伤其实也不是，只是感觉……我也不知道该怎么形容！就好像我灵魂中的某种东西正在被挤压出来。” “你的灵魂？” “我想不出别的词来表达了。我从来没有感觉到之前我从未有过这样的感受，但那次确实经历了。那种感觉简直疯狂极了，我体内仿佛充满了前所未有的压力……然后，那种激情突然就被熄灭了！我当时感觉棒极了，可紧接着，却因为尴尬而‘死’掉了。[silly |安息吧，”你悲叹道。 |[pc.isCunning |对于一个鬼魂来说，真是太爱说话了。” 凯西哼了一声：“好吧，我终于找到了一个愿意听我说话的人！我打赌你肯定想知道他们下一次来的时候发生了什么，对吧？” 你点了点头。 |我想你这次做得更好了吧。” 凯西哼了一声：“是啊，毕竟有个圣骑士在我身上动来动去，这种事难免会发生。而且这已经不是第一次了。” “那第二次来访又是怎么回事呢？ ] ] 公主挠了挠头：“在阿斯特里达离开后，我有几天感觉挺好的……真的没什么不适。我自己再说一次，我确实应该向那些被我骚扰过的人，以及那个被我弄伤的卫兵道歉。他们大多都表示理解。爸爸还让赫斯提亚女士为我做了我最喜欢吃的菜。克里托皮塔还有一份芝士蛋糕。我得以到外面去跑跑，感觉真是太好了。到了第三天，我又在满身大汗中醒来，手部指竟然又开始……那种不适感又出现了。至少我还能告诉妈妈，症状又复发了！然后我又回到了那座塔里，阿斯特里达又一次来找我。这次来的是艾瑞娜女士本人——她就是提克里斯地区这个组织的负责人啊！ [var0 |能够得到你的女神代表的亲自关注，想必是件非常荣幸的事情吧，”凯特说道，“你和她关系不错吗？ |你认识她吗？ ] 艾瑞娜？嗯，算是吧。我们之前确实见过面。几年前她宣誓成为‘第一长矛’的时候，我在场。她比我年纪大不了多少，所以爸爸希望我们能建立良好的关系。等我有朝一日成为王子，我们很可能需要经常一起合作。我觉得我们相处得还挺不错的……这也让事情变得糟糕多了我又被一个叫阿斯特里达的女孩子揍了一顿，还是那个每隔几周就会和我一起吃午饭的女孩。” 凯西叹了口气：“又发生了同样的事情。我感觉到自己的灵魂仿佛被挤压了一下，然后突然感到一阵剧痛。艾瑞娜仔细检查了我的身体，用了一些魔法治疗我，嘟囔了好一会儿，最后告诉我现在应该没事了！” “显然，她错了 [pc.bg acolyte scholar |你皱起眉头，努力回忆自己所了解的关于这个神秘组织的信息。他们是一群专业的法师猎手和法术破解者，从出生起就接受了专门的训练。如果凯西真的被阿斯特拉达的第一长矛解除了诅咒，那么这里发生的这一切绝对不可能是普通的诅咒现象。像阿斯特丽达这样能力出众的人，绝对不可能遗漏任何细节；这个诅咒，几乎可以肯定是坏了。然后它又……恢复了正常状态。 ] 显然，”公主叹道。 [pc.isCunning |在这两次尝试之间发生了什么吗？有没有什么不寻常的事情？” 凯西摇了摇头。“我不知道……我真的不知道。我们当时在庆祝，我参加了派对，吃了很多美食，还做了很多运动……实际上读书哦，而且每天都会去那座寺庙。会向娜瑞瓦献上许多感恩的祷告。直到她最终被治愈之前，一直都是这样。” “所以你根本没去过别的地方吗？” 凯西摇了摇头：“没有离开过宫殿的范围。只是在宫殿的院子里、寺庙里活动而已。” 嗯…… ]

rows.translation: 尝试完成阿斯特丽达的任务吧。

rows.original: "My family? You're not thinking one of them-" You wave your hands. "No, no. I'm just [pc.isCunning |looking for context here |trying to learn about you all ]. You're an only child, right, Kythie?" She nods, though hardly enthusiastically. "Yeah. First and only. Don't worry — no siblings trying to make sure I can't take the throne." "What about your parents, do they have any nieces and nephews that might have designs?" "On my dad's side, yeah. Mom's parents were, uh, a couple of the moment, I guess you might say. She's an only child too." You arch a brow. "A couple of the moment?" Kythie chuckles awkwardly. "Yeah, well, my grandfather's a baron, he rules one of the villages up north on the border, but he never married. He [var0 |met a girl like Cait here, a mendicant priestess of Mallach, and contracted with her to bear him a child." "Just like my dad did to have me and Calla," Cait says. "Though it's pretty rare for a missionary to take something like that on by herself. She must have really loved him." "That's what I hear," Kythie shrugs. "But she left before I was born. Either way, it didn't win Grandpa any favors at court. I don't know about Jassira, but in Tychris, parents are expected to get married. Stay together. People give him weird looks even now." |eventually entered into a compact with a Mallachite missionary that came to preach in the principality, and she bore him a child." "Does something like that happen often?" "No!" Kythie laughs. "No, it really doesn't. Parents are supposed to stay together, aren't they? Get married and all. But my grandmother left to go back to Jassira before I was even born. People remember that about Grandpa more than anything." ] You glance over your shoulder at the door and whisper. "Does that mean your mother's a bastard, by the court's reckoning?" That makes Kythie squirm. "No. She's, I mean, it's a religious thing. A foreign religious thing, but still, the laws says children born by contract are legitimate just as much as the church does. So, no. It's just... yes, the way people sometimes treat her, you'd think they didn't believe in any of that. A lot of the court doesn't like that my parents are together. Even now." [pc.bg nobleScion |Someone the court considers lowborn being elevated to royal consort must have made Tethys some enemies, even if Kythie and her parents don't recognize it. Noble circles are hidebound at the best of times, and Tychris seems more conservative than most. Could that be a motive for the cursing? Hard to say. ] "So," you say, "how did your mother end up marrying Prince Evander then?" "It was, is, kind of a long story," Kythie shrugs. "But basically, Grandpa — on Dad's side — decided it was a good idea to have some foreign blood in his grandchildren. That we'd been isolated up here so long that we needed it. And Mom's the only noble in the whole city who doesn't have two parents born in the city. It was her or nobody." The princess's ears flick. "But it was a good match! They'd been friends growing up, and they love each other. I'm glad they're my folks." "But you said you have some cousins?" She nods. "Yeah. Dad had a brother, and he had a couple of kids..." [pc.isDK |"What killed him?" |"Sorry for your loss. What happend?" ] "He took sick. We had a real bad winter, maybe ten years ago now? Got a deep cough he never could shake. It was the same year Grandpa passed, too. That was... it was rough. Uncle Iavose's daughters are tough as nails, though. They make me look soft and dainty. And before you ask — they love me, they've protected me all my life. I'd sooner believe Nareva herself cursed me than either of them."
rows.translation: 我的家人？你该不会是说他们中的某个人吧……” 你挥了挥手部，说道：“不，不是的。我只是 [pc.isCunning |需要结合上下文来理解这句话的含义。 |正在努力了解你们所有人。 ]你是独生子女吧，凯西？” 她点了点头，但并不显得很热情。“是的，我是独生女。别担心，没有兄弟姐妹会试图阻止我继承王位。” “那你的父母呢？他们有没有侄子侄女可能会对王位产生兴趣？我爸爸这一边，嗯，是的。我妈妈的父母，呃，可以说他们属于那种‘一时风光’的人吧。我妈妈也是独生女。” 你挑了挑眉毛：“一时风光的人？” 凯西尴尬地笑了笑。嗯，我祖父是个男爵，他在北方边境的一个村庄里掌管着那里的事务，但他从未结婚。 [var0 |在这里，我遇到了一个像凯特这样的女孩——她是玛拉赫教派的一位修行女祭司，我和她约定，让她为我生一个孩子。” “就像我爸爸为了生下我和卡拉那样，”凯特说道，“不过，对于一位传教士来说，独自承担这样的责任其实是非常罕见的。她一定真的很爱他。” “我也是这么听说的，”凯西耸了耸肩，“不过她在我出生之前就离开了。不管怎样，这件事并没有让爷爷在宫廷里获得任何好处。至于贾西拉，我就不清楚了，但在提克里斯，人们普遍认为父母应该结婚。待在一起吧。现在人们看到他还是会用奇怪的眼神看着他。 |最终，她与一位来到这个公国传教的马拉克信徒传教士缔结了婚约，还为他生下了一个孩子。” “这种事情经常发生吗？” “不会的！”凯西笑着说，“真的不会。父母应该是永远在一起的，不是吗？应该结婚生子才对。但在我出生之前，我的祖母就已经回到了贾西拉。人们对祖父的这件事记得最为清楚。 ] 你回头瞥了一眼门，低声说道：“按照法庭的判断，这是不是意味着你的母亲是个私生女？ 那个这让凯西感到很不自在。“不行。我的意思是，这其实是一件与宗教有关的事情。外国的这虽然有点宗教色彩，但法律明确规定，通过契约诞生的孩子与通过正常婚姻诞生的孩子具有同等的法律地位，教会也认同这一观点。所以，答案是否定的。不过……有些人对待她的态度，确实让人觉得他们根本不相信这些道理。至今，很多法院也不认可我父母这种同居关系。 [pc.bg nobleScion |对于那些被法庭认为出身低微的人而言，能够成为王室的配偶，无疑会招致许多敌人的怨恨。即使凯西和她的父母没有意识到这一点。贵族阶层在最好的情况下也依然非常保守，而蒂克里斯似乎比大多数人都更加守旧。这会不会是那些诅咒行为的动机呢？很难说。 ] 那么，”你问道，“你母亲后来是怎么嫁给埃万德王子的呢？” “这其实是个挺长的故事，”凯西耸了耸肩，“但基本上就是，我爸爸那边的祖父觉得，让孙子们身上有一些外国血统会是个不错的主意。我们在这里与世隔绝了太久，真的非常需要这样的帮助。而且妈妈是整个城市里唯一一位父母并非都出生在这个城市的贵族。除了她，没有人能够胜任这个角色。”公主的耳朵微微动了动。“不过，这确实是一段很合适的婚配啊！他们从小就是朋友，而且彼此非常相爱。我很高兴他们成为了我的家人。 “但是你说你还有一些表亲吧？” 她点了点头。“是的。我爸爸有一个哥哥，而那个哥哥也有几个孩子 [pc.isDK |是什么导致了他的死亡？ |对您的损失我深表遗憾。到底发生了什么？ ] 他生病了。那是大约十年前吧，那个冬天实在非常寒冷。他一直咳嗽个不停，怎么也治不好。就在那一年，爷爷也去世了。那真是……一段艰难的时光。不过，Iavose叔叔的女儿们都非常坚强，她们让我觉得自己显得太脆弱、太娇弱了。在你问之前，我想说——她们真的很爱我。受保护的我一生都这么认为。比起他们中的任何一个，我更愿意相信是娜瑞瓦本人诅咒了我。
rows.raw: ' "My family? You're not thinking one of them-" You wave your hands. "No, no. I'm just [pc.isCunning |looking for context here |trying to learn about you all ]. You're an only child, right, Kythie?" She nods, though hardly enthusiastically. "Yeah. First and only. Don't worry — no siblings trying to make sure I can't take the throne." "What about your parents, do they have any nieces and nephews that might have designs?" "On my dad's side, yeah. Mom's parents were, uh, a couple of the moment, I guess you might say. She's an only child too." You arch a brow. "A couple of the moment?" Kythie chuckles awkwardly. "Yeah, well, my grandfather's a baron, he rules one of the villages up north on the border, but he never married. He [var0 |met a girl like Cait here, a mendicant priestess of Mallach, and contracted with her to bear him a child." "Just like my dad did to have me and Calla," Cait says. "Though it's pretty rare for a missionary to take something like that on by herself. She must have really loved him." "That's what I hear," Kythie shrugs. "But she left before I was born. Either way, it didn't win Grandpa any favors at court. I don't know about Jassira, but in Tychris, parents are expected to get married. Stay together. People give him weird looks even now." |eventually entered into a compact with a Mallachite missionary that came to preach in the principality, and she bore him a child." "Does something like that happen often?" "No!" Kythie laughs. "No, it really doesn't. Parents are supposed to stay together, aren't they? Get married and all. But my grandmother left to go back to Jassira before I was even born. People remember that about Grandpa more than anything." ] You glance over your shoulder at the door and whisper. "Does that mean your mother's a bastard, by the court's reckoning?" That makes Kythie squirm. "No. She's, I mean, it's a religious thing. A foreign religious thing, but still, the laws says children born by contract are legitimate just as much as the church does. So, no. It's just... yes, the way people sometimes treat her, you'd think they didn't believe in any of that. A lot of the court doesn't like that my parents are together. Even now." [pc.bg nobleScion |Someone the court considers lowborn being elevated to royal consort must have made Tethys some enemies, even if Kythie and her parents don't recognize it. Noble circles are hidebound at the best of times, and Tychris seems more conservative than most. Could that be a motive for the cursing? Hard to say. ] "So," you say, "how did your mother end up marrying Prince Evander then?" "It was, is, kind of a long story," Kythie shrugs. "But basically, Grandpa — on Dad's side — decided it was a good idea to have some foreign blood in his grandchildren. That we'd been isolated up here so long that we needed it. And Mom's the only noble in the whole city who doesn't have two parents born in the city. It was her or nobody." The princess's ears flick. "But it was a good match! They'd been friends growing up, and they love each other. I'm glad they're my folks." "But you said you have some cousins?" She nods. "Yeah. Dad had a brother, and he had a couple of kids..." [pc.isDK |"What killed him?" |"Sorry for your loss. What happend?" ] "He took sick. We had a real bad winter, maybe ten years ago now? Got a deep cough he never could shake. It was the same year Grandpa passed, too. That was... it was rough. Uncle Iavose's daughters are tough as nails, though. They make me look soft and dainty. And before you ask — they love me, they've protected me all my life. I'd sooner believe Nareva herself cursed me than either of them." '

rows.original: "Well, there's a lot of people that live and work here," Kythie says. "Between servants, staff, men-at-arms, we probably have a hundred people on the grounds! I know a lot of them by name, but not everybody..." "Who has influence here, then? Other than you and your parents." Kythie clasps her hands and thinks. "I guess there's probably... three people with real influence, like that? Magister Vasko, of course. He's my parents' most important counselor. Then there's Mistress Hestia. She's sort of the head domestic, handles most of the cooking — for us and for the palace as a whole. Amazing baker. And then there's Captain Tyna, head of the guard. She reports to Mom, the city's Strategos, and makes sure the palace, and the city as a whole, stay safe." "Do you get along with all of them?" "Yeah!" Kythie insists. "Hestia dotes on me like an extra mom. Tyna and I spar all the time — and she doesn't have anything to be jealous of, she kicks my butt more often than not. And Vasko's always trying to teach me things, even if I think, deep down, he knows I'm too dense to really get his lessons about magic and whatever." [pc.isMage |"What kind of things does he try to teach you?" "I don't know... protection magic, I guess? He said it was important that I learn how to sense other mages casting their spells, and how to counter it. Maybe it would have helped keep me from getting cursed? He's a smart man, especially for someone from the commons. He must have been worried something like this could happen. I really should have tried harder to understand." You have to wonder, why would Vasko be so interested in teaching Kythie to combat mages? She's neither warrior nor mage. ] [var0 |Cait nibbles the tip of her thumb. "So Hestia handles most of your food, right? What's her story?" "She and my mom go way back, actually," Kythie says. "Mom's was the city's Strategos — our top general — even before she married dad. Hestia was one of her companions. When my mom hung up her spear after the Lion Witch's War, Hestia did too, and Mom invited her to come serve in the palace. I think she'd intended for Hestia to be a guard-captain or something, but she said she was done with fighting, and wanted to do something wholesome with the rest of her life. Turned out she's an amazing cook." You and Cait exchange a glance. Hestia certainly has opportunity to hurt the princess, but the motive seems lacking. ]
rows.translation: 嗯，这里居住和工作的人很多，”凯西说，“包括仆人、工作人员和卫兵，整个庄园里大概有上百人吧！我认识他们中的很多人，但也不是所有人……” “那么，这里谁才有真正的影响力呢？除了你和你的父母之外。” 凯西双手部交叠，陷入沉思。“我想，大概还有……三个人真正拥有这样的影响力吧？当然是瓦斯科大师。他是我父母最信任的顾问。还有赫斯提亚女士。她差不多算是家里的管家，负责为我们以及整个宫殿准备大部分食物。她是个非常出色的烘焙师。另外还有泰娜队长，她是卫队的负责人。她直接向城市的战略长官——也就是妈妈汇报工作，并确保宫殿以及整个城市的安全。你和他们所有人都能相处得很好吗？” “当然！”凯西坚定地回答，“赫斯提亚把我当亲生女儿一样疼爱。我和泰娜经常一起练习战斗，她根本没有什么可嫉妒的——事实上，她大多数时候都能把我打得落花流水。而瓦斯科总是试图教我各种东西，尽管在内心深处，我觉得他应该知道我实在太笨了，根本学不会。获得他关于魔法以及各种相关知识的讲解。 [pc.isMage |他试图教你哪些东西呢？” “我也不清楚……应该是防护魔法吧？他说，学会感知其他法师施放的法术并学会如何应对它们非常重要。也许这样就能避免我被诅咒吧？他是个聪明人，尤其是对于一个出身于平民家庭的人来说。他肯定预料到会发生这种事。我真应该更加努力地去理解这些内容。” 人们不禁会想瓦斯科为什么会对教导凯西如何对抗法师如此感兴趣呢？她既不是战士，也不是法师。 ] [var0 |凯特轻轻咬着拇指的指尖。“所以，大部分食物都是赫斯提亚负责准备的，对吧？她的背景是怎样的呢？” “其实，她和我的妈妈关系很久了，”凯西说道，“在我妈妈嫁给爸爸之前，她就已经是这座城市的战略顾问了——也就是我们的最高指挥官。赫斯提亚也是她的同伴之一。在狮女巫之战结束后，当我妈妈放下她的长矛时，赫斯提亚也跟着停下了战斗，于是妈妈邀请她来宫殿里工作。我想妈妈原本打算让赫斯提亚担任卫队队长之类的职务，但赫斯提亚表示她已经厌倦了战斗，想要用余生去做一些有意义的事情。原来她是个非常出色的厨师啊。” 你和凯特对视了一眼。赫斯提亚确实有机会伤害那位公主，但她的动机似乎不够充分。 ]

rows.original: "You mean, what do I do aside from being a pretty princess, right?" Kythie says with a smirk, adjusting her little gold tiara. "As of this year I'm an aurum wreathe athlete, that's what!" Kythie flexes, slapping a bicep that strains the gold armlet she's wearing. "I'm a champion discus thrower, and I'm pretty darn good at the thousand-yard sprint, the javelin, and wrestling." [var0 |"I'll say!" Cait laughs. She rubs at one of the mostly-healed bite marks on her arm. "You're a feisty one for sure." Kythie blushes. |"You're a real powerhouse, huh?" Kythie's tail swishes proudly. "Yep!" ] "Your parents don't exactly look like the sporting types," you muse, thoughts wandering between the plush goddess of a consort and her frail-looking twink of a husband. "How'd you end up so interested in it?" The princess snort-laughs and wiggles her ears. "Yeah, uh, I don't think Dad would survive a round in the ring with me, let alone Captain Tyna. But Mom used to be a warrior — a damned good one too! She hung up her spear to focus on raising me, though. But she made sure I grew up strong enough to protect myself at least." "Does that mean you know how to actually fight?" [pc.bg soldier |Any highborn would be expected to know how, of course, but there's a hell of a difference between training in the palace and actual experience. You've seen her peers learn that the hard way. ] "Wrestling is fighting! Just for submission rather than, like, killing somebody," Kythie insists. "But I'm a noble. I learned how to use a sword and spear, and fight in the shield wall and from horseback. I wouldn't say I have any particular talent for combat, but I'm not bad at it. I could lead the city's soldiers if I had to. It's just... part of that training was also learning how to fight bare-handed, and I kind of fell in love with that instead of poking holes in people. Captain Tyna taught me to love the thrill of it, and then that got me interested in the other sports at the Tycathalon, and I just... I don't know, I guess I've just got a talent for the discus." "When did you start competing?" Kythie thinks for a moment. "Um, I guess when I was about twelve, I started really training to compete. There are tournaments for children that I did well in, but you need to be sixteen to compete in the real ones. Mom took me to Drapsa and Khor'minos to compete there last year and the year before. And this year was the big Tycathalon." So three years. "Any major wins before this year?" "I took argent in Khor'minos! Though I didn't feel great about that..." You quirk a brow. "Why so?" The princess shifts uncomfortably. "Well, most events separate men from women as it is, you know, but Khor'minos is a little more sexist than Tychris. There were barely any women competing, and most of the lady-minotaurs didn't take it very seriously. The only reason I didn't take aurum there was that there was one more foreign competitor, a sellsword from Tronarii, where they use these bladed discs in battle. She was incredible, like she was dancing as she threw." [pc.bg soldier |Experience wins again. |"Damn." ] [var0 |Cait gasps. "Oh, I think I know who you mean! Tall, skinny human lady that looks like she was carved out of mahogany?" Kythie nods. "Yeah! I forget her name, but she's a big champion back south. She did a demonstration at the temple once. My sister was crushing on her for weeks..." ] Either way, it doesn't sound like Kythie's had enough of an athletics career to be worth sabotaging.
rows.translation: 你是说，除了当一个漂亮的公主之外，我还能做些什么，对吧？”凯西带着一丝笑意说道，同时调整着自己戴在头上的小金冠。“从今年开始，我已经成为了一名‘黄金花环’运动会的运动员，就是这个啦！” 凯西展示着自己的肌肉，用力甩动手臂，使得她戴在手臂上的金手镯发出了叮当声。“我可是掷铁饼项目的冠军，而且在一千码短跑、标枪项目和摔跤方面也表现得相当不错哦。 [var0 |真的吗！”凯特笑着说，她轻轻揉了揉手臂上那些已经基本愈合的咬痕。“你确实是个脾气火爆的人呢。” 凯西的脸颊顿时红了。 |你可真是个厉害的角色啊，嗯？” 凯西骄傲地摇动着尾巴：“没错！ ] 你的父母看起来可不太像运动型的人啊，”你想着，脑海中不断浮现出那位雍容华贵的王后与她那位看起来体弱多病的丈夫的形象。“你是怎么对运动产生兴趣的呢？” 公主发出一阵轻笑，还摇动着耳朵。是啊，我觉得爸爸要是和我一起上擂台，肯定撑不过一回合，更别提泰娜队长了。不过妈妈以前可是个战士，而且还是个非常出色的战士！不过后来她放弃了战斗，专心抚养我。不过她确实确保我长大后有足够的力气保护自己。这是不是意味着你真的知道该怎么做？战斗?" [pc.bg soldier |任何一个出身高贵的人都应该懂得这些，但在宫中接受训练与实际经验之间，还是存在着天壤之别的。你也亲眼看到过她的同龄人是如何通过惨痛的教训才学会这些的。 ] 摔跤其实就是战斗！只不过目的是让对手屈服，而不是杀死对方，”凯西坚持说道。“但我可是贵族出身。我学会了如何使用剑和长矛，也懂得如何在盾墙后作战，以及如何骑马作战。虽然我不能说自己在战斗方面有什么特别的天赋，但至少糟糕如果需要的话，我完全可以带领这座城市的士兵们作战。只是……那些训练内容中也包括学习徒手格斗，而我反而对这种战斗方式产生了浓厚的兴趣，而不是喜欢用武器刺伤别人。泰娜上尉教会了我享受那种战斗带来的刺激感，从那以后，我对泰卡塔隆竞技场里的其他运动项目也产生了兴趣。总之……我也说不清楚，大概我就是天生适合投掷铁饼吧。 你是从什么时候开始参加比赛的呢？” 凯西思考了一会儿，说道：“嗯，大概在我十二岁的时候，我开始认真训练，准备参加比赛。有一些针对儿童的比赛，我在那些比赛中表现得还不错，但要想参加真正的比赛，至少得十六岁才行。去年和前年，妈妈带着我去德拉普萨和科尔米诺斯参加比赛。而今年，就是那场重要的泰卡塔隆比赛。 所以，三年了。 “在今年之前，有什么重大的胜利吗？” “我在科尔米诺斯比赛中获得了银牌！不过当时我并没有为此感到高兴……” 你挑了挑眉毛：“为什么呢？” 公主显得有些不自在地挪了挪身子。嗯，大多数活动本来就会将男性和女性区分开来，但你知道，科尔米诺斯这个活动比提克里斯更加性别歧视。几乎没有任何女性参加比赛，而且大多数女弥诺陶洛斯们也并不把这次比赛当回事。我之所以没有去参加那里的比赛，只是因为还有另一位外国参赛者——他是一名来自特洛纳里的雇佣兵，在那里人们会在战斗中使用这种带刃的圆盘武器。她简直太厉害了，投球的时候简直就像在跳舞一样。 [pc.bg soldier |经验依然是最重要的。 |该死。 ] [var0 |凯特倒吸一口凉气：“哦，我想我知道你指的是谁了！那个高个子、身材苗条的女性，看起来就像是用红木雕刻出来的一样吧？” 凯西点了点头。 “对！我忘了她的名字，但她是在南方很有名的一位强者。她曾经在寺庙里进行过表演，我妹妹当时迷上了她，整整好几周都对她念念不忘呢…… ] 无论如何，听起来，凯西的田径生涯还没有发展到值得被破坏的程度啊。
rows.raw: ' "You mean, what do I do aside from being a pretty princess, right?" Kythie says with a smirk, adjusting her little gold tiara. "As of this year I'm an aurum wreathe athlete, that's what!" Kythie flexes, slapping a bicep that strains the gold armlet she's wearing. "I'm a champion discus thrower, and I'm pretty darn good at the thousand-yard sprint, the javelin, and wrestling." [var0 |"I'll say!" Cait laughs. She rubs at one of the mostly-healed bite marks on her arm. "You're a feisty one for sure." Kythie blushes. |"You're a real powerhouse, huh?" Kythie's tail swishes proudly. "Yep!" ] "Your parents don't exactly look like the sporting types," you muse, thoughts wandering between the plush goddess of a consort and her frail-looking twink of a husband. "How'd you end up so interested in it?" The princess snort-laughs and wiggles her ears. "Yeah, uh, I don't think Dad would survive a round in the ring with me, let alone Captain Tyna. But Mom used to be a warrior — a damned good one too! She hung up her spear to focus on raising me, though. But she made sure I grew up strong enough to protect myself at least." "Does that mean you know how to actually fight?" [pc.bg soldier |Any highborn would be expected to know how, of course, but there's a hell of a difference between training in the palace and actual experience. You've seen her peers learn that the hard way. ] "Wrestling is fighting! Just for submission rather than, like, killing somebody," Kythie insists. "But I'm a noble. I learned how to use a sword and spear, and fight in the shield wall and from horseback. I wouldn't say I have any particular talent for combat, but I'm not bad at it. I could lead the city's soldiers if I had to. It's just... part of that training was also learning how to fight bare-handed, and I kind of fell in love with that instead of poking holes in people. Captain Tyna taught me to love the thrill of it, and then that got me interested in the other sports at the Tycathalon, and I just... I don't know, I guess I've just got a talent for the discus." "When did you start competing?" Kythie thinks for a moment. "Um, I guess when I was about twelve, I started really training to compete. There are tournaments for children that I did well in, but you need to be sixteen to compete in the real ones. Mom took me to Drapsa and Khor'minos to compete there last year and the year before. And this year was the big Tycathalon." So three years. "Any major wins before this year?" "I took argent in Khor'minos! Though I didn't feel great about that..." You quirk a brow. "Why so?" The princess shifts uncomfortably. "Well, most events separate men from women as it is, you know, but Khor'minos is a little more sexist than Tychris. There were barely any women competing, and most of the lady-minotaurs didn't take it very seriously. The only reason I didn't take aurum there was that there was one more foreign competitor, a sellsword from Tronarii, where they use these bladed discs in battle. She was incredible, like she was dancing as she threw." [pc.bg soldier |Experience wins again. |"Damn." ] [var0 |Cait gasps. "Oh, I think I know who you mean! Tall, skinny human lady that looks like she was carved out of mahogany?" Kythie nods. "Yeah! I forget her name, but she's a big champion back south. She did a demonstration at the temple once. My sister was crushing on her for weeks..." ] Either way, it doesn't sound like Kythie's had enough of an athletics career to be worth sabotaging. '

rows.original: "I guess you would have heard about that, huh?" Kythie says, fiddling with a braid. "Yeah, I have a fiancee. He's a prince from the city of Felurze, a little south of here. Our parents made the arrangement years ago. He'll be of age next year, and then come up to Tychris so we can be wed. I just hope to the gods he never finds out about any of this..." "You think he would be upset about what [var0 |you and Cait have |we've ] been doing?" She shakes her head. "I don't know, but I'm sure he'd never let me live it down. He's a little shit like that, always teasing me about something! If it's not about how I act, it's about some little this-and-that from ten years ago... and if he runs out of ammunition he'll just say I have fat tits." Kythie pouts, crossing her arms under her fat tits. "Sounds like you're good friends, at least?" "Eh, I mean, I guess. I only see him once or twice a year, but we get on. At least, we put in the effort to. Our parents are all really invested in seeing this marriage play out." "Why is that?" And more importantly, you wonder, who would benefit from destabilizing it. Kythie sighs. "That's, well it's, um, complicated. You've seen my dad. A stiff breeze would blow him over. Grandpa, Uncle, my great-aunt, it's all kind of the same. I'm the first member of the family born anything but sickly in living memory. The clerics of Nareva said we need to stop marrying nobles from our own court; that foreign blood will save us from the decline. Mom kinda proved that it's moving in the right direction, at least." [pc.bg scholar |It sounds like the point is to undo a little too much inbreeding up here in Tychris. Old Belhar used to have the same problem, as you recall; several emperors who came from the union of cousins proved to be unstable. Better to be physically frail than mentally, you suppose. |You wonder if the royal was already under some kind of curse... ] "So, do you really think he cares about your, well, maidenhead?" you ask. "It's certainly important to your parents." Kythie glances away. "I don't think he does, but his parents do. The feeling's mutual, I guess. Dad's not the only one concerned with bloodlines; my fiancee's parents only agreed to the arrangement on the assurance that their son would plant his seed in my womb, ensuring their blood became the next rulers of Tychris. And the best way to assure that is my chastity. The contract's ironclad, oathsworn before Nareva and Tira." "And what does your prince think about all of this?" "I, uh," Kythie's ears flatten against her head. "I don't know. It's our duty. He knows that as well as I do. He's a twerp, but still puts in the effort to be tolerable." [pc.bg minstrel noblescion courtesan |You've heard this story before. It's a rare thing for promised couples to be enthusiastically in love; the best they can hope for is a quiet toleration that blooms into better. But Kythie's response leaves you wondering. "You're an incredible woman, Kythie. He should be over the moon." "Yeah! But, like, I mean, he's just..." Kythie's cheeks flush, and she squeezes her own fingers. "He's always... he's never been interested in me like that. Not like Mom and Dad were when they were in our shoes. It's, I guess it's just kind of disappointing. I don't get the childhood friend romance, or the prince charming with love at first sight. And he just gets... me." Could it be that the Prince of Felurze would want to break off this engagement himself? ]
rows.translation: 我想你会我听说过这件事，对吧？”凯西一边说着，一边摆弄着自己的发辫。“是的，我有一个未婚夫。他是来自费卢尔泽城的王子，就在我们这里南边不远处。我们的父母几年前就安排好了这门婚事。他明年就成年了，到时候就会来到蒂克里斯，然后我们就可以结婚了。我只希望诸神能让他永远不要知道这些事情……” “你认为他会因为这些事情而难过吗？ [var0 |你和凯特有 |我们已经 ] 他最近在干什么呢？” 她摇了摇头：“我不知道，但我敢肯定，他绝对不会让我就此罢休的。他就是这种人，总是拿一些事情来取笑我！要不是我的行为方式，就是十年前的一些小事……要是他的‘弹药’用完了，他就只会说‘我的胸部很大’吧。”凯西撅着嘴，双臂交叉在胸前。 “听起来你们应该是很好的朋友吧？” “嗯，算是吧。我一年也就见他一两次面，不过我们相处得还不错。至少，我们付出了努力。我们的父母也都非常希望看到这段婚姻能够顺利发展。” “为什么呢？”更重要的是，你会想知道，谁会从破坏这段婚姻中获益。 凯西叹了口气。嗯，这个情况有点复杂。你们都见过我爸爸，一阵微风就能把他吹倒。爷爷、叔叔、我的姑婆们，也都是这种情况。在大家的记忆中，我是家里第一个没有天生体弱多病的成员。娜瑞瓦的神职人员们认为，我们应该停止与自己宫廷中的贵族通婚；他们认为，外来的血统能够帮助我们避免衰落。不过，妈妈的做法至少证明，我们正在朝着正确的方向前进。 [pc.bg scholar |看来，关键在于扭转提克里斯地区这种过度近亲繁殖的现象。正如你所记得的，老贝尔哈尔也曾面临同样的问题——几位由表亲联姻而产生的皇帝都被证明是不稳定的。或许，身体虚弱总比精神失常要好吧。 |你不禁怀疑，这位王室成员是否早已陷入了某种诅咒之中…… ] 那么，你真的认为他在意你的……贞操吗？”你问道，“不过这对你的父母来说肯定很重要。” 凯西移开了视线，说道：“我不这么认为。他也是这么想的，但他的父母却坚持这样做。我想，这种想法是相互的。父亲并不是唯一一个关心血统问题的人；我未婚妻的父母也是只有在得到保证——他们的儿子会将自己的后代留在我的肚子里，从而确保他们的血脉能够成为泰克里斯未来的统治者——之后，才同意这个安排的。而确保这一点的最佳方式，就是保持我的贞洁。这份契约是铁一般的，我在娜瑞瓦和蒂拉面前宣誓过。” “那么，你的王子对这一切是怎么看的呢？” “我，呃……”凯西的耳朵紧紧贴在脑袋上。我不知道。这是我们的职责。他和我一样明白这一点。他虽然是个小混蛋，但还是会努力让自己变得可以忍受。 [pc.bg minstrel noblescion courtesan |你以前肯定听过这个故事。对于那些被许下承诺的情侣来说，真正彼此深爱着对方其实是件难得的事；他们最多只能期待一种逐渐发展成更深厚感情的、表面上的宽容与接纳。但凯西的反应却让人不禁产生疑问：“凯西，你真是个了不起的女性。他应该高兴极了。” “是啊！但是，我是说，他其实……”凯西的脸颊涨得通红，她紧紧地捏着自己的手指，“他从来都没有这样对我……从来都没有像爸爸妈妈在我们这个年纪时那样对我。我觉得，这真的有点令人失望。我无法理解那种青梅竹马的恋情，也无法理解那种一见钟情的浪漫故事。而他，只是选择了……我。 难道费卢尔泽王子本人想要解除这段婚约吗？ ]

rows.original: Kythie draws in a breath when you ask the question, and then glances sharply away. "That's, uhm, why do you ask...?" You cross your arms. "What's going on with you?" "Nothing!" Kythie insists. "I was just interested, that's all." "Interested in what? Those books aren't exactly easy reading, Kythie." The princess squirms uncomfortably under your inquiring gaze, before finally slumping her shoulders when you refuse to relent. "I was researching something. Someone." Her tail flops into her lap, and she rubs at the smooth blue scales. "Myself." "[pc.isDK|Narcisistic much?"|You think you're going to find yourself in a bunch of old books?"] Kythie waves her hands. "N-no, not like that! Just, sometimes I have strange dreams. Since before the whole curse thing even started, like since I was a kid. I have these really vivid dreams about dragons, and the sea — I've never been to the sea! I thought those books might help, but honestly, I barely understood anything in there. It might as well have been in Macahn for all I could tell. I tried talking to Vasko about it, asked him to help me puzzle out what they were saying, but after a few hours he was more frustrated with me than I was at the books! I just ended up taking them back to the temple..." "So, these dreams... have they changed at all lately?" "You mean since the curse? I... sort of..." Kythie [kythie.lowLibido |blushes a little, and her ears flatten against her scalp. |licks her lips, and her see the flame on her tail start burning a little more intently. ] "The dreams used to be about flying in the open sky, or breathing fire on monsters, or perching up on the top of the palace and just basking in the sun... but now every night I dream about being bred. I'm a huge and powerful and beautiful dragon, and [kythie.fucked |a hero — like you — |a beautiful paladin like Cait ] comes to lift my tail and just ravish me until I'm so full of eggs I can barely move." Kythie presses her thighs together. "And then I wake up and I'm knuckles-deep in myself, drenched in sweat, feeling like my womb's so empty! Like an ache I can't shake off." You [pc.isCunning |whistle |let out a breath ]. That's a hell of a thing. "When did these dreams start?" She shrugs. "I can't really remember a time before it. Dad used to read me stories about dragons, when I was a baby. He said we were descended from them. All salamanders are, and that's why Nareva chose Tychris as her new stronghold, during the Godswar! When the dreams started, I just thought it meant Nareva loved me. [kythie.lowLibido |Not so sure about that now... |Now it seems like she just wants me to get packed full of eggs, like a dragon broodmother! ] So... sorry I didn't really want to mention it before. It's weird!" [ashe.around |Ashe vibrates at your side. "Ask her what color of dragon she is in her dreams." Okay, sure. "Do you remember what you looked like as a dragon? What colored scales?" Kythie makes an embarrassed noise in her throat. "I... remember once I flew over a lake, and shone like a coat of gold and pearls in my reflection. When the light caught my scales, it was blinding. I was like Dad's crown reshaped into a winged tyrant that could rule an empire. I've never felt so powerful, or so beautiful..." You glance down at Ashe. "Sounds familiar..." "Really?" "I'll tell you about it sometime." |[var0 |If Kythie's dreaming of a dragon... you don't know if there's any actual connection, but you do know a dragon not all that far away that's suffering for want of someone with royal blood. Maybe that could be a cure for the horny princess? Ashe's draconic power might be able to break its hold on her! ] ]

rows.raw: ' Kythie draws in a breath when you ask the question, and then glances sharply away. "That's, uhm, why do you ask...?" You cross your arms. "What's going on with you?" "Nothing!" Kythie insists. "I was just interested, that's all." "Interested in what? Those books aren't exactly easy reading, Kythie." The princess squirms uncomfortably under your inquiring gaze, before finally slumping her shoulders when you refuse to relent. "I was researching something. Someone." Her tail flops into her lap, and she rubs at the smooth blue scales. "Myself." "[pc.isDK|Narcisistic much?"|You think you're going to find yourself in a bunch of old books?"] Kythie waves her hands. "N-no, not like that! Just, sometimes I have strange dreams. Since before the whole curse thing even started, like since I was a kid. I have these really vivid dreams about dragons, and the sea — I've never been to the sea! I thought those books might help, but honestly, I barely understood anything in there. It might as well have been in Macahn for all I could tell. I tried talking to Vasko about it, asked him to help me puzzle out what they were saying, but after a few hours he was more frustrated with me than I was at the books! I just ended up taking them back to the temple..." "So, these dreams... have they changed at all lately?" "You mean since the curse? I... sort of..." Kythie [kythie.lowLibido |blushes a little, and her ears flatten against her scalp. |licks her lips, and her see the flame on her tail start burning a little more intently. ] "The dreams used to be about flying in the open sky, or breathing fire on monsters, or perching up on the top of the palace and just basking in the sun... but now every night I dream about being bred. I'm a huge and powerful and beautiful dragon, and [kythie.fucked |a hero — like you — |a beautiful paladin like Cait ] comes to lift my tail and just ravish me until I'm so full of eggs I can barely move." Kythie presses her thighs together. "And then I wake up and I'm knuckles-deep in myself, drenched in sweat, feeling like my womb's so empty! Like an ache I can't shake off." You [pc.isCunning |whistle |let out a breath ]. That's a hell of a thing. "When did these dreams start?" She shrugs. "I can't really remember a time before it. Dad used to read me stories about dragons, when I was a baby. He said we were descended from them. All salamanders are, and that's why Nareva chose Tychris as her new stronghold, during the Godswar! When the dreams started, I just thought it meant Nareva loved me. [kythie.lowLibido |Not so sure about that now... |Now it seems like she just wants me to get packed full of eggs, like a dragon broodmother! ] So... sorry I didn't really want to mention it before. It's weird!" [ashe.around |Ashe vibrates at your side. "Ask her what color of dragon she is in her dreams." Okay, sure. "Do you remember what you looked like as a dragon? What colored scales?" Kythie makes an embarrassed noise in her throat. "I... remember once I flew over a lake, and shone like a coat of gold and pearls in my reflection. When the light caught my scales, it was blinding. I was like Dad's crown reshaped into a winged tyrant that could rule an empire. I've never felt so powerful, or so beautiful..." You glance down at Ashe. "Sounds familiar..." "Really?" "I'll tell you about it sometime." |[var0 |If Kythie's dreaming of a dragon... you don't know if there's any actual connection, but you do know a dragon not all that far away that's suffering for want of someone with royal blood. Maybe that could be a cure for the horny princess? Ashe's draconic power might be able to break its hold on her! ] ] '

You put your hands on your hips. "It could be important." "It's not! It's private! That [kythie.lowLibido |Laz |stupid brat or a boy ] is Lazaran en Felurze — my betrothed. His uncle passed me a personal letter from my fiance when he came to see the Tycathalon, and that's all." The princess is seething — and something tells you it's about more than just having her mail read. [kythie.lowLibido |You [pc.isDK |frown |put a hand on her shoulder, feeling the warmth rising to the surface in her. Uh-oh. ] "Take it easy. rows.original: "Philandros? Philaaaaandros?" Kythie rolls the name in her mouth, scratching at her cheek. "Yeah, it's kind of hard not to know the name. He was the reigning princeps right when the Godswar broke out, I think. He had a son, Philander, that died right at the start of the war." She pauses to think. "He helped found the Order Astrida, right? Near the middle of the war, when things were desperate and Nareva'd become the city's patron directly. He's got a statue right outside, celebrating his heroism." "So he is one of your ancestors?" "Sort of," Kythie says. "I haven't exactly memorized the royal genealogy but I'm pretty sure we're actually descended from his nephew, who took the throne. Or maybe it was a cousin. None of Philandros's trueborn children survived the war." Ah. "So [kythie.lowLibido |why the question? |what's with the question, huh? ] [kythie.isCursed |Do you think my... ancestry has something to do with it? |That interested in me, are you? ]" "I met a giant in the forest, back near Hawkethorne. She said she'd sworn an oath to Prince Philandros, and won't let me past her because of it. I was hoping maybe you'd know why?" Kythie blinks. "A giant? Uh.... what?" You explain what happened: the jotun woman appearing out of seemingly nowhere, challenging you with an axe, then claiming she belonged to what now appears to be an ancient and long-dead monarch of Tychris. "I can't imagine! It's been, what, two hundred and fifty years? I guess the northern-er you are the longer you live, in the cold. I've heard that a few times from Vasko... But she can't have just been sitting there for all that time, right?" "Hard to say. But she's going to keep sitting there unless I find a way to convince her. Any ideas?" Kythie grimaces. "You're asking me for ideas? Oh gods, you must be desperate." She laughs nervously. "I don't know, and I doubt anybody alive in the city knows she's even there! If she's waiting for her prince to relieve her of her obligation, she's going to be waiting a lot longer too!" You let Kythie think on that a moment more, watching the princess's brows furrow. She's really rubbing those braincells together for you. "Uhm, well, maybe you could bring her something that belonged to Prince Philandros? I don't know if she'd care about a royal writ from Dad, but a symbol from the princeps! I know Lady Eirina has a ring that belonged to Philandros — it's like the signet of the whole Order Astrida. Show that to your giant lady and maybe she'll give you a pass!" "Hey, that's an idea," you tell her, [kythie.fucked |leaning in and planting a kiss on her lips. |clasping her shoulder. ] "[pc.isDK |See, you're smarter than you look." "Hey!" |Thanks!" Kythie swishes her tail. "N-no problem." ] Time to talk to Lady Eirina, then.
rows.translation: “菲兰德罗斯？菲——兰——德——罗斯？”凯西把名字在嘴里滚了一圈，挠了挠脸颊。“是啊，想不知道这个名字都难。我记得诸神之战爆发那会儿，在位的亲王就是他。他有个儿子叫菲兰德，战争刚一开始就死了。”她停下来想了想。“他是帮助创立阿斯特里达教团的人之一，对吧？那大概是战争中期，局势最绝望、娜瑞瓦直接成了这座城的守护神的时候。外面就有一座他的雕像，纪念他的英勇。” “所以确实是你的祖先之一？” “算是吧，”凯西说。“我也没把王室族谱背下来，但我相当确定我们其实是他侄子那一脉的后代，后来是那位侄子继承了王位。也可能是个表亲。菲兰德罗斯的嫡亲子女没有一个活过那场战争。” 啊。 “那么[kythie.lowLibido |你为什么问这个？ |问这个干嘛，嗯？ ] [kythie.isCursed |你觉得我的……血统跟这事有关系？ |就这么对我感兴趣，是吗？ ]” “我在鹰棘镇附近的林子里遇到一个巨人。她说她曾向菲兰德罗斯王子立下誓言，就因为这个不让我过去。我还指望你也许知道原因？” 凯西眨了眨眼。“一个巨人？呃……什么？” 你解释了事情的经过：那个约顿女巨人不知从哪儿冒了出来，提着斧头向你挑战，随后声称自己属于一位如今看来早已作古的提克里斯古代君主。 “我想不通！那都过去……两百五十年了吧？我猜越往北边去，人在寒冷里活得就越久。这话我从瓦斯科那儿听过好几次……可她总不能真在那儿干坐了那么久吧？” “难说。但除非我找到办法说服她，否则她会一直坐在那儿。有什么主意吗？” 凯西苦着脸。“你居然问我要主意？哦，天哪，你肯定是走投无路了。”她紧张地笑了笑。“我不知道，而且我怀疑城里活着的没人知道她在那儿！如果她是在等她的王子来解除她的义务，那她还得等更久呢！” 你让凯西再多想了一会儿，看着公主的眉头拧成一团。她为了你可真是把脑细胞搓得冒火。“呃，那个，也许你可以带一件属于菲兰德罗斯王子的东西给她？我不知道她会不会在意我父王颁发的王室文书，但从亲王本人那里来的信物就不一样了！我知道艾瑞娜女士有一枚属于菲兰德罗斯的戒指——那就像是整个阿斯特里达教团的印玺。把它拿给你的巨人女士看，说不定她就会放你过去了！” “嘿，这倒是个主意，”你告诉她，[kythie.fucked |凑过去在她嘴唇上亲了一下。 |握住她的肩膀。 ] “[pc.isDK |看吧，你比看上去要聪明。 “嘿！” |谢谢！” 凯西甩了甩尾巴。“没、没问题。” ] 那么，该去找艾瑞娜女士谈谈了。

"So [kythie.lowLibido |why the question? |what's with the question, huh? ] [kythie.isCursed |Do you think my... ancestry has something to do with it? |That interested in me, are you? ]" "I met a giant in the forest, back near Hawkethorne. She said she'd sworn an oath to Prince Philandros, and won't let me past her because of it. I was hoping maybe you'd know why?" Kythie blinks. "A giant? Uh.... what?" You explain what happened: the jotun woman appearing out of seemingly nowhere, challenging you with an axe, then claiming she belonged to what now appears to be an ancient and long-dead monarch of Tychris. "I can't imagine! It's been, what, two hundred and fifty years? I guess the northern-er you are the longer you live, in the cold. I've heard that a few times from Vasko... But she can't have just been sitting there for all that time, right?" "Hard to say. But she's going to keep sitting there unless I find a way to convince her. Any ideas?" Kythie grimaces. "You're asking me for ideas? Oh gods, you must be desperate." She laughs nervously. "I don't know, and I doubt anybody alive in the city knows she's even there! If she's waiting for her prince to relieve her of her obligation, she's going to be waiting a lot longer too!" You let Kythie think on that a moment more, watching the princess's brows furrow. She's really rubbing those braincells together for you. "Uhm, well, maybe you could bring her something that belonged to Prince Philandros? I don't know if she'd care about a royal writ from Dad, but a symbol from the princeps! I know Lady Eirina has a ring that belonged to Philandros — it's like the signet of the whole Order Astrida. Show that to your giant lady and maybe she'll give you a pass!" "Hey, that's an idea," you tell her, [kythie.fucked |leaning in and planting a kiss on her lips. |clasping her shoulder. ] "[pc.isDK |See, you're smarter than you look." "Hey!" |Thanks!" Kythie swishes her tail. "N-no problem." ] Time to talk to Lady Eirina, then. '

rows.original: "Why? Oh, I could hardly count the reasons, Champion!" Tethys growls, fixing you with a withering look. "Thore is nothing but an upjumped bandit masquerading as a lord, and his misbegotten son is no better than his father. They killed Count Julius in cold blood when he dared to stand up against their company's demand for tribute and now squat on his grave like a pack of vultures. They burned his daughter alive! And then there's the brutal stranglehold over trade he's exerting — one can hardly move goods across the River Maiden without Thore taking a princely cut. He commands the safest crossing of the river for fifty leagues in either direction and is delighted to remind anyone who'll listen. Damned mongrel peasant delights in rubbing his new position in the face of everyone around him!" The lady-consort pauses, and takes a deep breath. "And that is why Felurze is so important, Champion. The city commands the second safest crossing of the Maiden. It's no Belharan stone, but it's stood unharmed for ten years. It's become a lifeline for our city's goods to reach southern markets. You must understand how dangerous it already is, moving anything to Old Belhar. Risking the Maiden in the process is too much. She's savage, particularly this time of year." "Ten years," you murmur. "But Kythie's been betrothed to Lazaran longer, hasn't she? Before Count Thore took over, too." "Yes, yes. Count Julius only had the one daughter; no sons to speak of. I oft wondered if Maidenbridge suffered the same... weakness of the blood... that afflicts so many northern realms. It hardly matters now. Lazaran was always our pick. His parents are good friends, and staunch allies. His uncle Asher, too. Evander's been close with him since they were small." Tethys laughs dryly. "If my husband had been born a woman I suspect we'd have a prince-consort Asher today. Does that answer your question, Champion? I'll not have Kythie's hand bound to that of a usurper and murderer, and that is the end of that!" Yeah, you got it alright. [kythie.isCursed |Considering how steadfast Tethys is in refusing him, one wonders if that would be motive enough to make Count Thore resort to... darker means of encouraging her to accept the offer? ]
rows.translation: “为什么？哦，冠军，这理由我数都数不过来！”泰西斯低吼着，用一道能把人剜掉一层皮的目光盯住你。“托雷不过是个暴发户土匪，披着一张领主的皮；他那个孽种儿子也不比老子强。朱利叶斯伯爵胆敢站出来反抗他们商会索取的贡赋，就被他们冷血地杀害，如今他们又像一群秃鹫似的蹲在他的坟头上。他们还把他女儿活活烧死！再说他对贸易的那套残暴钳制——想沿梅登河运货，托雷不抽走一笔亲王级别的分成，你几乎寸步难行。他掌控着上下游各五十里格内最安全的渡口，还乐此不疲地提醒每一个愿意听的人。这该死的杂种泥腿子，就爱把自己新得的地位甩到周围每个人脸上！” 这位亲王妃顿了顿，深吸一口气。“所以费卢尔泽才这么重要，冠军。那座城控制着梅登河第二安全的渡口。它比不上一座贝拉兰石桥，可十年来一直安然无恙，已经成了我们城中货物运往南方市场的一条命脉。你必须明白，往旧贝尔哈运货本来就已经够危险了。再拿梅登河去冒险，代价太大。这条河很凶蛮，尤其是每年这个时节。” “十年，”你低声说。“可凯西跟拉扎兰订婚的时间更长，对吧？而且还是在托雷伯爵上位之前就订下的。” “是啊，是啊。朱利叶斯伯爵只有一个女儿，没有值得一提的儿子。我常想，梅登布里奇是不是也患上了那种……血脉上的虚弱……困扰着北方那么多王国的毛病。如今这些都无所谓了。拉扎兰一直是我们的人选。他父母是我们的好友，也是坚定的盟友。他叔叔阿舍尔也一样。埃万德从小就和他亲近。”泰西斯干笑一声。“要是我丈夫生来是个女人，我猜今天我们就会有一位王夫阿舍尔了。这样算回答你的问题了吗，冠军？我绝不会把凯西的手绑到一个篡位者和杀人犯手上，这事到此为止！” 嗯，你算是问明白了。 [kythie.isCursed |想想泰西斯拒绝得如此坚决，不知道这够不够成为动机，让托雷伯爵动用……更阴暗的手段逼她接受这门亲事？ ]

rows.original: [var0 |You and Cait exchange a look. "I think that's all we needed for now." "Alright, if you're sure," the princess laments. "Cait, could you, um, stay for a while? I, well, I can-" "It's okay, sweetheart, you don't have to say," Cait says, giving you a wink. "I've got you." Kythie smiles, even if she's blushing like a rose. You give Cait's [cait.fucked |ass |shoulder ] a squeeze and go knock on the door, taking your leave. Tethys bars the door again behind you, sighing to herself as she does so. "I hope you've learned something useful, [pc.name]." [pc.isDK |Quit nagging, woman, you'll get on it when you get to it. |You're working on it, you're working on it... ] |[kythie.lowLibido |"I'll get back to it," you say, turning towards the door. "[pc.isDK |Try not to schlick yourself silly while I'm gone." Kythie groans. "I'm fine! For now. Jerk. |Are you going to be okay?" Kythie shrugs. "As much as I can be. The fire's never gone, but... it's embering now, thanks to you. ] I'm sure you'll hear about it when it starts blazing." The whole town will if you let it get too far. |"I've got to get back to it," you say — and instantly feel Kythie's tail wrapping around your leg for the trouble. "Do you have to...?" Kythie murmurs, biting her lip. The way she's leaning forward now puts her whole cleavage on display, stiff nipples jutting through the fabric of her chest-straps. "Not to be a bother, but I could use your company a bit longer." You can feel the effort it's taking her to be demure; her tail-muscles are flexing, trying to keep you from pulling away. "Kythie..." Her chest heaves beneath its struggling restraints, and you see a dangerous glint in her eyes... before she draws in a deep breath and squeezes her fists, forcing herself to let you go. "Please, hurry back. I don't know how much longer I can hold out." "I will." ] You turn and give the door a heavy knock. Tethys lets you out, and you glance over your shoulder at the lonely princess as it's barred back behind you again. "I pray you have learned something useful, Champion," Tethys says quietly. "You [pc.hasKids |can only |cannot begin ] to imagine how much I hate this, every time." [pc.isDK |"I'm working on it!" you huff. The nagging isn't helping! |"I'm trying my best, Lady Tethys," you insist. ] ]
rows.translation: [var0 |你和凯特对视了一眼。“我想我们现在需要的就是这些了。” “好吧，如果你确定的话……”公主有些遗憾地说，“凯特，你能再留一会儿吗？我……其实我可以的……” “没关系的，亲爱的，你不必说出来。”凯特眨了眨眼对你说，“有我在呢。” 凯西露出了微笑，尽管她的脸已经红得像朵玫瑰。你看着凯特 [cait.fucked |屁股 |肩膀 ] 轻轻敲敲门，然后离开。 泰西斯在你离开后再次关上了门，同时暗自叹了口气：“希望你这次能学到些什么有用的东西 [pc.name]." [pc.isDK |别再唠叨了，女人，到了该做的时候自然会去做的。 |你正在努力解决这个问题，你真的在努力…… ] |[kythie.lowLibido |我稍后会处理这个的，”你边说边朝门口走去。[pc.isDK |我不在的时候，你可别犯傻啊。” 凯西叹了口气：“我现在还好吧……至少暂时还好。这个笨蛋。 |你不会有事吧？” 凯西耸了耸肩：“能没事就最好了。那场大火虽然从未完全熄灭，但……多亏了你，现在它只是还在闷烧而已。 ] 我敢肯定，等它真正开始燃烧的时候，整个镇上的人都会听说这件事的。” “如果你不让事情发展得太严重，整个镇上的人应该都不会知道这件事的。 |我得回去继续工作了，”你说道——转眼间，就感觉到凯西的尾巴缠住了你的腿，似乎在抱怨你打扰了她。 “真的必须现在走吗……？”凯西咬着嘴唇轻声说道。她现在前倾的姿势让她的胸部完全暴露在空气中，坚硬的乳头甚至从胸带的布料中凸显出来。“其实我也不想打扰你，但还能再陪你一会儿吗？感受她为了保持端庄而付出的努力实在令人惊叹；她的尾巴肌肉都在不停地收缩，试图阻止你离开她。 “凯西……” 在那些束缚她的力量之下，她的胸膛不断起伏，你看到她眼中闪烁着危险的光芒……直到她深吸一口气，紧握双拳，强迫自己放开你。“求你了，快回来吧。我不知道自己还能坚持多久。” “我一定会回来的。 ] 你转身用力敲了敲门。泰西斯让你走了出去，而在你离开后，那扇门又被关上了。 “希望你这次能学到一些有用的东西，冠军，”泰西斯轻声说道。“你 [pc.hasKids |只能 |完全不行 ] 每次想到自己有多讨厌这件事，我就觉得难以忍受。 [pc.isDK |我正在处理这件事！”你气呼呼地说。这种不断的催促根本没有任何帮助！ |我已经在尽力了，泰西斯女士，”你坚持说道。 ] ]

rows.original: You glance back at Cait. "Do you think you could help Kythie out, Cait?" The kitty-cleric blinks, raising her brows. "Me?" Her gaze quickly turns to Tethys. "Would you be okay with that? I'm not a Champion like my [pc.name] here, but I know a thing or two about sating desires! It'd be my pleasure to help, if you'd consent to it." "Goodness knows Kythie can't," Tethys says with a sigh. "If you know how to help my daughter, Cait, I'd be grateful." Cait looks between you both, and then slaps one of her own biceps. "I can treat the symptoms, anyway. You 'manders don't go into heat, do you? So something's causing it, something magic or poisonous, or maybe yeah, a curse. I don't know what I can do about that. But she's going nuts, and I, well, I'm a Mallachite. There's no greater sin to my god than twisting passion into suffering. [pc.name] was right to call me. I'll do everything I can to help. Just... I hope you know what that means?" "I do." Tethys glances away, chewing on her lip. "In other circumstances I'm sure you two would have been good friends, Cait. If you are confident in your ability, then... then I will ask you to be more than that to her, for as long as it takes for us to find a cure. Please, sister, ease her suffering." Cait gives her a firm nod. "I'll try. No, I will." She looks to you and flashes a smile. "Don't worry about me. She might be strong, but I've got [silly |reach and |feline ] flexibility on my side. And a whole lot of Mallachite training." Yeah she does. "Good luck, Cait." [flags.CAIT_KISS |Cait leans in and kisses you. "Don't wait up. Go find her cure. |"I don't need luck. I've got skill!" ] Tethys opens the door and ushers Cait inside. The pink kitten gives you a wink, and then she's gone. All you hear from inside is more banging around, Cait hissing, and then a number of heavy, fleshy impacts. The lady-consort winces. "I... will she be alright?" "She's fine," you say with confidence. "Now I'll get back to work." "Godspeed, Champion."
rows.translation: 你回头看向凯特。“凯特，你觉得你能帮帮凯西吗？” 这位猫族教士眨了眨眼，挑起眉毛。“我？”她的目光很快转向泰西斯。“你同意吗？我不像我的[pc.name]那样是个冠军，但满足欲望这种事我还是懂一两手的！只要你点头，我很乐意帮忙。” “老天也知道凯西自己办不到，”泰西斯叹着气说。“凯特，如果你知道怎么帮我女儿，我会很感激。” 凯特看看你，又看看泰西斯，然后拍了拍自己的一条上臂。“反正我能治标。你们蝾螈人没有发情期，对吧？所以肯定是有什么东西在作祟，魔法的、毒物的，或者——对，说不定是个诅咒。那个我暂时不知道能怎么办。可她已经快疯了，而我呢，我是马拉克的信徒。对我的神来说，把情欲扭曲成痛苦是最大的罪。[pc.name]叫我来是对的。我会竭尽所能帮忙。只是……我希望你明白那意味着什么？” “我明白。”泰西斯移开目光，咬着嘴唇。“若不是这样，我确信你们俩本会成为好朋友的，凯特。如果你对自己的本事有信心，那么……那我就请你对她来说不止是朋友，直到我们找到解药为止。拜托了，姐妹，减轻她的痛苦。” 凯特坚定地朝她点了点头。“我会试试。不，我一定会做到。”她看向你，露出一个笑容。“别担心我。她也许很强壮，但我有[silly |臂展和 |猫科动物的 ]柔韧性做本钱。还有一整套马拉克信徒的训练。” 她确实有。“祝你好运，凯特。” [flags.CAIT_KISS |凯特凑过来吻了你。“别等我。去找治她的办法吧。 |“我不需要运气。我有的是本事！” ] 泰西斯打开门，把凯特领了进去。这只粉色的小猫朝你眨了眨眼，然后就消失在门后。你只听见里面又是一阵乒乓乱响，凯特发出嘶嘶声，接着是好几下沉甸甸的、皮肉相击的闷响。 这位亲王妃缩了缩脖子。“我……她不会有事吧？” “她没事，”你自信地说。“现在我该回去干活了。” “愿神与你同行，冠军。”
