rows.original: "What if I wanted to help you?" you suggest, [vasko.fucked |taking a step closer, sidling right up to your big, hunky lover. "I'm not in the habit of betraying handsome men I'm fucking." Vasko's eyes widen, just a bit, before he slips an arm around your waist and his tail around your leg. "Ah, my darling, I knew I saw something in you. Past those good looks. And the whole good-at-sex thing." He chuckles at himself. "So tell me, what is it, exactly, you want to help me with?" |leaning against the table. "I'm not exactly a huge fan of the royal family myself. They've been lying to me from before I even got here." "Well! Is that so?" Vasko gives you an appraising look, steepling his fingers. "And just what is it you want to help me with?" ] "Stop playing dumb," you say. "Tell me what you're actually trying to do with Kythie." Vasko clicks his tongue, and leans back in his chair. "It's simple, really. For her own good, despite what it seems. You may think whatever you want of what I'm about, [pc.name], but I do care for the girl. She's done nothing wrong, yet. My aim is simply to ensure she never has a chance to." "Go on." "Her family have run this city into the ground, reduced us to a rump state begging to be conquered the moment a strong rival rises up. Pathetic, mewling nobles each weaker and more spineless than the last. But they command an old and prestigious name, and that carries value in this world, no matter how vapid that is in the face of actual talent at rulership. In the face of real strength. All I want is to make sure she's not married off to another inbred lordling; Kythie needs as husband of strong, virile blood — and the County of Maidenbridge needs the legitimacy of a noble house. Everyone who matters wins, and in the meantime, Tychris is left without an heir around the house for Evander and Tethys to hide their failures behind." "You're just getting her out of the way so you can take power." Vasko curls his nose. "So that I can undo the damage generations of inept rulership has inflicted on our society. So that I can guide the realm towards a more equitable new era, where commonfolk have a voice in governance, rather than bowing to the whims of farmer-barons and peacock generals. Kythie's the last hope of this failing monarchy. I get her out of the city, and I can start to exert real influence here. And another city that's already heading the right direction gains the legitimacy it needs to thrive!" He claps his hands together. "So, if you want to help, [vasko.fucked |darling |[pc.name] ], all you need to do is convince that old cow Tethys that her daughter's only got one hope to cure her plight — what I'd been trying to do before you butted in in the first place — and that's getting pregnant. Her fiance's too young to bed, so ship her off to Maidenbridge where Count Thore's son is ripe for it."
rows.translation: “如果我想帮你呢？”你提议道，[vasko.fucked |往前迈一步，贴着你这魁梧壮硕的情人凑了上去。“我可没有背叛自己操过的帅哥的习惯。” 瓦斯科的眼睛微微睁大，随即一条手臂环上你的腰，尾巴缠上你的腿。“啊，我的宝贝，我就知道我在你身上看到了什么。不只是那张好看的脸。还有那手好床上功夫。”他自己笑了起来。“那么告诉我，你到底想帮我做什么？” |靠在桌边。“我自己也谈不上是王室的大粉丝。我还没到这儿，他们就已经在骗我了。” “哦！是吗？”瓦斯科双手指尖对顶，用打量的目光看着你。“那你到底想帮我做什么？” ] “别装傻了，”你说。“告诉我你到底想对凯西做什么。” 瓦斯科弹了下舌头，靠回椅背。“其实很简单。是为了她好，尽管看起来不像。你爱怎么想我的为人就怎么想，[pc.name]，但我确实关心这姑娘。她至今什么都没做错。我的目的只是确保她永远没机会做错。” “继续说。” “她的家族把这座城市带进了泥坑，把我们削弱成一个只要出现一个强大的对手就等着被吞并的残破小邦。一群可悲的、只会嘤嘤叫的贵族，一个比一个软弱、一个比一个没骨气。可他们占着一个古老而显赫的名号，而在这世上，这名号就是有价值——哪怕在真正的治国才能面前、在真正的力量面前，它多么空洞无物。我只想确保她不会被嫁出去给又一个近亲繁殖的小领主；凯西需要一个血统强健、生殖力旺盛的丈夫——而梅登布里奇伯爵领需要一个大贵族家族的合法性。所有重要的人都赢了，与此同时，提克里斯家里就没了好让埃万德和泰西斯拿来掩盖自己无能的继承人。” “你只是想把她挪开，好让你自己夺权。” 瓦斯科皱起鼻子。“是为了让我能挽回一代代无能的统治者对这个社会造成的伤害。是为了让我能引领这个王国走向一个更公平的新时代——平民在治理中拥有发言权，而不是向农场男爵和孔雀将军们的心血来潮低头。凯西是这垂死君主制最后的希望。我把她弄出城，就能在这里开始施加真正的影响力。而另一座本就走在正确方向上的城市，也能得到它繁荣所需的合法性！” 他双手一拍。“所以，如果你想帮忙，[vasko.fucked |亲爱的 |[pc.name] ]，你只需要说服泰西斯那头老母牛，让她相信她女儿只有一线希望能摆脱困境——也就是我原本一直在做的事，直到你插进来搅局——那就是怀上孩子。她的未婚夫太年轻，上不了床，所以把她送去梅登布里奇，托雷伯爵的儿子正好到了年纪。”

rows.original:
"What, become the next prince-consort myself?" Vasko snort-laughs, rolling his eyes. "Tethys and Evander would sooner lock Kythie in a tower than have her body be sullied by a common man like myself. [kythie.fucked
        |At least, that's what I thought before you came along. But it's too late for that, now. 
    ]No, they'd never go for it. And, as beautiful as Kythie is, I'd be making both of us miserable the rest of our lives. I care for the girl too much for that."
    
    "Not enough to not curse her."
    
    Vasko winces. "A little pain for now is nothing compared to a lifetime!"

“什么，让我自己当下一任亲王夫婿？”瓦斯科嗤笑着翻了个白眼。“泰西斯和埃万德宁可把凯西锁进塔里，也不会让她的身体被我这种平民玷污。[kythie.fucked
        |至少在你出现之前我是这么想的。但现在说这个已经太晚了。 
    ]不，他们绝不会答应。而且，凯西再美，那样做也只会让我们俩余生都在痛苦中度过。我太在乎这姑娘了，不会那么干。”
    
    “还没在乎到不去诅咒她。”
    
    瓦斯科皱起脸。“眼下的一点痛苦，跟一辈子比起来算不了什么！”

One neat little package, isn't it? ]
rows.translation: [var0 |瓦斯科靠回椅背，抚着自己布满鳞片的下巴。“嗯！那……我想也行得通。你也是贵族，而且显然比霜冻边境剩下的任何血脉都强壮。你和凯西会生出强壮的孩子。你的领地离提克里斯也没那么近，王子没法拿凯西的未来当挡箭牌来掩盖自己的无能。我还是想帮梅登布里奇，但我没对他们发过誓——他们也不知道这事是我干的——所以我想这算不上伤害，也不算犯规。让你站在我这边，总比让你来搅我的计划好。所以，是的，如果你要走这条路，我不反对。” |瓦斯科摇摇头。“亲王和亲王妃绝不会同意，而且如果你试着……偷偷来一手，能落个流放就算你走运了。不行，她需要一个有地位的人，”他几乎是把这个词啐出来，“而且要能立刻娶她。这儿的名单很短，你我都不在上面。要是你能在接下来几天里从屁股里掏出个贵族身份来，那随你，但要是办不到——咱们还是照梅登布里奇的方案来。那是稳赢的。” ] [pc.hasVirileCock |或者，你也可以自己动手，直接让凯西怀上你的孩子。他们可以把你赶出宫殿，却没法把女儿的处女之身还回来。这会毁掉她的婚约、也解开诅咒，还会让她和她父母蒙羞。一举多得，一包搞定，不是吗？ ]
rows.raw: " [var0 |Vasko leans back, stroking his scaly chin. "Hm! That... might also work, I suppose. You're noble, too, though clearly of stronger stock than anything left in the Frost Marches. You and Kythie'd make strong children. And your domain's not so close to Tychris that the prince would be able to use Kythie's future as a shield to hide his incompetence. I'd still like to help Maidenbridge, but I've made no vows to them — they have no idea I'm responsible either — so I suppose it's no harm, no foul. Better to have you on side than fucking with my plans. So, yes, if that's the path you want to pursue, I won't oppose you." |Vasko shakes his head. "The prince and consort would never consent to it, and if you try and... sneak it in, you'll be lucky if exile's the worst you face. No, she needs someone of standing," he nearly spits the word, "and able to marry her immediately. That's a short list around here, one neither of us is on. If you can pull nobility somewhere out of your ass within the next few days, by all means, but barring that — let's stick to the Maidenbridge plan. It's a sure-win." ] [pc.hasVirileCock |Alternatively, you could take things into your own hands and just impregnate Kythie yourself. They can throw you out of the palace, but they can't un-take their daughter's virginity. It'll ruin her engagement and fix the curse, and bring shame on her and her parents. One neat little package, isn't it? ] "

rows.original:
"Now!" Vasko says, hopping to his feet and sweeping across the room. "You need to talk to Tethys. Convince her there's only one cure: packing that womb of her daughter's with virile seed, and the sooner the better. There's already an envoy of Maidenbridge here in the city, asking after Kythie's hand — good fortune, that. If you haven't already, you might want to talk to him. Just don't, uh, say anything about all of this. Better for everyone if he stays in the dark."
    
    "And what'll you be doing?" you ask him.
    
    Vasko gestures around. "Keeping her drugged, until Tethys finally gives. And once she's gone, I'll be ready to move in and take advantage of their weakness. I have a raft of reforms they just need to press the seal to, starting with landholding rights for farmers and fairer taxes for the city's commonfolk."
    
    Right then. To Tethys...
rows.translation:
“那么！”瓦斯科说着蹦起身，大步扫过房间。“你得去跟泰西斯谈。让她相信只有一种解药：往她女儿的子宫里灌满强健的种子，而且越快越好。梅登布里奇已经有个使节在城里，来求娶凯西——真是好运。要是你还没见过他，不妨去跟他谈谈。只是别，呃，别把这一切说出去。他蒙在鼓里对大家都好。”
    
    “那你打算做什么？”你问他。
    
    瓦斯科朝四周一挥手。“继续给她下药，直到泰西斯最终松口。等她一走，我就准备好插手，利用他们的软弱。我有一整套改革方案等着他们盖章，从农民的土地所有权，到给城里平民更公平的税赋。”
    
    好吧。去找泰西斯……

rows.original:
"You're not making a great case for yourself," you say, letting your hand drop to your [pc.weapon]. 
    
    Vasko sighs, rising to his feet. "I'm sorry to hear that, [pc.name]. You almost made a good choice, for once in your life. And now... now I can't exactly let you walk away."
    
    "Just give it up, Vasko." 
    
    The Magister narrows his eyes. You tense, ready for him to try and cast a spell — only for his tail to swipe the table, sending beakers and glass flying right at you!
    
    [var0
        |You duck down and draw your weapon as the glass shatters against the wall behind you. You're not falling for that old trick!
        |You barely manage to shield your eyes before the glass shatters against your arms and chest, slicing into you in a hail of agonizing blades. Fuck, there's blood all over your face! You can't see!
    ]
rows.translation:
“你这可没给自己辩出什么好名声，”你说着把手垂向你的[pc.weapon]。 
    
    瓦斯科叹着气站起身。“听到这话我很难过，[pc.name]。你这辈子总算差一点做了个正确的选择。而现在……现在我可没法就这么放你走了。”
    
    “放弃吧，瓦斯科。” 
    
    宫廷法师眯起眼睛。你绷紧身体，准备好他要施法——结果他的尾巴却扫过桌子，把烧杯和玻璃器皿朝你直直甩了过来！
    
    [var0
        |你低头闪避，拔出武器，玻璃在你身后的墙上砸得粉碎。这种老把戏可骗不到你！
        |你勉强护住双眼，玻璃就砸在你的手臂和胸口上碎裂，化作一阵剧痛的刀锋割进你的身体。操，你满脸都是血！你看不见了！
    ]

rows.original:
Vasko drops to a knee, breathing hard. "What... but how... my magic...?"
    
    You take a step forward and knock the magister's wooden rod from his hand. "Enough, Vasko. [pc.dcb
        |Your magic is nothing compared to me.
        |You've lost. Yield.
        |Stop being a meanie!
    ]"
    
    The magister's teeth clench, but he's got nothing left. No choice but to yield.
    
    "You fool," Vasko groans. "You're just perpetuating the status quo, for what? Another generation of weak-kneed rulers disconnected fr-"
    
    "Shut up!" you snap. "Nothing gives you the right to curse an innocent girl."
    
    Vasko winces. The aurora on the tip of his tail dims. "So, Champion... now what?"
rows.translation:
瓦斯科单膝跪地，喘着粗气。“什么……可是怎么……我的魔法……？”
    
    你上前一步，把宫廷法师手里的木杖打落。“够了，瓦斯科。[pc.dcb
        |你的魔法在我面前不值一提。
        |你输了。认输吧。
        |别再当坏蛋啦！
    ]”
    
    宫廷法师咬紧牙关，但他已经一无所有。除了认输别无选择。
    
    “你这蠢货，”瓦斯科呻吟道。“你只是在维持现状，图什么？又一代软脚虾统治者，跟民众脱fr-”
    
    “闭嘴！”你厉声道。“你没有任何权利去诅咒一个无辜的姑娘。”
    
    瓦斯科皱起脸。他尾尖上的极光黯淡下去。“那么，冠军……现在怎么办？”

rows.original: Bring Vasko to Lady Tethys and make him confess to what's he's done. He will face the law of the state for treason.
rows.translation: 把瓦斯科带到泰西斯夫人面前，逼他坦白自己的所作所为。他将以叛国罪面对国法制裁。
rows.raw: "Bring Vasko to Lady Tethys and make him confess to what's he's done. He will face the law of the state for treason."

rows.original: Bring the 'mander-mage to Eirina, of the Order Astrida. Vasko will be made Dreamless; his magic will be stripped away from him forever.
rows.translation: 把那个蝾螈法师交给阿斯特里达教团的艾瑞娜。瓦斯科会被变成无梦者；他的魔法将被永远剥夺。
rows.raw: "Bring the 'mander-mage to Eirina, of the Order Astrida. Vasko will be made Dreamless; his magic will be stripped away from him forever."

rows.original: Enact your own brand of justice, and ensure Vasko never even wants to hurt anyone again. Fill that mind of his with nothing but harmless horny.
rows.translation: 施行你自己那一套正义，确保瓦斯科连伤害别人的念头都不会再升起。把他那颗脑子塞满无害的发情念头，除此之外什么也不留。
rows.raw: "Enact your own brand of justice, and ensure Vasko never even wants to hurt anyone again. Fill that mind of his with nothing but harmless horny."

rows.original: You need two Bimbo Brews to fully blast a mind as dark as Vasko's.
rows.translation: 要把瓦斯科这样黑暗的脑子彻底轰烂，你需要两瓶笨蛋啤酒。
rows.raw: "You need two Bimbo Brews to fully blast a mind as dark as Vasko's."

rows.original: "You're going to see Tethys and explain to her what you've done to her daughter." Vasko snarls. "You might as well kill me yourself, coward. That brute will only have one thing on her mind." You just haul the traitorous 'mander to his feet and shove him towards the door. "Get moving." [kythie.isCursed |The nearer you draw to the tower, [kythie.highLibido |and the louder Kythie's horny screaming gets, ]the more hopeless Vasko looks. A few of the guards between his lab and the princess's cell give you questioning looks, but they don't stop you. | You march him straight to the lady-consort's sitting room, not far at all from his lab. The single guard between you and there gives you a questioning look, but otherwise doesn't hassle you. ] You find Tethys [kythie.isCursed |pacing in front of Kythie's door. She pauses in her fretting just long enough to frown at the both of you |reclining in her reading chair. She gets up with a frown ]. "What is the meaning of this, [pc.name]? Why are you manhandling my magister?" "Tell her," you say, shoving Vasko towards Tethys. "Go to hell." Tethys's eyes narrow. "Vasko, what have you done?" "He's your culprit," you say, since Vasko's still not owning up to it. "Vasko cursed Kythie." "Is this true, Vasko?" Tethys asks. Her lips draw into a thin line, and a vein pulses above her left eye. But her voice stays even, at least for now. "Are you responsible for my daughter's suffering?" You can practically feel the need to smart-talk her welling up inside the sorcerer; the visceral desire to overflow with sarcasm. But there's no point left. Not under the consort's withering gaze, standing within beating range. He just hangs his head and lets his shoulders go limp. "I am, Tethys. I did it. It was me." Tethys doesn't ask why. She doesn't question. She just strikes Vasko, a full-knuckle punch to the stomach that leaves him reeling against the wall. His tail bracing him is the only thing that keeps him upright. "You damn brute!" Tethys scowls, and whistles to her guard. "Take him. Gag him. Shackle his hands, down to the fingers. Evander will deliver justice in the morning." Vasko gives you a hateful look before strong arms clasp his shoulders, and he's hauled away.
rows.translation: “你要去见泰西斯，亲口告诉她你对她女儿做了什么。” 瓦斯科龇牙咆哮。“你还不如亲自动手杀了我，懦夫。那母夜叉脑子里只会想着一件事。” 你只是把那叛徒蝾螈拽起来，推着他往门口走。“走。” [kythie.isCursed |你越靠近那座塔，[kythie.highLibido |凯西发情的尖叫声就越响， ]瓦斯科看上去就越绝望。从他实验室到公主牢房之间的几个卫兵向你投来询问的目光，但都没有拦你。 | 你押着他径直走向亲王妃的起居室，离他的实验室一点也不远。你们之间那名唯一的卫兵向你投来询问的目光，除此之外并没有为难你。 ] 你找到泰西斯时，她[kythie.isCursed |正在凯西门前踱步。她焦躁不安地停下脚步，只够朝你们俩皱一下眉头 |正靠在自己的阅读椅上。她皱着眉站起身 ]。“这是什么意思，[pc.name]？你凭什么这样粗鲁地对待我的宫廷法师？” “告诉她，”你说着把瓦斯科推向泰西斯。 “去死吧。” 泰西斯眯起眼睛。“瓦斯科，你做了什么？” “他就是真凶，”你说，因为瓦斯科仍然不肯认账。“是瓦斯科诅咒了凯西。” “这是真的吗，瓦斯科？”泰西斯问。她的嘴唇抿成一条细线，左眼上方一根血管突突跳动。但她的声音至少此刻还保持着平稳。“我女儿的痛苦是你造成的？” 你几乎能感觉到那股想跟她耍嘴皮子的冲动在这位法师体内翻涌；那种忍不住要倾泻讽刺的本能渴望。但已经没有意义了。在亲王妃那令人窒息的注视下，站在挨打的范围内，毫无意义。他只是垂下头，肩膀松垮下去。“是我，泰西斯。是我干的。就是我。” 泰西斯没有问为什么。她什么也没问。她只是动手打了瓦斯科，一记握紧拳头的重拳砸在他肚子上，打得他踉跄着撞上墙壁。全靠尾巴撑着，他才没有倒下。“你这该死的畜生！” 泰西斯沉下脸，朝她的卫兵吹了声口哨。“把他带走。堵上他的嘴。把手锁起来，连手指都锁上。埃万德明天早上会来伸张正义。” 瓦斯科恨恨地看了你一眼，随即一只有力的手扣住他的肩膀，把他拖走了。

rows.original:
Tethy doesn't look any happier now that the criminal is in custody. Her hands rest on her hips, and her brow is furrowed deep enough to leave her looking like a bird of prey. 
    
    [kythie.isCursed
        |"Without anyone to poison her again, the Astrida should be able to fix Kythie now," you suggest, trying to snap Tethys out of it.
        
        Her eyes shift to you slowly. "About time." She sighs, long and hard. Her shoulder slump. "Thank you, Champion. I... thank you. Allow me some time to arrange things with Eirina. You will have your reward once my daughter is cured once and for all. And once the villain meets justice."
        
        You nod. "Tomorrow?"
        
        "Tomorrow, goddess willing."
        |"Are you alright, Tethys?" you ask. "The villain's been caught, you're daughter's cured..."
        
        "I wish I was," she says. She sighs, long and hard. Her shoulder slump. "Thank you, Champion. I... thank you. I will be alright, eventually. This has all been so... awful."
        
        She shakes her head. "You have done the realm a great service, finding the viper in our midst. I pray there was only the one."
        
        So far that you've found...
        
        "You've more than earned your commission, Champion. I will have our treasurer ensure you receive the rest by day's end. Now, I must tell Evander what's happened. You may excuse yourself."
    ]
rows.translation:
罪犯已经收押，泰西斯看上去却没有半点高兴。她双手叉腰，眉头皱得深到让她看起来像一只猛禽。 
    
    [kythie.isCursed
        |“既然没人能再给她下毒了，阿斯特里达现在应该能治好凯西，”你提议道，想把泰西斯从那股情绪里拉出来。
        
        她的目光缓缓移向你。“总算。”她长长地、重重地叹了口气。肩膀垮了下来。“谢谢你，冠军。我……谢谢你。给我些时间去跟艾瑞娜安排。等我女儿彻底痊愈、等那恶人受到审判，你就会拿到你的报酬。”
        
        你点点头。“明天？”
        
        “明天，如果女神愿意的话。”
        |“你还好吗，泰西斯？”你问。“恶人已经抓住了，你女儿也治好了……”
        
        “我倒希望是这样，”她说。她长长地、重重地叹了口气。肩膀垮了下来。“谢谢你，冠军。我……谢谢你。我最终会好起来的。这一切实在……太可怕了。”
        
        她摇摇头。“你为王国立了大功，揪出了我们中间的毒蛇。我祈祷只有这一条。”
        
        至少目前你找到的只有这一条……
        
        “你的酬劳远不止这些，冠军。我会让我们的司库确保你在今天结束前拿到剩下的部分。现在，我得去把发生的事告诉埃万德。你可以退下了。”
    ]

rows.original:

rows.original: Popping your head into the frostmander's lab, you're met with the peculiar sight of it being surprisingly empty. It's strange[vasko.isBimbo |; even though she's recently become much more friendly and social with the others in the castle, she still spends a lot of time in here | – especially for someone like Vasko, whom you hardly see anywhere else when he has his experiments and tests all in this room ]. A quick glance around shows that, no, [vasko.heShe] really isn't here — [vasko.heShe] isn't even taking a nap in the connecting bedroom. Though you do see a short, written note sitting on [vasko.hisHer] nightstand. Picking it up, it reads: [vasko.isBimbo |Hey Sweetie! I'm spending some time with our little bug here on the castle grounds. They've got caregivers to look after kids while the staff is working, so I drop by to visit Chryse there! Come join us!! Vaska ♡ |My dear [pc.name], Should you see this note, it means you've stopped by before I could return. I am visiting our daughter where she resides in the care of caretakers set up for working staff with children. If it pleases you, come join us. Vasko ] [pc.dcb |You guess you have the free time. |You have some free time, and you definitely want to see your little girl... why not? |Heck yes, you'd love to see your sweet baby!! ] The note doesn't actually mention any instructions for where, exactly, the nursery room is, so you sort of just wander a little bit until you finally reach it. It doesn't turn out to be that hard to figure out where it is, since you can hear the happy laughter and giggles of small children down the hall from where the room actually sits. The door itself is cracked open the slightest bit, granting you a small peek into the room before you open it fully. It's a very large room set up with a small kitchen in one corner and fully equipped for a wide range of ages. From small playpens and cribs, to a small but varied selection of books in a pseudo library, to a small area that looks set up to teach or tutor children of many ages. Several frostscales attend to the handful of children here, from a couple toddlers to the oldest, who looks to be roughly 12 years of age. One of them, a particularly curvaceous frostscale with untameably curly hair and a mole on her cheek, notices you and quickly comes to greet you at the doorway. "Hello," she says, voice soft yet laced with something protectively fierce. "My name is Myrine, and I'm the matron here. Can I help you with something...?" You quickly explain that you're looking for [vasko.name], and that a note said [vasko.heShe]'d be here. Immediately her body relaxes, giving you a smile instead. "Ahhh, I see! My apologies; one can never be too careful with an unfamiliar face. [vasko.HeShe]'s over there." [vasko.name] stands near the cribs, Chryse cradled in [vasko.hisHer] arms while [vasko.heShe] [vasko.isBimbo |coos at her with watery eyes |smiles at the way she gnaws at a scaled fingertip ]. [vasko.HeShe] gently bounces her; one hand alternates between rubs and soft pats against her back. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] looks back at you when you reach [vasko.hisHer] side and gives you a [vasko.isBimbo |beaming |soft ] smile. "[vasko.isBimbo |Hey, Sweetie. You got my note! |Hello, my dear. I see you got my note. ]" You were surprised to not see [vasko.himHer] in [vasko.hisHer] lab. Has [vasko.heShe] been here long? "I was about to head back to the lab, since she's about ready for a nap. I had some free time and I wanted to see her." [vasko.HeShe] wraps [vasko.hisHer] tail around one of your legs, the cool aurora at the tip tickling your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]. [vasko.HisHer] eyes don't waver from the wiggling bundle of salamander baby in [vasko.hisHer] grasp. You get a good look at Chryse for the first time since she was born. The little frostscale is about as plump as a newborn can be, all chubby cheeks and pudgy belly. She's also got the same blue scales that [vasko.name] does, still soft with the newness of birth. Her tail tip has the barest flame started, already flickering in a beautiful aurora. But her eyes? Those are all yours. Even as they slip closed, she is indisputably yours and [vasko.name]'s. [vasko.isBimbo |"Babies weren't really anything I gave a whole lotta thought to, you know? Like, they happen, yeah, but I didn't think about ME having one. |"I wasn't really sure about having a child, at first. I didn't have the best experience myself when I was younger and I wasn't sure I'd really know what to do with a baby. ]" [vasko.name] leans against your side, [vasko.hisHer] skin cool. "But goddess, she's perfect." Reluctantly [vasko.heShe] transfers the sleeping babe from [vasko.hisHer] arms to the crib with all the care of a parent trying not to wake up a fussy child. Chryse settles peacefully without complaint, a sleepy snuffle her only response. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] uses [vasko.hisHer] tail to nudge you towards the entrance, nodding once to a matron that waves the two of you goodbye while you close the door of the nursery behind you. "I'm heading back to my lab now, [vasko.isBimbo |Sweetie |my dear ], but come find me whenever you want to visit our daughter, okay? We'll go together; spend some time as a family, if we get the chance." Reaching [vasko.hisHer] lab, the frostmander turns to you. "Now, what can I do for you, [vasko.isBimbo |hun |[pc.name] ]?"
rows.translation: 你把头探进冰霜火蜥蜴的实验室，却看到里面出奇地空无一人，不禁觉得有些古怪[vasko.isBimbo |；虽说她最近变得友善合群了许多，但还是常常待在这里 |——尤其是瓦斯科这种把实验和测试全放在这间屋里、平时几乎不会在别处露面的人 ]。 你迅速环顾四周，确认[vasko.heShe]确实不在——[vasko.heShe]甚至也没有在相连的卧室里打盹。不过，你倒是在[vasko.hisHer]床头柜上看见了一张简短的字条。 你拿起来一看，上面写着： [vasko.isBimbo |亲爱的！ 我正在城堡里陪我们的小可爱！这里有照顾员工孩子的看护员，所以我会来这里看克丽丝！ 快来和我们一起玩！！ 瓦斯卡 ♡ |亲爱的[pc.name]： 如果你看到这张字条，说明你在我回来之前来过了。我正在看望我们的女儿；工作人员工作期间，她会住在为有孩子的员工设置的托儿处。如果你愿意，请来和我们团聚。 瓦斯科 ] [pc.dcb |你想自己正好有空。 |你有些空闲，而且确实很想见见自己的小女儿……何乐而不为呢？ |当然要去，你太想见自己的可爱宝宝了！！ ] 字条其实没写育婴室究竟在哪里，于是你只能四处转悠了一会儿，最终才找到那里。不过想判断位置并不算难，因为还没走到门口，你便已经能听见走廊那头传来的孩童欢笑声。 房门微微敞着一条缝，你在彻底推开之前，得以先窥见里面的一角。这间屋子非常宽敞，角落里设有一间小厨房，各种设施足以照顾不同年龄的孩子：既有小型围栏和婴儿床，也有一处宛如小图书馆、种类丰富的藏书区，还有一片似乎专门用于教授或辅导各年龄段孩童的地方。 几名冰鳞火蜥蜴照料着屋里的几个孩子，年龄从蹒跚学步的幼儿到看起来大约十二岁的孩子不等。 其中一名身材格外丰腴、卷发怎么也理不顺、脸颊上还有颗美人痣的冰鳞火蜥蜴注意到你，很快便来到门口迎接。 “你好，”她柔声说道，嗓音中却带着一股保护幼崽般的强硬。“我叫米琳，是这里的女管事。请问有什么事吗……？” 你赶紧解释自己在找[vasko.name]，而字条上说[vasko.heShe]会在这里。 她立刻放松下来，转而向你露出微笑。“啊，我明白了！请原谅；面对陌生面孔，再小心也不为过。[vasko.HeShe]就在那边。” [vasko.name]站在婴儿床附近，将克丽丝抱在[vasko.hisHer]怀里；[vasko.heShe][vasko.isBimbo |眼含泪光地对她柔声细语 |微笑着看她啃咬自己覆着鳞片的指尖 ]。[vasko.HeShe]轻轻摇晃着她；一只手轮流在她背上抚摸、轻拍。 这位[vasko.isBimbo |痴女 |宫廷法师 ]在你来到[vasko.hisHer]身旁时回头看向你，露出一个[vasko.isBimbo |灿烂的 |温柔的 ]微笑。“[vasko.isBimbo |嗨，亲爱的。你看到我的字条了！ |你好，亲爱的。看来你看到我的字条了。 ]” 没看到[vasko.himHer]出现在[vasko.hisHer]实验室，你还挺惊讶的。[vasko.heShe]来这里很久了吗？ “她差不多该睡午觉了，我本来也准备回实验室。我正好有空，便想来看看她。”[vasko.HeShe]用[vasko.hisHer]尾巴缠住你的一条腿，尾尖冰凉的极光挠得你的[pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]微微发痒。[vasko.HisHer]目光始终没有离开[vasko.hisHer]怀里扭动着的火蜥蜴宝宝。 自克丽丝出生以来，你第一次得以仔细端详她。 这个冰鳞火蜥蜴宝宝胖乎乎的，圆润的脸颊和肉嘟嘟的小肚子无不透着新生儿的可爱。她还长着与[vasko.name]相同的蓝色鳞片，只是初生的鳞片依旧柔软。她的尾尖刚刚燃起最微弱的火焰，已经开始闪烁出美丽的极光。 至于她的眼睛？ 那可全都随你。 即使她缓缓合上双眼，也毫无疑问是你和[vasko.name]的孩子。 [vasko.isBimbo |“我以前从没怎么认真想过宝宝的事，你懂吧？就是，当然会有人生宝宝，可我没想过自己会有一个。 |“一开始，我其实不确定自己是否想要孩子。我小时候的经历算不上好，也不知道自己是否真的懂得该怎么照顾宝宝。 ]”[vasko.name]靠在你身侧，[vasko.hisHer]肌肤一片冰凉。“不过，女神在上，她太完美了。” [vasko.heShe]依依不舍地将熟睡的宝宝从[vasko.hisHer]怀中放进婴儿床，动作无比小心，唯恐惊醒这个可能哭闹起来的小家伙。 克丽丝安静地睡着，没有半点不满，只发出一声睡梦中的轻哼。 这位[vasko.isBimbo |痴女 |宫廷法师 ]用[vasko.hisHer]尾巴轻推你走向出口，又朝一位女管事点了点头；你们轻轻关上育婴室的门时，对方挥手向你们道别。 “我现在要回实验室了，[vasko.isBimbo |亲爱的 |亲爱的 ]。不过，只要你想看女儿，就来找我，好吗？我们一起过来；有机会的话，就作为一家人共度一段时光。” 回到[vasko.hisHer]实验室后，冰霜火蜥蜴转向你。 “那么，有什么需要我效劳的吗，[vasko.isBimbo |亲爱的 |[pc.name] ]？”

I am visiting our daughter where she resides in the care of caretakers set up for working staff with children. If it pleases you, come join us. Vasko ] [pc.dcb |You guess you have the free time. |You have some free time, and you definitely want to see your little girl... why not? |Heck yes, you'd love to see your sweet baby!! ] The note doesn't actually mention any instructions for where, exactly, the nursery room is, so you sort of just wander a little bit until you finally reach it. It doesn't turn out to be that hard to figure out where it is, since you can hear the happy laughter and giggles of small children down the hall from where the room actually sits. The door itself is cracked open the slightest bit, granting you a small peek into the room before you open it fully. It's a very large room set up with a small kitchen in one corner and fully equipped for a wide range of ages. From small playpens and cribs, to a small but varied selection of books in a pseudo library, to a small area that looks set up to teach or tutor children of many ages. Several frostscales attend to the handful of children here, from a couple toddlers to the oldest, who looks to be roughly 12 years of age. One of them, a particularly curvaceous frostscale with untameably curly hair and a mole on her cheek, notices you and quickly comes to greet you at the doorway. "Hello," she says, voice soft yet laced with something protectively fierce. "My name is Myrine, and I'm the matron here. Can I help you with something...?" You quickly explain that you're looking for [vasko.name], and that a note said [vasko.heShe]'d be here. Immediately her body relaxes, giving you a smile instead. "Ahhh, I see! My apologies; one can never be too careful with an unfamiliar face. [vasko.HeShe]'s over there." [vasko.name] stands near the cribs, Chryse cradled in [vasko.hisHer] arms while [vasko.heShe] [vasko.isBimbo |coos at her with watery eyes |smiles at the way she gnaws at a scaled fingertip ]. [vasko.HeShe] gently bounces her; one hand alternates between rubs and soft pats against her back. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] looks back at you when you reach [vasko.hisHer] side and gives you a [vasko.isBimbo |beaming |soft ] smile. "[vasko.isBimbo |Hey, Sweetie. You got my note! |Hello, my dear. I see you got my note. ]" You were surprised to not see [vasko.himHer] in [vasko.hisHer] lab. Has [vasko.heShe] been here long? "I was about to head back to the lab, since she's about ready for a nap. I had some free time and I wanted to see her." [vasko.HeShe] wraps [vasko.hisHer] tail around one of your legs, the cool aurora at the tip tickling your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]. [vasko.HisHer] eyes don't waver from the wiggling bundle of salamander baby in [vasko.hisHer] grasp. You get a good look at Chryse for the first time since she was born. The little frostscale is about as plump as a newborn can be, all chubby cheeks and pudgy belly. She's also got the same blue scales that [vasko.name] does, still soft with the newness of birth. Her tail tip has the barest flame started, already flickering in a beautiful aurora. But her eyes? Those are all yours. Even as they slip closed, she is indisputably yours and [vasko.name]'s. [vasko.isBimbo |"Babies weren't really anything I gave a whole lotta thought to, you know? Like, they happen, yeah, but I didn't think about ME having one. |"I wasn't really sure about having a child, at first. I didn't have the best experience myself when I was younger and I wasn't sure I'd really know what to do with a baby. ]" [vasko.name] leans against your side, [vasko.hisHer] skin cool. "But goddess, she's perfect." Reluctantly [vasko.heShe] transfers the sleeping babe from [vasko.hisHer] arms to the crib with all the care of a parent trying not to wake up a fussy child. Chryse settles peacefully without complaint, a sleepy snuffle her only response. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] uses [vasko.hisHer] tail to nudge you towards the entrance, nodding once to a matron that waves the two of you goodbye while you close the door of the nursery behind you. "I'm heading back to my lab now, [vasko.isBimbo |Sweetie |my dear ], but come find me whenever you want to visit our daughter, okay? We'll go together; spend some time as a family, if we get the chance." Reaching [vasko.hisHer] lab, the frostmander turns to you. "Now, what can I do for you, [vasko.isBimbo |hun |[pc.name] ]?" "

            |“你好，米琳，”瓦斯科向一名看护点头致意。“如果不会造成太大打扰，[pc.name]和我想陪陪[vasko.numKids 1 2

        ]与其他孩子一起玩耍的地方。
        
        [vasko.isBimbo
            |瓦斯卡在米琳脸颊上响亮地亲了一口以示感谢，随后轻快地走上前抱起你们的女儿，惹得她又惊又喜地叫了一声。
            
            “你好呀，小宝贝！！！”
            |瓦斯科拍了拍米琳以示感谢，随后从容地走上前抱起你们的女儿，惹得她又惊又喜地叫了一声。
            
            “你好，我的小宝贝。”
        ]这位[vasko.isBimbo
            |痴女
            |大法师
        ]开始夸张地连连亲吻克丽丝的脸颊，随后撅起[vasko.hisHer]嘴唇贴着她的皮肤吹气逗她发笑。
        
        [vasko.numKids 1 2 3
            |你们的女儿一看到你，便伸出双手向前探来。
            
            “[pc.mfn
                |爸
                |妈
                |叭
            ]！”她脱口叫道，不停扭动着身体，直到你将她抱进怀里。一只小拳头伸向你的[pc.ear]，用力拉扯；不过当你用拇指轻轻诱导她松开拳头时，她很快便放了手。
            |你抱起另一个孩子，亲吻{his
            |her}额头和乱抓的小手，沉浸在宝宝见到你时发出的欢快叫声中。
            |你们的其他孩子人数多过你们俩，但你毫不在意，一手一个抱起其中两个，在他们的额头和乱抓的小手上落下亲吻。
        ]
        
        [vasko.name]俯身越过你满怀扭动的宝宝，在你嘴角轻轻一吻。“我们来陪这个日益壮大的家庭好好相处一会儿，怎么样？”
        
        听起来再好不过。
        
        接下来几个小时，你和[vasko.name]陪着[vasko.numKids 1 2
            |克丽丝
            |你们的小家伙们
        ]，任由小家伙[vasko.numKids 1 2
            |想玩什么就玩什么
            |们想玩什么就玩什么
        ]；积木、图画书，还有一次不幸吐到[vasko.name]长袍上的小事故——一切都飞快流逝，却又仿佛处于慢动作之中。
        
        你珍惜其中的每一秒；终有一天，你会最后一次抱起自己的宝宝，却不会意识到那就是最后一次。因此，只要现在还能这样做，你便要把握每一秒。每一次拥抱、每一个吻、每一处擦破的膝盖和每一次含泪撅嘴——在流逝的岁月中，你都会将它们珍藏心底。
        
        遗憾的是，终于到了[vasko.numKids 1 2
            |克丽丝睁不开眼
            |孩子们睁不开眼
        ]的时候；而你仍抱着[vasko.numKids 1 2
            |她
            |他们
        ]。他们该午睡了，你和[vasko.name]也该各自回去履行职责。

        克丽丝安静地睡着，没有半点不满，只发出一声睡梦中的轻哼。
    ]
    
    这位[vasko.isBimbo
        |痴女

    “那么，有什么需要我效劳的吗，[vasko.isBimbo
        |亲爱的
        |[pc.name]
    ]？”
